༄༅/ /khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa ngo mtshar yon tan rin po che 'dus pa'i rgya mtsho 'phel bar byed pa phun tshogs bdud rtsi'i char rgyun zhes bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ khyab bdag rigs brgya'i mgon po 'jam dbyangs bla ma kun dga'i mtshan can gyi rtogs pa brjod pa ngo mtshar yon tan rgya mtsho'i kha skong phun tshogs bdud rtsi'i char rgyun zhes bya ba/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtha' yas rgyal ba'i ye shes gcig sku ngag gi dbang po'i mkhyen mtsho las/ /thub bstan kun gsal dga' ma'i mgrin pa mdzes pa'i rgyan du nyer 'ong nas/ /bsod nams 'od phung 'bar ba'i 'phreng bas phan bde'i 'dab brgya bzhad mdzad pa/ /'jam dbyangs sngon med smra ba'i nyi ma bdag gi yid mkhar rtag tu rol/ /rab snyan grags pa'i 'od dkar bye ba'i dpung / /phyogs bcur spros pas 'gro kun bag med kyi/ /mun pa'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal byed mkhan/ /rje btsun mtshan mo'i mgon la phyag bgyi'o/ /grangs med legs byas chu gter gyis bskrun zhing / /blo gros mdangs bkra 'phrin las dri bsung 'phro/ /lung rtogs ze'u 'bru'i 'phreng mdzes skal ldan gyi/ /bung ba'i dpal gyur yongs 'dzin padmor 'dud/ /gang thugs gser gyi ra ba mthon po'i khong / /yon tan bdud rtsi'i dog pas yongs gtams kyang / /bzang po'i chos tshul dal 'bab kun bsdus pa/ /rnam 'dren yid bzhin rgya mtshos 'gro 'di srungs/ /lha brgya'i thor cog ngo mtshar nor bu'i khrir/ /zhabs sen dbyig gi khu ba ngal 'tsho ba'i/ /kun dga'i byed po 'jam mgon bsod nams gter/ /gang khyod snying gi pad mtsho 'dir bzhugs la/ /rnam gsum dad pa'i skyed tshal rgyas pa'i gnyen/ /rtogs brjod zla ba'i ma ma 'phel ba'i grogs/

/ngo mtshar yan lag brgyad kyis legs 'khyud pa'i/ /bdud rtsi'i char zil spro 'di byin rlobs shig /ces slad du bgyi bar 'os pa rnam pa gnyis sngon du btang nas/ de la 'dir gang gleng bar bya ba ni drug pa rdo rje sems dpa' dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa dag yin la/ de yang / rgyal ba rnams ni 'gro ba kun la bu gcig pa ltar dgongs pa'i brtse ba chen pos kun nas bslangs te/ thob par bya ba'i 'bras bu sku bzhi dang / ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid can gyi byang chub chen po mngon du mdzad nas/ lus can mtha' dag srid pa dang zhi ba'i rgud pa thams cad las gtan nas bsgral bar bzhed pa'i smon pa dang 'jug pa'i bdag nyid can gyi byang chub kyi sems/ dmigs par bya ba kun rdzob dang / don dam pa'i spyod yul can/ dag pa gsum gyi rang bzhin du gyur pa nyid ches shin tu goms pa mthar thug pa'i dbang las/ rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid dang / nam yang mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po zung du 'grel ba'i 'od gsal chos sku khyab 'jug gi bsti gnas las skad cig kyang ma g.yos par/ dge sbyong dang / bram ze dang / 'khor los bsgyur ba la sogs pa g.yo ba dang / 'byung ba dang / de las gyur pa la sogs brten pa'i dngos po cir yang sprul nas/ srid pa ji srid par sems can gyi don mdzad pa ni chos nyid de/ de yang mkhyen pas 'dul ba la 'phags pa 'jam dpal/ thugs rjes 'dul ba la phyag na padmo/ nus pas 'dul ba la gsang ba'i bdag po lag na rdo rje ston pa mdzad ces grags so/ /de dag kyang gtso che ba'i dbang du byas kyi/ gzhan du na gsum po re res kyang gang la gang 'dul de la der ston pa ni/ dper na ston ka'i dus kyi zla ba'i dkyil 'khor cha shas yongs su gang ba/ chu klung dang /

rdzing bu dang / lteng ka la sogs pa rnyog pa dang bral ba'i chu nang ji snyed pa rang gi snang brnyan de snyed kyis mdzes par byed pa bzhin no/ /de la re zhig blo gter brtan pa'i 'khor lo de nyid kyis/ bdag cag gi skyobs pa shākya'i dbang po'i 'khor tshogs rnam bzhi'i 'dus pa rgya mtsho lta bu'i nang du/ theg pa gsum rang gis thos nas gzhan la sgrog pa'i khyu mchog gi dam pa/ cod pan med pa'i bram ze'i rgyal srid mchil ma'i thal ba bzhin bor nas rab tu byon pas/ thog ma med pa nas goms pa'i ma rig pa'i sgo nga dum bur dbral te mthu che zhing / rdzu 'phrul che ba'i rtser son pa/ 'phags pa mau 'gal gyi bu chen po zhes grags dkar sa gsum gyi rna ba'i bcud len du 'phro ba der sprul nas/ 'phags pa utpa la'i mdog 'dod pa la shas cher 'chum pa'i las kyi 'dam rdzab las nye bar drangs pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa dpal skyes shin tu smad pa'i duḥkha'i 'dod pa las bsgral ba sogs gdul bya'i skye bo grangs med pa zhig gi don mdzad pa dang / gzhan yang 'phags pa'i yul du mkhas pa dang / btsun pa dang / bzang ba'i ngang tshul can bgrang mi bzod pa bsgyur nas/ 'gro ba mang po mtha' gnyis kyi g.yang sa nas 'byin par mdzad pa'i tshul mtha' yas shing / phyis nas 'phags pa gru 'dzin gyi bdag po'i zhing khams kai la sha'i 'phreng ba can gyi ljongs 'dir/ byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje nyi ma de nyid stobs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po'i skur bzhengs pa srong btsan sgam po'i bka' mched gser gyi shing rta'i kha lo pa mgar stong btsan yul bzung zhes bya bar sprul nas/ 'gro sems mya ngam gyi thang la legs byas kyi lam srol bzang po gsar du gtod pa dang mkhan po chen po shanta rakṣi ta zhes bya bar/ dbus 'gyur mes po'i yul nas bslab gsum dza hu'i bu mo byang phyogs sa 'og gi khyon 'dir legs par drangs nas/

skal ldan dug can pa'i bu grangs med drug khri'i sgrib gnyis kyi dri ma drungs nas bkrus te/ byang grol shel gyi lding khang du bkri bar mdzad pa'i shing rta bcu pa la sogs pa rnams pa thams cad par sprul nas/ skye dgu kun la phan bde'i dus ston bzang po spel bar mdzad pa'i tshul grangs mi bzod cing / khyad par dri ma med pa'i gdung rigs gsum rtsen gyi lam las gral gyi 'phreng ba bar ma chad par 'ongs te mdzad bzang sprin gyi myu gu dal bur 'phro bas yid can nor gyi blo gros ma yongs kyis lung bzang dge legs rtswa ljang gsar pa'i 'jo ber gyis bklubs par byed pa'i/ don las mtshan du grags pa'i rigs rgyud skyon bral nam mkha'i rgyal mtshan srid pa'i tsha zer 'joms byed kyi tshogs su zlos pa'i rol gar gyis rtse ba ni/ gnas gsum gyi don la mkhyen can nyi ma ltar gsal ba'i grub rig me na ka'i khyu'i lung bstan gyi tambu ra snyan par 'tsher ba ltar rgyal ba'i zhing rab 'byams kun tu grags shing grub la/ de dag gi nang nas kyang tshe dang / lta ba dang / nyon mongs pa dang / dus dang / sems can gyi snyigs ma'i lang tsho shin tu bdo ba'i skabs 'dir na/ bdag cag 'gro ba lha dang bcas pa'i mgon dang / skyabs dang / gling dang / dpung gnyen gcig pu/ rgyu dang 'bras bu'i theg pa gnyis kyi gnad ji lta ba bzhin rang gis gzigs nas gzhan la 'doms pa'i ston pa gnyis pa snod bcud thams cad rten dang brten pa'i 'khor lor bsgyur nas/ bde ba chen po'i ye shes kyis byin gyis brlabs te/ 'dzin med snang stong zung 'jug gi lam la sbyangs pa mthar son pas/ chos lung sprul pa'i bdag nyid can gyi sku gsum pa/ 'chi med 'od gsal gyi gser mngal dri ma med pa nas nye bar 'ongs shing / bya ba dang / spyod pa dang / rnal 'byor dang / bla na med pa'i tant+ra'i rig byed bzhi'i 'byung khungs su gyur pa'i rnam dpyod kyi gdong pa bzhi pa sdug bsngal gyi chu klung chen po'i rang mtshang mngon sum du brtol nas/

las nyon gyi rgya mtsho rtsa ba nas skem par byed pa'i lam gyi tsha zer phyogs bcur spros pas/ thar pa'i pad tshal drag tu bzhad pa la rang dbang byed pa'i dad pa dang / brtson 'grus dang / dran pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / shes rab kyi dbang po zur phud lnga pa/ phung po lnga'i dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa ma lus par sbyangs te/ ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin can gyi rgyal ba lnga'i ngo bor gyur pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo kun la khyab par byed pa'i rigs drug pa gzung 'dzin gyi sprin tshogs rnam par bral ba'i 'od gsal chos sku'i mkha' dbyings su mngon par 'phags te/ 'grib pa med pa'i mkhyen brtse'i dkyil 'khor las legs par bshad pa'i 'od zer stong phrag spros nas/ rgyal ba'i ring lugs nyin mor byed pa'i bdun gyi bdun pa/ chos brgyad kyi 'ching thag dum bu brgyar bcad de/ rnam par thar pa brgyad la ci dgar bsam gtan pa'i lam gyi yan lag brgyad pa/ srid pa'i duḥkha drag po rtsad nas 'jil bar byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin la lugs dang / lugs mi mthun par mthar gyis gnas par byed pa'i snyoms 'jug dgu pa/ sngon gyi gnas dang / khams sna tshogs dang / mos pa du ma la sogs pa shes bya kun gyi gnas tshul ji lta ba bzhin mkhyen pas thabs dang / skyabs dang dag pa sogs la sems can rnams bslu byed bdud kyi dpung tshogs 'joms par byed pa'i stobs bcu pa/ rang don spangs rtogs phun tshogs mngon du gyur nas gzhan don 'phrin las phun tshogs lhun gyis 'grub pa rgyun mi 'chad pas/ skye dgu kun la dngos dang brgyud pas srid pa dang zhi ba'i phun sum tshogs pa thams cad bde blag tu stsol bar mdzad pa'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che/ mdor na/ mkhas pa thams cad kyi mnga' bdag grub pa thams cad kyi gtsug rgyan/ srid pa thams cad kyi skyobs pa/ phan bde thams cad kyi 'byung gnas dam pa dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes grags dkar nam mkha'i pha mtha' 'gog pa 'di nyid du sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar gyis rnam par rol par gyur to/

/de nyid kyi phyir/ bdag nyid chen po 'di'i spangs rtogs nus pa'i yon tan ni 'di tsam mo zhes rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pas kyang mtha' dag par brjod cing tshad gzung bar mi nus na/ ma rig pa'i ling tog can dag gis ni/ lta ga la zhig ste/ slob dpon chen po tsand+ra kirtis nam mkha' med par 'dab chags ldog par mi 'gyur gyi/ /'di ni rang mthu zad pas ldog par 'gyur de bzhin/ /slob ma dang bcas sangs rgyas sras rnams sangs rgyas kyi/ /yon tan mkha' ltar mtha' yas ma brjod ldog par 'gyur/ /zhes seng ge'i nga ro phyogs kun tu sgrog par mdzad pa ltar ro/ /de lta na yang rgyal ba nyid kyi gsung las/ slob dpon yon tan gleng bya yi/ /skyon rnams nam yang ma yin no/ /zhes dang / ji ltar kha mkhan mkhas pa yis/ /til sogs mar khu 'jur ba bzhin/ /bla ma'i yon tan gzhung las bzung / /zhes 'byung ba ltar/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i rdo rje slob dpon gyi yon tan brjod pa shin tu 'os shing / de ltar brjod pa la/ sangs rgyas byang sems gaṅgā'i klung 'gram gyi bye ma snyed la/ bskal pa de snyed du bsnyen bkur ba'i bsod nams las lhag pa'i phan yon yod par yang bshad do/ /don de nyid thugs la bzhag nas/ rje btsun sa skya pa'i nges don bstan pa'i srog shing sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyi bsti gnas gling kha bde ba can gyi zur 'chad rig pa 'dzin pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po ngag dbang dpal ldan pa dang / grub pa'i dbang phyug sangs rgyas dpal gyi zhabs rten seng ge'i khri la mngon par rtsen nas bshad sgrub kyi ring lugs skyong ba rje dkon mchog lhun grub gnyis kyis bdag nyid chen po'i rnam par thar pa ha cang rgyas pa ma yin pa re spro bar mdzad la/ de dag gi rjes su mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i chos tshul rgya mtsho'i klong la rang dbang 'byor pas 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i rnam dpyod kyi mthu grub cing /

chos dang srid kyi 'byor ba mngon par mtho ba'i mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi gtsug gi cod pan du zhabs sen nor bu'i 'phreng ba nye bar bkod pa/ khyab bdag rnam snang chen po dang gnyis su med pa'i 'chi med mgon po/ don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te/ mkhan rin po che mai tri dhya na sa mu dra'i zhal snga nas kyis/ shes bya'i gnas 'di kho na la sbyangs pa'i mkhas pa gzhan gyi blo yul du yang 'char bar dka' ba'i tshig rgyan gser gyi phreng bas mdzes par spud pa'i sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa chen po'i rtogs pa brjod pa ngo mtshar yon tan rin po che 'dus pa'i rgya mtsho zhes don dang mthun pa'i mtshan gyi dge legs sa gsum gyi rna ba bdud rtsir byed pa'i shin tu rgyas shing legs pa 'di mdzad cing / 'di nyid bdag nyid chen po dgung grangs lnga phrag bcu dang nyag ma lngar phebs pa bong bu zhes pa lcags mo yos kyi lo'i 'bras ldan gyi dus ston gsar du shar ba'i ltad mo'i zla ba'i dkar phyogs stong pa dang po'i nyin legs par grub/ de lo yul ljongs 'dir nas la sogs pa'i 'bru rnams dngos gtsang ba'i phogs shin tu chung ba zhig byung yang / mkhan rin po che nyid la chos grwa'i 'dzin skyong gi phyir gsol thang chung ngu zhig yod par/ nyi shu 'gyur yang lhag tsam smin pa sogs sngags 'chang bla ma nyid kyis thun mong gi dngos grub bde blag tu stsal pa'i dge mtshan gsar pa yang mngon sum du mthong ngo / /de nyid kyi tshig tshogs ha cang rgyas pa cung zad 'bri ste/ khro phu nas mkhan rin po che dus zhabs gnyis par grags pa dpal rgyas dbang pos/ gtsug lag lugs brgya'i sgo la rnam dpyod kyi 'jug pa chu mtsho ltar zab pa phyag mdzod rje dbon bsod nams rab brtan pas spring yig lha'i rnga sgras/ mnyam bzhag gi ting nge 'dzin las bskul ba'i ngor/ rtogs brjod ngo mtshar rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs kyi sgra dbyangs bskal bzang dpyid kyi dga' ston zhes bya ba 'tsham zhing 'jebs pa zhig spel bar mdzad do/

/de ltar de dag las dang po gnyis ni bdag nyid chen po'i sku tshe'i stod ring mo zhig nas grub zin pa'i phyir mgo smos pa tsam du gsal/ phyi ma ni rje btsun dam pa 'di dgung bgrang lnga bcu bdun pa rnam rgyal gyi lo bsgrigs par snang yang / bdag nyid chen po dang yul gyis bskal ba'i phyir/ yon tan rin po che 'dus pa'i rgya mtsho las yi ge'i 'phreng ba ring po bskyungs pa tsam ma gtogs don la khyad par chen po ma mchis la/ 'di gnyis su dgung grangs lnga bcu rtsa lnga man gyi mdzad pa rnams gsal bar bzhugs pa yin zhing / lnga bcu rtsa drug man gyi mdzad pa rnams ni sngar phan glegs bur 'khod pa zhig ma mngon no/ /de nyid kyi phyir da ni de phyin chad kyi rnam par thar pa rnams sa khongs su ma bcad par sgro skur dang bral ba'i sgo nas 'jal byed 'di la mdzad pa 'di zhes ldab ldib med par bsnyad par bya'o/ /de yang 'di ltar/ rgyal ba thams cad kyi spyi gzugs/ lung rtogs thams cad kyi 'byung khungs/ 'dus pa thams cad kyi khyu mchog 'gro ba thams cad kyi 'dren pa dam pa dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa'i dbang po 'di nyid dgung gi bgrang gzhi drug gis lhag pa'i bcu phrag lngar phebs pa dga' ba zhes pa chu pho 'brug gi lo/ lha khang chen mo'i khyams stod shar gyi gyang ris sngar 'phros rnams mthar phyin te/ rab tu gnas pa smin rgyas su bsgrubs nas byin rlabs kyi dpal 'bar bar mdzad/ de nas lo de'i dpyid kyi dus ston gsar du shar ba na/ myang stod rtse chen nas bla ma grwa ris dang bcas pas gsol ba btab ste/ dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang chen mo dbu rtse rnying ma'i khyams 'jam dbyangs gzi 'od 'bar ba'i drung du/ thugs sras 'jam pa'i mgon po ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pa'i zhal snga nas lcam sring / don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te mkhan rin po che mai tri dhya na sa mu dra'am/

mtshan gzhan 'jam dbyangs blo ldan pa'i drung / gsol ba 'debs pa po rnams dang / chos grwa lho byang gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po dang bcas pa sogs tshogs pa brgya phrag brgal ba la/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lū nag dril gsum gyi zab gnad thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa/ paṇa chen nā ro ta pas mkha' spyod dbang mo nyid kyi zhal bum las dngos su nos shing / pham mthing pa sku mched las gzhan la ma gnang ba'i slob bshad zab mo/ rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras la mdo sngags kyi gdams pa rgya mtsho lta bu mnga' ba'i snying po'i snying po mchog tu gyur pa/ skal ldan dad 'dun can rnams tshe 'di nyid mkha' spyod nyams dga'i grong du myur bar bgrod pa'i gsang lam/ mchog sgrub pa'i dmar mo skor gsum gyi nang tshan/ rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs dbang bzhi'i tshul du bskur ba'i cho ga zab mos thog mar snod rung bsgrubs/ de nas bskyed pa'i rim pa phag mo mkha' spyod/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa rtsa dbu ma/ lam gyi yan lag pra sen dbab pa/ sman chen po'i bcud len/ gnod sbyin mo dbang du bya ba zhes lam gyi yan lag lnga gsungs pa'i/ dngos gzhi bskyed pa'i rim pa la/ dpal brtse ba chen po kun dga' snying pos/ nyal dang ldang dang bdud rtsi myang / /tshad med bla ma bdag lhar bskyed/ /'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor dang / /dpa' bo dpa' mos byin gyis brlabs/ /ngag bzlas yid bzlas gnyis gcig yin/ /bsam gyis mi khyab rnal 'byor dang / /spyod lam gyi ni rnal 'byor te/ /de ltar rnal 'byor bcu gcig go /zhes don tshan bcu gcig tu gsungs pa dang / rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma yum la sbyar ba sogs sbyor dngos rjes gsum thams cad la/ rje btsun dam pa rang nyid kyis mdzad pa'i/ dal 'byor gru chen mi rtag dran pa yis/ /ba dan dkar pos bskyod pa'i las 'bras kyi/ /blang dor mthun pa'i rlung gis rab bskul nas/

/'jigs rung 'khor ba'i mtsho las sgrol bar mdzod/ /ces sogs lam rim smon lam dang sbyar te/ dpe dang / lung dang / rigs pa dang / man ngag bzhi'i sgo nas chu gter ltar zab cing / kun gsal ltar yangs pa'i gsung bshad shin tu zhib cing mtha' chod pa re mdzad nas/ slob ma rnams kyi ma rtogs pa dang / log par rtog pa dang / the tshom gyi dra ba mtha' dag legs par bcad de gtan la phab/ de ltar nges pa'i shes pa gting tshugs pa na/ mthar a ru ra lag mthil du bzhag pa lta bu'i sems 'dzin gyi dmigs pa lhag par rang gsal zhing 'khyer bde ba re nyams khrid du shin tu smin par stsal cing / de yang bdag nyid chen po 'dis sngon 'gro'i khrid 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs la sogs pa gsungs pa na/ kye ma bdag lta bu rang ngan song du ma lhung na re dga' ste snyam spu zing zhes byed cing / lus zhags pa dam pos bcings pa lta bu'i shin tu gu dog pa'i nyams 'char ba dang / sbyin pa dang tshul khrims la sogs pa'i bsngags pa bsnyad pa na/ zang zing phal pa gzhan lta ci yan lag gi dam pa yang mgo yang gtang na snyam pa dang / bskyed rim gyi rnam pa la sems 'dzin lta bu'i dmigs pa gtad pa na/ 'dug gnas grogs dang bcas pa thams cad kyang lha dang / gzhal yas khang gi rnam par phra lam gyis shar ba snyam byed pa dang / mtshan bcas kyi rdzogs rim tsand+ra li lta bu'i dmigs pa phog pa'i tshe/ lte bar gtum mo'i me lce tsha hur gyis 'bar ba snyam byed pa dang / mtshan med bsam mi khyab lta bu'i lta ba'i ngo sprod gnang ba na/ gdos bcas kyi lus kyang mi dmigs pa nam mkha'i rang bzhin du stong sangs kyis song ba snyam byed pa 'byung zhing / rje nyid kyang / bskyed rim gyi gsung bshad lta bu gnang ba'i tshe phyag chos 'chad sogs kyi phyag rgya sna tshogs mdzad de/ mdun du brkyangs pa dang / g.yon nas g.yas phyogs su bsgyur ba la sogs pa'i sgo nas lha'i phyag mtshan dang /

rgyan la sogs pa rnams kyi tshad dang dbyibs dang kha dog sogs pa sku mdun de ka na phyag gis gzung du yod pa lta bu dang / lta ba'i skabs su phyag mnyam bzhag bcas te thog mar spyan 'bras nyi zla 'dra bar khra khor khor g.yo zhing / slar shangs kyi rtser zim bur gzigs te cung zad re mnyam par 'jog par mdzad la/ zhal nas kyang kho bo la tshogs pa lta bu'i nang du yang / de dag kun la ltos pa med par brjod bral gyi nyams cung zad 'char gyin 'dug de mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes kyi ming gdags rung tsam yin pa 'dra zhes gsungs skad/ bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid zab mo de dag gi rgyab rten du/ rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub dkyil 'gro kun mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i myur lam/ lam gyi cha lag 'pho ba'i yi ge mus chen 'khor lo sdom pa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i bskyed rim gyi rnam bshad/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho'i gsung la rje mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis zin bris mdzad pa'i khrid yig sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen/ kun mkhyen bstan pa'i nyi ma bsod nams seng ge ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po rnams kyis mdzad pa'i rje btsun ma'i sgrub thabs/ dpal ldan grub pa'i khyu mchog grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i rtsa dbu ma'i khrid/ rje btsun brtse ba chen po kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa'i rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi sdom/ grub chen nā ro ta pas mdzad pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs sogs lugs 'di la tshad mar gyur pa'i rgya bod kyi bstan bcos rab tu mang po zhig gi lung stsal cing / de'i dus gsung las/ sgrub thabs gzhan phal cher las rje btsun ma 'di la thod skam gyi do shal bshad kyang / kun mkhyen rin po che nas rlon pa'i do shal bshad pa 'di thabs mtshon byed yin pas/ kho bos kyang sngags thang chen mo'i mkha' spyod ma'i sku 'di la 'di bzhin bri ba'i bkod pa byas pa gsungs/

de dag ni bod gzhung rgya gzhung dang 'brel ba zhes pa de yin la/ rgya gzhung rgyud dang 'brel dgos pa yin gsungs nas/ slar yang de thams cad kyi rgyab rten du/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rje sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po'i gsung la/ de nyid kyi sras kyi thu bo gnyan phul chung ba gtsug tor rgyal pos zin bris su btab pa'i rnam bshad mu tig gi 'phreng ba dang / badzra dharma rang nyid kyis mdzad pa'i dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi don 'grel khob phub legs par bshad pa bde mchog rgyud bshad bstan pa rgyas pa'i nyin byed kyi steng nas/ rtsa rgyud bsdus pa le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa'i lung bshad rgyas shing mtha' chod pa stsal te/ de yang bzhi thog bla brang gi ltag sgo nas/ dbu rtse chen mo'i bar la chos nyan pa rnams gral gyi 'phreng ba bar thag snyoms par khrig gis bsgrigs/ de nas bdag nyid chen po nyid sku 'khor la las steng nas thur ma brgya pa'i grib bsil phub/ la las dbyibs dod cing mdangs bkra la dar gos bzang po'i na bzas bklubs pa'i phyag dpe'i glegs bu rab tu phangs pa 'dra ba dag gus par khyer/ 'ga' res mthong ba tsam gyis ya mtshan skyes pa'i phyag 'khar sogs bzung ste/ spos kyi glang po dregs pa dang bral ba gnyis 'thung gi tshogs bcas nags su rgyu ba ltar dul zhing brjid pa'i sgo nas chos nyan rnams la phyag dbang gnang bzhin pas dal bur phebs te/ bla brang shar gyi sgo mdun 'dir sku phyag 'khar la brten te cung zad bsti bar mdzad/ der skabs sos ka'i dus la bab pas/ sa gzhi rnams ni snum zhing 'jam/ mtha' skor rnams ni khrims gtsang gser gyi rgyal mtshan/ ngur smrig gi lhab lhub g.yo ba'i bshes gnyen rje mang pos nye bar brgyan pa'i snang tshul rmad du byung ba de mthong ba na dga' bdes myos pa'i yid la 'di lta bu'i bkod pa ri mor 'khod na ma 'ongs pa'i skye 'gro rnams dad pa dbang med du skye ba 'dug snyam pa yang shar/

de nas rim gyis khri steng du phebs te legs par rtsen zin pa dang / chos nyan pa rnams gul le 'dus te yig brgya nyer gcig tsam re 'dren/ de nas slob ma rnams kyis maṇḍal 'bul zhing / de'i ring la rje nyid kyis chos gtor bsngo bar mdzad/ de rnams zin pa dang chos nyan pa'i dmigs pa thun mong ma yin pa gsal 'debs pa la dmigs pas mtshams sbyar te/ thog mar spyir yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i chos kyi phung po'i rnam gzhag de thams cad bsdu na rgyu 'bras kyi sde snod rin po che rnam pa gnyis su 'dus tshul/ 'bras bu sngags kyi sde snod la yang rgyud de gnyis dang / gsum la sogs pa rnam gzhag grub pa'i slob dpon so sos bzhed pa mi 'dra ba yod tshul/ de dag las rang re sa skya pa'i rje btsun gong ma rnams skabs 'dir/ grub chen la ba'i na bza' can la sogs pas/ ji srid mdo bya spyod pa dang / /rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i dbye ba yi/ /zhes sogs 'di nyid kyi rtsa rgyud le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas/ mdo sde rtog pa'i rgyud/ bya ba spyod pa/ rnal 'byor/ rnal 'byor gsang ba/ gsang ba mtha'i rgyud sde sgo drug tu mdzad pa 'di nyid gtso bor bzhed pa yin tshul/ de dag gi nang nas rgyud 'di nyid ston pa sprul pa'i sku dpal khrag 'thung gi lha tshogs rnams da lta yang 'dzam bu'i gling gi yul nyer bzhi na mngon sum du bzhugs pa dang / bskyed rim gyi skabs su pho nya gsum bsre ba dang / rdzogs rim dpyid dang thig le'i man ngag zab mo sogs rgyud sde gzhan las ma gsungs pa'i zab khyad du mas sgo drug par 'jog pa'i tshul/ rgyud gsung ba po'i ston pa byon tshul/ byon nas rgyud gsungs tshul/ de nyid bsdu pa pos ji ltar bsdus tshul sogs kyi sgo nas/ zab khyad kyi rgyud 'di ji ltar byung tshul/ spyir bde mchog la/ ma rgyud sangs rgyas ma'i sbyor/

spyi ltar bshad pa/ 'dus pa sdom 'byung / 'phags pa lugs ltar bshad pa/ dus kyi 'khor lo mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho/ ltar bshad pa/ gsang ba mthar thug ltar bshad pa ste bzhi las/ phyi ma 'di la rtsa rgyud ni rgyas pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa dang / bsdus pa le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa 'di yin zhing / bshad rgyud ni/ slob dpon dkar rgyal zla bas/ 'byung dang mkha' 'gro kun spyod dang / /kha sbyor rgyud dang bla ma ste/ bshad rgyud rnam pa lngar nges so/ /zhes gsungs pa 'dis bshad rgyud dgu bstan par bu ston rin po che bzhed pa la/ lngar nges zhes pa la sogs pa'i lung rigs mang pos dgag sgrub kyi tshig nyams cung zad dang / rang lugs gsang mthar bshad pa'i lugs la/ smin byed dbang dang / grol byed mngal sgong gnyis kyi mngon rtogs ston pa'i bshad rgyud lngar nges pa'i sgrub byed sogs kyi sgo nas/ bde mchog spyi dang khyad par gsang mtha' la rtsa bshad bzhugs tshul dang / de la rgya bod du bshad srol ji ltar byung tshul/ srol 'byed bla ma rnams kyis rgyud don mngon rtogs su bsdebs nas nyams su bstar ba la sogs brjod bya zab cing rgya che la rtogs sla ba rjod byed kyi tshig gtsang zhing 'gag 'dril la rna bar snyan pa'i legs bshad kyi dga' ston nyin re bzhin bstsal kyang / zlos 'khrul dang lhag chad kyi tshig 'bru gcig kyang mi 'ong bas/ e ma 'di lta bu'i 'chad tshul nges par 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi thugs mtsho las brtol ba ma gtogs/ bus pa'i shes rab kyis bskal par sbyangs kyang mi shes pa 'dug snyam pa yang nas yang du 'byung / de ltar spyir bshad nas bye brag gzhung gi don la sbyor ba na/ rgyud 'di'i le'u dang pos mdor bstan/ bar pa zhe dgus rgyas par bshad/ tha ma lnga bcu rtsa gcig pas thams cad kyi don bsdus te bstan zhes sogs don gyi khog phub/ le'u dang po ri bo tshang tshing ri sul lam zhes sogs dkyil 'khor bri ba'i gnas bstan nas/

bri tshul ji ltar yin na de ston pa la/ de la ci ba ma lhung bas zhes sogs le'u gnyis pa gsungs/ de ltar dkyil 'khor bris nas dbang bskur ba'i tshul ni/ de nas sgrub pos dngos kun gyis/ /zhes sogs le'u gsum pa 'dis ston zhes bya ba la sogs pas 'grel gyi mtshams sbyar ba sogs gzhung don lam pa re skam bshad du mdzad/ de nas dngos gzhi rang nyid kyis mdzad pa'i don 'grel gzhung dang bcas pa bklags lung du stsal te/ dka' gnas rnams la mchan bu sogs kyi steng nas zhib sed rgyas pa re gnang / rtsa rgyud kyi mchan/ mu tig 'phreng ba/ nag 'bum gyi mchan sna thung ba/ rim gnyis lam slong gi mchan rnams rje btsun rtse mo zhabs kyis btab par bdag gi bla ma mus pa chen po gsung gsungs shing / gzhan yang der skabs/ sa chen yab sras/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang / kun mkhyen chen po/ glo bo mkhan chen pa sogs bla ma gong ma rnams kyis rgyud bshad mdzad tshul rgyas par gsungs nas/ bdag rang gis kyang skye ba snga ma'i las 'phro cung zad bzang ba yod 'dug pas/ gzhon nu nyid nas chos la don gnyer chen po rang byas/ de'i stobs kyi thob rgya yang mi chung tsam byung / lhag par 'khor lo bde mchog gi chos skor 'di rnams rgyal ba mus pa chen po la nyan dus zin thun bskyar chos kho na rgyun du byas pas/ da lta 'chad sgom gang byed kyang the tshom mi za ba yod/ deng sang ni bstan pa nyams ches pas/ nyo tshong dang / zhing las sogs 'jig rten gyi bya ba kho na lhur byed pa ma gtogs/ chos la don gnyer byed mkhan re re tsam yang mi rnyed pa'i tshod du 'dug cung zad chos la gzhol ba rnams kyang rgyud bshad zer ba byas na a tsi ba gcig yin snyam snying dngangs nas 'gro yi 'dug ste/ spyir rgyud bshad lugs la rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum las/ rgyud kyi tshig rigs mtha' dag ṭīkka sa bcad sogs dang sbyar te 'bru re re nas zhib tu 'chad pa ni rab/

sa gzhung tsam sbyar ba khog phub kyi bshad pa 'di lta bu'am/ rgyud kyi lung sngon la byas nas/ sa bcad dang gzhung gi tshig zur tsam sbyar ba zin thun du byed pa ni 'bring / tha ma gzhung la sa bcad sbyar ba bklag lung du byas te/ gal che ba rnams la mchan bus bshad pa tsam byas pas kyang rgyud kyi bshad bka' thob par 'gyur ba yin te/ rje sa skya pa chen pos/ rgyud kyi don rnams ni mchan du legs par btab la zhes dang / bshad pa mang po ni gsang sngags dam tshig gi rgyud yin pas 'chol bar 'gyur la zhes dang / bu ston gyis kun mkhyen 'phags 'od la 'dus pa'i rgyud gsan dus/ 'phags 'od kyi gsung las/ khyed lta bu la rgya ba'i rgya lugs dang / gar pa'i gar lugs nas dgos pa'i lugs min/ gzhung dang 'grel pa tsho shar re bklag la skabs skabs su 'gag re tsam bshad de chos thob che bar byed pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs 'dug pa yin/ gang ltar yang rgyud dbu zhabs yongs rdzogs kyi lung dang / de'i 'grel pa tshad thub cig gi lung rgyun bla ma brgyud pa bar ma chad pa las 'ongs pa cig ni nges par thob dgos/ de bzhin du khrid la yang / dper na lam 'bras kyi nyams khrid tshang la ma nor ba zhig thob nas/ lam skor phyi ma brgyad lung khrid du byas pas chog pa rang re sa skya pa'i phyag len la bzhugs pa sogs bshad lugs rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum mdo don 'di nyid rang srol rma med par gzigs nas/ grub chen nag po spyod pa'i rnam sprul rje grol mchog zhabs kyi khrid brgya sgrig pa'i rgyab rten du yang mdzad pa yin/ des na rgyud 'chad lugs rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi rnam dbye 'di bzhin phyed pa gal che zhing / de ltar phyed na de tsam gyi skrag pa byed mi dgos/ zhes sogs shin tu gces shing yid la 'bab pa'i zhal gdams bdud rtsi'i chu gter mang po chal chil du khol ba na/ der 'dus kyi skal ldan mgrin sngon can dag rnam dpyod kyi dbang po che cher brtas te/

rje nyid kyi zhal dkyil nam mkha'i gling la dad pa'i 'dren byed ngoms pa med par btod cing / gsung zer sprin gyi me tog la gcig tu 'dun pa'i sgo nas dga' ba'i mjug sgro zlum por bskor te/ bsam sgom thos pa'i gar stabs ci yang brel bar gyur to/ /de lta bu'i sgo nas rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i bskyed rdzogs kyi gdams pa zab mo rgyab chos kyi lung dang bcas pa ma tshang ba med pa legs par stsal pas/ de dus kyi chos nyan phal cher mkha' 'gro'i dbang mo 'di'i rim gnyis kyi nyams bzhes la dus rtag tu gzhol bar gyur cing / stan thog gcig tu nye snying 'bru 'bum bzla ba la sogs pa grangs dus mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa mthar bskyal ba dang / lo tshigs mang por mtshams kyi bcad rgya la 'jug pa yang mang du byung bas/ zhi ba'i sgo 'phar brgya phrag dus gcig tu dbye bar mdzad pa yin no/ /mkha' spyod dga' ma'i zab lam rdo rje glu/ /rgyud bshad tambu ra dang lhan cig snyan/ /skal bzang rnam dpyod a mra'i dog pa dang / /mnyam du dad pa'i pad mtsho rgyas par gyur/ /lhan cig brjod pa'i rgyan no/ /de lta bu'i chos kyi 'khor lo dang bar ma chod par jo bo bka' gdams pa nas brgyud pa'i myur sgrol dpal mo nyer gcig gi rjes gnang / bstod pa la sogs pa'i lung dang bcas pa dang / rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug lū hi pa dang / ḍeāṃ ki pa la sogs pa'i grub thob brgyad cu'i rjes gnang / de dag gi rtogs brjod paṇḍi ta nyi ma 'od zer gyis phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa 'grel bcas/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i rjes gnang gi yi ge de dag gi rnam thar/ lo rgyus/ bla ma rdo rje gdan pas bstod pa la sogs pa 'di skor gyi lung yongs su rdzogs pa stsal cing / der skabs rje nyid kyis grub chen brgyad cu'i sgrub thabs thus shing zlum la byin rlabs kyi dpal 'bar ba zhig mdzad de/

thub bstan lha chen gyi gling tshang so so'i bla mchod sogs kyi thog 'dzugs ja bzang po dang bcas pa legs par btsugs te/ de nyid kyi lung yang gnang / de dag dang 'brel chags su 'jam dbyangs gzhon nu ngur smrig gi bla gos 'chang ba chos kyi rje sa skya paṇḍi ta chen po'i chos dang de min rnam par 'byed pa sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu byed pa'i bstan bcos las/ 'on kyang bya ba'i rgyud du ni/ /bris sku lha ru bsgoms nas kyang / /de la dngos grub lon pa yin/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa dang sbyar te/ rgyud sde bzhi la smin byed dbang gi rim pa/ grol byed lha'i bskyed chog sgrub pa po rten gyi gang zag sogs mi 'dra ba'i khyad par yod tshul/ bye brag gdul bya mchog rjes su gzung ba'i don du gsungs pa rnal 'byor rgyud la/ dam ye bsres nas slar yang ye shes pa/ /gshegs par 'dod pa rnal 'byor rgyud kyi lugs/ /zhes pa ltar/ bdag nyid lhar bskyed pa la ye shes kyi 'khor lo dgug gzhug byas te dam ye dbyer med du bsres/ phyag rgya bkrol nas ye shes pa gshegs te/ rang nyid dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis gnas/ des na rab dbye las/ de nas rang nyid tha mal 'gyur zhes pa yang / rang nyid dam tshig sems dpa' chig rkyang du gnas pa la 'chad pa yin/ de nyid ston pa'i rgyud la slob dpon padma lcags kyus/ rtsa rgyud shin tu zab cing rtogs dka'i don/ /bshad dang cha mthun rgyud kyis rnam dbye bas/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rtsa bshad cha mthun gyi rgyud gsum du yod pa las/ rtsa rgyud ni de nyid bsdus pa ste/ 'di la dum bu bzhi yod pa'i dang pos gtso bor gti mug dang lus kyi dri ma sbyang ba'i slad du rnal 'byor dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor shin tu rgyas pa zhig ston la/ spyir rnal 'byor dbyings la sambu ṭa rdor dbyings dang / yo ga rdor dbyings gnyis las 'di phyi ma yin/ dum bu gnyis las ni ngag dang 'dod chags kyi dri ma sbyong ba'i ched du khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi lam 'jig rten gsum rgyal gyi dkyil 'khor ston/

dum bu gsum par ni phyag rdor 'gro 'dul gyi dbang gsungs shing / 'gro 'dul la spyan ras gzigs 'gro 'dul dang / phyag rdor 'gro 'dul gnyis yod pa'i dang po ni/ lha gtso bo zhal bcu gcig pa la 'khor mang pos bskor ba/ dbang gi mtshams su slob ma rnams kyi ming byang bum par bcug nas/ gang sngon la 'tshang rgya ba de'i ming byang thog mar 'byung bar dmod pa zhig snang / dum bu bzhi pas ni/ nga rgyal dang ser sna'i gnyen por don thams cad grub pa'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor shin tu che ba zhig bstan/ brjod bya de dag dang ldan pa'i rgyud 'di nyid ston pa sangs rgyas pa'i tshul bstan nas zhag bdun lon pa'i tshe 'og min du dum bu dang po gsungs/ de nas sum bcu rtsa gsum du rgyud phyi ma rnams gsungs/ de nas lcang lo can du rgyud nye bar bsdus pa gsungs pas lha gnas gsum par yang grags pa'i rgyud yin/ gnyis pa bshad rgyud la dum bu dang po'i bshad rgyud thams cad gsang ba/ dum bu gnyis pa'i bshad rgyud khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi rtog pa ste bshad rgyud so so ba dang / rdo rje rtse mo'am/ badzra she ṣa ra'am/ rgya cher rol pa zhes bya ba'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs gsum dang ldan pa de thun mong gi bshad rgyud yin/ gsum pa cha mthun gyi rgyud ni dpal mchog dang po dang / dpal mchog sher phyin gyi skor lta bu ste 'di gnyis la sngags dum dang / sher dum zhes kyang bya/ der ma zad ngan song sbyong rgyud/ rnam snang sgyu dra/ rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud la sogs pa mang du yod/ gtsug tor dgu pa zhes bya ba 'di 'ga' zhig rgyud du 'dod kyang / mjug gi tshigs bcad du kun snying dang / 'jigs med sbas pa'i man ngag la brten nas brtsams tshul yod/ bu ston rin po ches bstan bcos su bzhed pa nyid legs so/ /de dag gi nang nas ngan song sbyong ba'i rgyud chung 'di ni/ snga rabs kyi mkhas pa rnams kyi gsung bgros las/

rgyud chung gcig la brtag pa gnyis/ /brtag pa gnyis la ston pa gsum zhes 'byung ba ltar/ brtag pa gnyis la shlau ka stong yod pa'i brtag pa gong ma ston pa shākya'i dbang pos/ lha'i bu nor bu dri ma med pa mnar med du skyes nas zhag bdun pa'i tshe sum cu rtsa gsum gyi dga' ba'i tshal du gsungs te 'dis brjod bya kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor bstan la/ brtag pa phyi ma nas dkyil 'khor bcu gcig bshad pa'i shākya thub pa sku'i dkyil 'khor/ tshe dpag med gsung gi dkyil 'khor/ phyag rdor 'chi 'joms thugs kyi dkyil 'khor/ 'khor los bsgyur ba yon tan gyi dkyil 'khor/ me ltar 'bar ba 'phrin las kyi dkyil 'khor te/ 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor drug dang / gtso bo phyag na rdo rje la phyogs skyong bcus bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor/ rgyal chen bzhis bskor ba/ lha chen brgyad kyis bskor ba/ klu chen brgyad kyis bskor ba/ gza' brgyad rgyu skar dang bcas pas bskor ba/ 'jigs byed dgu srin po dang bcas pas bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor te 'jig rten pa'i dkyil 'khor drug la sbyong rgyud dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis zhes grags shing / 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor bar ma bzhi ni ston pa'i 'khor gyi gtso bo phyag na rdo rje zhi bas gsungs/ me ltar 'bar ba dang / lo ka ba'i dkyil 'khor drug ni de nyid drag por bzhengs pa khro bo 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal bas gsungs te ston pa gsum po de yang ngo bo gcig la ldog pa tha dad tsam yin/ gzhan yang ro sreg dang / las bzhi'i sbyin sreg gnyis la yang dkyil 'khor gyi tha snyad btags nas dkyil 'khor bcu bzhi dang / dbang bskur te sdig pa sbyang ba la sogs te sdig pa sbyang ba'i sgo bdun nam dgu dang bcas pa ni rgyud 'di'i brjod bya'i gtso bor bzhugs/ rgyud 'di rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du tshig la mkhas pa shākya bshes gnyen/ don la mkhas pa sangs rgyas gsang ba/

tshig don gnyis ka la mkhas pa kun dga' snying po ste mkhas pa mi gsum la sogs pas gsal bar mdzad cing / bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir bstan pa snga dar gyi dus lo tsā ba chen po dza ya rakṣi dang / rin chen mchog la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab kyang lam srol gang gi khongs su bsdu dpyad dka' bar snang / phyi dar gyi tshe lo tsā ba chen po rin chen bzang pos sangs rgyas zhi ba la gsan pa'i yo ga smad lugs dang / dharma pā la la gsan pa'i stod lugs gnyis/ jo bo rje nas rtsa skya pa sogs la brgyud pa ste 'phags yul nas brgyud pa'i srol chen po gsum byung zhing / rang re sa skya pa la lugs dang po gnyis ka'i bka' bab kyang / phyag len phyi ma mdzad pa yin zhes bya ba la sogs pa/ blo gros zhan pa rnams ni bzung bde zhing go sla ba brda' chad rags pa dag gi them skas las kyang mkhas pa'i go sar bkri ba dang / blo chen rnams la zab cing yangs pa mtha' chod pa ste/ mdor na gdul bya'i bsam pa dang mthun pa'i legs par bshad pa'i dga' ston rgya chen po sngon du 'gro bas/ bdag nyid chen po nyid kyis mdzad pa'i don 'grel khog phub sbyong rgyud bstan pa rgyas pa'i nyin byed kyi steng nas/ dpal ldan ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po'i bshad lung zhib cing rgyas pa'i bka' drin dang / mus chen sems dpa' chen pos mdzad pa'i rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga kun mkhyen bstan pa'i nyi ma bsod nams seng ges mdzad pa'i rgyud kyi 'grel pa gzhan phan kun khyab dang / dpal ldan grags pa'i thugs kyi rgya mtsho las gangs can gyi blo mun 'joms byed du 'ongs pa'i gzhan phan rnam gsum nyin byed dbang po'i gzi byin la co 'dri bas lung rigs ltar snang gi sprin tshogs rnams rmeg med du 'thor bar byed pa gzhan phan gnod 'joms kyi lung rnams stsal cing / yang dus der gcod nam mkha' sgo 'byed kyi byin rlabs/

sems dpa' chen pos mdzad pa'i khrid yig thog nas gcod do lugs kyi lung khrid/ rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i gdan thog gcig tu nyams su len tshul ma rig mun sel gyi lung dang bcas pa legs par gnang bas/ byin rlabs kyi tshe mkhan rin po che nyid la lta ba'i nyams myong khyad par can 'khrungs te/ sku lus kyi tshod gzung mi thub pa lta bu byung ba bdag nyid chen po'i drung du zhu bar mdzad 'dug cing / phyis nas kyang nam mkha' sgo 'byed kyi byin rlabs de khyad par du 'phags pa rang zhig yod ces yang yang gsungs so/ /gzhan yang der skabs ltung gshags sher snying / mus chen sems dpa' chen po'i bka' 'bum/ kun mkhyen rin po che'i sngags 'bum/ sa lo chen po'i bka' 'bum/ rje nyid kyis sgrig par mdzad pa'i sngags 'chang bstan pa'i nyin byed ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen dang / de nyid kyi thugs sras dam pa yab rje sbas pa'i sangs rgyas sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan can gnyis kyi sngags 'bum/ rje btsun bla ma rang nyid kyis mdzad pa'i kun mkhyen chen po'i rnam thar rgyas bsdus/ mkhan chen mkhas pa'i dbang po de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rje nyid kyi rnam par thar pa ngo mtshar yon tan rin po che 'dus pa'i rgya mtsho la sogs pa mdo rgyud bstan bcos rab tu mang po zhig gi ljags lung shin tu dag cing snyan pa'i gsung gis gsal bar stsal te/ bsod nams kyi nor can bgrang ba las 'das pa'i blo gros kyi yol go mang du thos pa'i zil mngar gyis phyur por gtams par mdzad pa yin no/ /de dag gi gong skabs shig gi tho rangs mtshan lam du/ rje nyid bde mchog pho brang du phebs nas/ de na bzhugs pa'i dkar po rnam gsum gyi sku brnyan de rnams la gus pa'i sgo nas legs par gzigs pas/ de rnams zhal 'dzum 'dzum mdzad cing / phyag brkyang bskum dang / sku yang bsgul bskyod sna tshogs mdzad pa snyam byed/ de nas thugs dad pa cher g.yos nas/

khyed kyis mi mkhyen pa'am mi gzigs pa ci yang ma mchis pas/ bdag gis tshe ji tsam thub dang phyi ma gar skye ba'i lung bstan gsal bar stsal du gsol/ zhes zhu bar mdzad pa na/ dbus kyi sa chen gyi sku de da lta'i bde mchog pho brang gi sku brnyan gsar pa de yin pa'i sku 'dra rnying ma mi tshad tsam zhig tu gyur nas/ sku g.yas 'og tu bcug ste gzim stabs log ge ba'i ngang nas/ rje nyid la gsang gros kyi tshul du/ tshe 'di 'jal byed gser ris 'khyud pa'i 'byung ba nyis bsgyur du thub bo/ /zhes gsal bar gsungs shing / phyi ma rig pa 'dzin pa grub bo/ /zhes gsung ba snyam byed pa na mnal sad pas/ bag chags sam lung bstan gang yin yang rmi lam ya mtshan che dgongs/ bsnyel tho yang 'debs par mdzad la/ 'di lta bu'i lung bstan khyad par can brnyes pa'i tshul mang du snang ba las thun mong du bsnyad 'os pa rnams ni rang rang gi thad sor ji ltar 'tshams par bri bar bya'o/ /lo de'i dbyar thog thub bstan yangs pa can gyi khra mo'i slob dpon chos rje lha dbang mtha' yas pa dang / dpal byang stod ngam ring gi dkar gung slob dpon sogs gzhi byes kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen du ma zhig la/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid dang / dpal rdo rje gur gyi mgon po'i srung 'khor brag rdzong ma'i khrid gnyis so so'i rgyab lung dang bcas pa sogs zab chos mang po zhig gi bka' drin stsol bar mdzad/ de'i ston rdo rje rnon po dge bsnyen mchog gi zol 'chang ba dpal ldan grags pa'i zhabs nyid/ bstan 'gro'i rtsa lag tu zlos te byon pa sngags 'chang bstan pa'i nyi ma ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi gdung rten yid bzhin nor bu'i drung du/ thugs sras 'jam pa'i dbyangs sogs rgyal bstan yongs rdzogs kyi mnga' bdag tu gyur pa'i grub rig mang po/ chos grwa phan tshun gyi blo gsal 'dus tshogs dang bcas pa chos nyan pa brgya phrag tsam la/

dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lū nag dril gsum so so'i dbang rnams rim pa bzhin sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas/ thog mar bde mchog nag po lugs kyi bskyed rim gyi bshad pa shin tu rgyas shing mtha' chod pa sems 'dzin gyi khrid dang bcas pa dang / rdzogs rim nag po rim bzhi dang / dpyid thig gi khrid rnams smin rgyas su gnang nas/ de dag gi rgyab chos lung gi skor la/ rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i bde mchog rgyud 'debs/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos kyi grags pas mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum nyams su len tshul dang / bskyed rim gyi rnam bshad bde chen thigs 'phreng / rje bzang po dpal bas mdzad pa'i nag po bskyed rim gyi rnam bshad chen mo dang / dpyid thig gi khrid yig kun mkhyen chen pos mdzad pa'i rim bzhi'i khrid yig rje sa skya pa chen po'i rim bzhi lam slong / grub chen nag po spyod pa'i rdo rjes spyod pa la rgyu ba'i skabs shig dur khrod tu tshogs kyi 'khor lo mdzad pa/ mi sngon po thod pa can zhig 'ongs nas ngas tshogs dpon byed zer ba la/ slob dpon gyis de ni ma yin te/ nga nyid rnal 'byor pa chen po yin pa'i phyir tshogs dpon ngas byed gsungs pas/ de nyid 'khor lo sdom par gyur te mdun gyi nam mkhar byon nas/ klog mkhan de yang klog mkhan ma yin he ru ka yi rnam 'phrul lo/ /'di ru mchog min dngos grub gzhan grub gzhung rnams rtsom zhig bar dor yang ni sangs rgyas 'grub/ /ces he ru ka'i zhal las dngos su gnang ba thob pa ltar/ rgyud sde sgo drug pa'i ma'i yang ma/ he ru ka'i rigs kyi lha tshogs thams cad kyi ston byed kyi rtsa ba dang / 'chad byed kyi bshad gzhir gyur pa/ rab gsal nyung ngu'i rgyud le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa'i dngos bstan gyi cha dang / bshad rgyud rdo rje mkha' 'gror sbas pa'i gnad rnams ma 'dres par/

grub pa'i dbang phyug dza landha ri ba'i bar gyi bla ma brgyud pa'i man ngag la brten nas mdzad pa sgrub pa'i thabs/ rtsa rgyud dang / he ru ka mngon 'byung la brten nas mdzad pa dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rtsa rgyud du mi gsal ba ma rgyud mtha' dag nas kha bkang ste mdzad pa sbyin sreg gi cho ga ste/ bskyed rim gyi gzhung gsum dang / rdzogs rim la pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis ka'i brjod bya thun mong ma yin pa zab mo gsal ba'i cha gtso bor ston pa gsang ba'i de kho na nyid/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad phyi nang gi mtshon don du brda' don bsre ba o la pa ti/ nang nges pa'i don dpyid dang phag mo zhal sbyor ba ba santa ti la ka dang gsum ste nag po gzhung drug gi lugs rnams legs par stsal cing / gzhung drug po 'di dag ni/ ston pa he ru ka nyid kyis zhal nas gsungs pa'i bka'/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i bka'/ rjes su gnang ba'i bka' gsum ldan du bzhugs zhes klog skya shes rab brtsegs gsungs par grags pa ltar don la yang gnas te/ slob dpon gyis mdzad zer ba yang / 'phags pa dpyid kyi thig le ni sambu ṭa'i brtag pa drug pa nas logs su phyung ba dang / gzhan lnga la mtshams sbyor tsam mdzad pa yin gyi gzhung mo rgyud tshig gtsang ma yin gsungs/ der rjes grub pa'i slob dpon chen po lū hi pa'i lugs kyi bskyed rim gyi bshad pa dang dmigs khrid/ rdzogs rim bsdu ba gsum pa'i khrid/ bzang po dpal bas mdzad pa'i rnam bshad/ lū hi pas mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs/ pradzñā rakṣi tas mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs kyi 'grel pa/ phyi rol mchod pa'i cho ga lag pa'i mchod pa/ gtor ma'i mchod pa ste lū hi pa'i smad lngar grags pa lung dang bcas pa dang / de nyid kyi mtshams nas slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pa'i lugs kyi bskyed rim dang / rdzogs rim rim pa lnga pa'i khrid/ rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i lū dril gnyis kyi sgrub thabs/

lū nag dril gsum ka'i rnam bshad/ bde mchog chos 'byung chen mo/ bzang po dpal bas mdzad pa'i dril bu lugs kyi rnam bshad/ grub chen de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i lus dkyil gyi mngon rtogs/ dkyil chog rim lnga ste dril bu gzhung gsum gyi lung dang bcas pa sogs mdor na 'khor lo bde mchog lugs gsum gyi rgyu lam gyi dbang / bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid/ rgyab rten gyi lung rnams tshang la ma nor bar stsol bar mdzad de/ nyid kyi gsung las/ chos gang la yang / bla mas kyang dbu zhabs bsgrigs nas bshad/ slob mas kyang don gnyer chen pos de bzhin nyan na bstan pa rnal ma gcig 'ong ba yin te/ zhes yang yang gsungs pa de rang nyid kyi phyag bzhes la theb par mdzad pa yin no/ /de dag gi skabs su nam mkha' shin tu dwangs pa la me tog gi char zim rgyun ma chad par babs shing / gsung las kyang / snga mor rje mus pa chen po las nged gnyis kyis 'khor lo bde mchog dril bu lugs kyi dbang nos pa'i tshe/ bar snang 'ja' 'od kyi drwa bas khyab pa la sogs pa'i mtshan ma ngo mtshar can mang du byung / bdag gi bla ma mus pa chen po de spyir mdo sngags mtha' dag la thos bsam phyin ci ma log pa mthar phyin cing / khyad par lugs 'di la bde mchog rlon pa rang yin zhes gsungs pa sogs bsngags brjod dpag tu med pa dang / phyag thugs khar thal mo sbyar te skyabs su mchi zhes gus pa'i tshul ci yang zhig mdzad de/ de lta bu'i sgo nas dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lū nag dril gsum nā ro mkha' spyod dang bcas pa'i zab lam 'dab brgya'i dga' tshal sngon med gsar du phye bas/ thar 'dod sbrang rtse can kun gyi re ba yid bzhin du rdzogs te/ bsam sgom gyi gshog rtsal ci nus su bskyod nas legs bshad kyi mgrin glu dar dir phyogs kun tu sgrog cing / bdag nyid chen po nyid kyang gdan sa chen po 'di chos 'di rnams kyi 'byung khungs rang du snang ba la skabs 'ga' zhig tu yid srub kyi byed pas chos kyi ming tsam yang mi grag pa'i tshod gcig byung 'dug kyang /

bla ma dang chos skyong gi thugs rjes 'di lta bu'i 'chad nyan gegs med grub pa rang re thams cad skal ba bzang / zhes gsungs zhing shin tu dgyes par gyur to/ /gzhan yang de dag dang rgyun chags su grub thob g.ya' bzang pa nas brgyud pa'i gza' srung u pa de sha'i yig lung dang / sa skya pa'i yab chos nor lha dbyug gu ma mched gsum gyi man ngag gi lung / de dag la chang bu 'bul tshul gyi gdams pa rnams stsal cing / de dus sngon bdag gi yongs 'dzin rgyal ba mus pa chen po de nyid bslab sbyangs mdzad pa'i skabs shig 'tsho ba'i rkyen cung zad dkon par byung ba khong rang gi bla ma grub chen chos dbang phyug pa de nyid kyis mkhyen nas/ sku drung du 'bod pa gnang ste 'di nyid kyi man ngag rnams bstsal/ mus pa chen pos kyang thugs nyams su bzhes pas/ de phyin chad 'bad rtsol la ma ltos par phyag rdzas kyi 'byor pa shin tu che ba byung zhing / lhag par bde mchog gsung bsnyen gyi skabs shig rje nyid kyis sgrub g.yog la khyed ci 'dod kyin 'dug gsungs pas/ de na re/ bdag sha mar bzang po 'dra byung na snyam gda' lags zer/ de'i nub rje 'dis sngags bzhi brgya tsam 'dren par mdzad nas nangs par nged la sha mar ster mi zhig khug shog gsungs pas/ sang nyin der khong dpon slob la yon bdag gcig gis sha mar stobs chen 'bul ba byung 'dug des na man ngag 'di 'bras bu 'phral du 'byin pa'i zab khyad can yin zhes/ chos 'di'i che ba'i lo rgyus kyang 'ga' gsung ngo / /de ltar 'khor lo sdom pa la sogs pa'i chos skor de rnams legs par zin 'phral gzhi byes kyi skal ldan mang po zhig la gsung ngag rin po che gzhi lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams pa zab mo cha lag dang bcas pa bka' drin gyis bskyangs par mdzad de/ 'di ni bdag nyid chen po'i gsung ngag tshogs bshad tshar bcu pa yin la/ de dus zab mo bla ma'i lam gyi rnal 'byor chag med nyams su len pa'i dam bca' 'bul ba yang mang du byung ngo /

/don de dag la 'di skad smra ste/ ting 'dzin sngags rgya'i 'od phreng bya ma rtas/ /rgyal kun sras bcas gdod ma'i pho brang nas/ /ngo mtshar ri mo'i rten la dgug gzhug gis/ /'gro 'dir rab dga'i bsod nams mgron chen phabs/ 1 /dad ldan 'dus tshogs kunda'i nags klung du/ /mkha' spyod dga' ma'i zab lam bsil zer 'bum/ /spros pas bsod nams sbrang rtsi'i dog pa ni/ /mthon por bcur pa'i sngon med zla dbang shar/ 2 /gsang mtha'i rtsa rgyud ma la ya yi rlung / /'grel bshad tsandan bsung zhim gyis bgos pas/ /gti mug tsha zer stong gis gdung ba yi/ /don mthun mang po'i snying la sim pa bstabs/ 3 /yo ga'i cha mthun rgyud rgyal gaṅgā'i chab/ /khyod thugs gtsug na zla ba'i ral pa nas/ /blo ldan nor bu'i sa gzhir 'thibs pa na/ /mkhas mang ma dros rgya mtsho gsar du 'khyil/ 4 /brtse chen yab sras 'dzum mdangs sku'i rnam 'phrul/ /'dren byed yul du shar la ngo mtshar ci/ /mgon khyod ring nas rmongs pa'i gnyid sangs kyang / /rmi lam lung bstan brnyes pa 'di ya mtshan/ 5 /yang ni phag mo'i bskyed rdzogs sprin gyi bcud/ /khro bcu'i srung 'khor rdo rje'i zegs mar bcas/ /skal ldan 'dzin mar phabs tshe sbyangs bsgyur mtsho/ /gang zhing bdag lta'i sa 'dzin phye mar bsnyil/ 6 /zla ba'i thod can lugs gsum gdams pa'i nor/ /'dod dgur spungs te ris med gdul bya yi/ /snod bcud da mal dngos dang cig shos kyi/ /snang zhen dbul ba'i 'jigs pa ring du bskrad/ 7 /bdag med mkha' 'gro'i zhal gdams mtho ris klung / /gang gi rnam dpyod dza hu'i ltor bskyil nas/ /'gro blo'i sa 'og skyugs tshe slob ma yi/ /dug can bu rnams sgrib bral thar par song / 8 /de nas sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa chen po 'di nyid dgung gi 'jal byed lnga bcu rtsa bdun du phebs pa rnam rgyal zhes pa chu mo sbrul mo gsar du shar ba na/

mdo khams nas a li chos rje grwa bu slob mang po dang bcas/ 'jam dbyangs bla ma nyid dang / gdan sa chen po mjal bar 'byor/ lha khang chen mor mang ja brgyad tsam bskol zhing / ja dang ras la sogs pa'i gral 'gyed mang po btang / bdag nyid chen por ja gos dar la sogs pa'i 'bul nod rgya chen po bsgrubs zhing shin tu gus par gyur/ rje btsun dam pa 'dis kyang chos dang zang zing gi longs spyod lhug par stsal pas/ de dag gi re ba'i yol go yongs su khengs par gyur to/ /dgun thog der gtsang grom pa rgyang nas mkhas pa chen po mang thos klu sgrub rgya mtsho'i rje dbon/ rin po che mang thos grags pa rnam rgyal/ gdan sa chen po 'dir 'jam pa'i dbyangs sa paṇḍi ta chen po nas brgyud pa'i bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom rgyun zhig nges par dgos rgyur snang ba spel ba'i mkhan po'i 'os rigs su khyed che ba 'dug pas bstan pa soms la myur bar spyon shig ces bka'i spring yig gser gyi shing rtas legs par drangs te/ dpal sa skya pa'i dbu rtse rnying ma'i dri'i gtsang khang mchog tu chos kyi rje nyid kyis mkhan po mdzad de/ dge 'dun grangs tshang bas cho ga rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas/ chos grwa lho byang gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang por/ kha che'i bsod snyoms pa chen po shākya shrī bha dra nas/ 'dzam gling byang phyogs kyi thub pa chen po 'jam mgon sa skya paṇḍi ta la legs par brgyud pa'i yongs su rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa yang dag par 'bogs pa'i mthun pa'i cha rkyen bzang po nye bar sbyar te/ dkar phyogs kyi lha klu sa gsum na gnas pa thams cad dga' ba'i zlos gar la ngom pa med par rtser bcug go /'di ni sa skya paṇḍi ta chen po'i ring lugs la gcig tu dgongs pa'i thugs kyi lhag bsam ston zla ltar dkar ba sku tshe'i 'phreng bar goms pa'i mtshon byed yang dag pa ste/ de yang bdag cag gi yongs su 'dzin pa chen po 'di nyid mkhas dbang na ga dzu nar 'khrungs pa'i tshe/

de nyid ya ga chos sdings kyi slob dpon mdzad skabs/ lo yu dgon par sa paṇa gyi sdom rgyun bzhugs pa'i mkhan rgyud rim par byon pa las/ skabs shig bla ma gcig la sa paṇa gyi sdom rgyun mi bzhugs nas byang nas chos rgyal nam mkha' tshe dbang rdo rjes/ dgon pa der sa paṇa gyi sdom rgyun bzhugs pa de chad du 'phangs pas/ sgrub chen mkhyen pa yangs pa gcig la sdom rgyun de bzhes shig ces bstan pa la gces spras su gnang ba'i bka' stsal cing / khong gis kyang de bzhin mdzad pas/ dgon pa de na sa paṇa gyi sdom rgyun ma chad pa yod pa de gsan nas/ sa paṇa dang de'i bstan pa la gus zhen cher 'khrungs te/ bla ma skyid gshongs pa chen po blo gros rnam rgyal la/ bdag sa paṇa gyi sdom rgyun cig zhu 'dod pas ji ltar legs zhus pas/ skyid gshongs pa'i zhal nas/ sa skya pa'i grwa dgon gang na yang de 'dra yod par mi 'dug lung phu na yod pa'i nges pa brtan po rnyed na/ rang re dpon slob gnyis char de ltar byas pas chog gsung bka'i gnang ba thob ste/ rlom po chu tshan gyi khar lu yu nas chos rje sangs rgyas 'od zer ba la mkhan slob gnyis char zhus nas/ gsang ston med par dge slong bzhi'i dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs/ de dus rje klu sgrub rgya mtshos dge slong gi sdom pa yod bzhin du blangs kyang mi 'chags par/ mdo rtsa ba las/ blangs pa la slar blang ba med pa'i phyir ro zhes pas shes gsungs nas/ sngar mkhan chen bzang bkras pa las thob pa'i tshigs phyi ma dbul chog legs par mdzad de/ 'di ni te por gtsang ba'i phyag len du mngon no/ /de ltar mkhas mchog chen po des/ chos kyi rje sa skya paṇḍi ta chen po'i bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom rgyun de nyid thugs bskyed rmad du byung bas bzhes nas/ dpal mnyan yod byar gshongs dang / grangs chen logs su chos rje 'ga' rong pa dang / 'brug pa'i dbu che chos rje spos skya ba sogs bla ma dang /

blo gsal mang po la rgya cher spel te/ bstan pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i ngur smrig sde/ /bgrang bar mi bzod mkhan bu'i cho ga bgyis/ /'di tsam gyis kyang sa skya paṇḍi ta'i/ /tshul khrims dri yis phyogs kun khyab gyur cig /ces smon lam yang mdzad pa de nyid legs par smin pa'i rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu bla na med pa'o/ /'brug sbrul gnyis kyi lo mtshams der/ dran pa lnga pa'i phru ma snying gi sa gzhi la btab pa'i gdug pa can 'ga' zhig gi byed pas/ mchod yon nas gling kha dgon par bsnyad rtsod cung zad byung bar brten/ mkhan chen rin po che de nyid zla ba dang po'i nang du shar la phebs dgos shar/ de nas bzung ste dbyar smad tsam gyi bar yan mar 'di skor la phebs bzhud mang po rang zhig mdzad dgos byung zhing / der skabs bdag nyid chen po 'di'i 'od gsal gyi gzigs snang la/ mkhan rin po che de nyid chos skyong gi rnam 'phrul mang pos bskor te 'byon pa zhig yang nas yang du byung nas/ ngos kyi rmi lam la mkhan chen rang chos skyong gi rnam sprul mang pos mtha' bskor nas 'byon pa sogs yang yang byung bas/ zhu don yang lod pa rang med tsam yong snyam pa dang / rang re kun 'di phyi kun tu rje btsun gong ma'i thugs rjes mi gtong nges pa'i blo gdeng cung zad byung ba yang dgongs 'tshal zhes pa'i lung bstan gyi bka' shog kyang stsol bar mdzad/ de dus mkhan chen rin po che nyid mchod yon so sor khrab la sogs pa'i go cha/ bu ram la sogs pa'i tang rtse/ rta dang gser zangs la sogs pa'i yo byad gzhan gyi gnang skyes gang la ci dgos pa thams cad 'dod dgur stsal chog pa'i 'di kha'i phyag mdzod kyi 'byor pa ngal gsos po'i mdzod la 'gran pa de la thugs lhag par rangs te/ e ma bdag nyid chen po sku bsod kyi dpal re che/ chu'i thub pa yang skyong bar nus pa'i phyag mdzod 'di 'dra ba bde blag tu rnyed pas mi zad nam mkha'i mdzod la mnga' brnyes/

gzhan du na da lam gyi zhu don 'di yang legs po rang yong dka' bar snang zhes gsungs shing rgyun par yang de rigs kyi gsung du ma 'byon pa sogs phyag mdzod rin po cher thugs kyi dag snang shin tu che bar mdzad/ phyag mdzod nas kyang mkhan chen rin po che nyid la/ lugs gnyis gang gi thad nas kyang thugs kyi 'jug pa gzhan las zab cing yangs la/ rno zhing dkyil che ba/ de nyid phyag thog tu khel ba sogs yon tan gyi khur 'di tsam gyis lci yang / dregs pa med par sku gsung thugs kyi ngal ba brgya phrag khyad du bkums te/ bdag nyid chen po'i bzhed don bsgrub pa la skad cig kyang mi g.yel ba 'di lta bu sa steng na yang dkon zhes sogs bsngags pa mang du brjod de thugs zhen gting nas che ste/ de ltar na dpon slob 'di gnyis ni snyigs dus kyi ngang tshul mi 'dzin par/ rnam par dka' ba'i lhag bsam dang / rmad du byung ba'i spyod pas blo gros dang ldan pa gzhan dag la yang 'di bzhin gyis shig pa'i phan pa'i gdams pa zab mo lhug pa nyid du 'doms pa'o/ /'di yang dper na 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po la rgyal phran gzhan dang thun mong ma yin pa'i longs spyod rin po che sna bdun dang / de dang nye ba bdun la sogs pa so sor yon tan gyi khyad par bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa yod pa rnams kyang rgyal po nyid kyi bsod nams kyi mthu yin pa ltar/ sngags 'chang bla ma chos kyi rje de nyid kyis sku tshe'i 'phreng ba thog ma med pa nas/ phra ma pha rol dbye ba'i phyir/ /nyon mongs can gyi sems kyi tshig /ces gsungs pa'i mi dge ba de las shin tu ldog ste/ sems can mi mthun pa mang po 'dum par mdzad pa'i legs byas kyi 'bras bu mtshon byed du snang ste/ rin chen 'phreng ba las/ phra ma yis ni bshes dang dbye/ /zhes mi dge ba'i las de'i myong ba rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu gsal bar bshad nas/

dge ba dag ni thams cad la/ /'bras bu de ni bzlog ste 'byung / /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de ltar 'jam dbyangs bla ma mthu stobs kyi mnga' bdag 'di nyid kyis bstan srung rgya mtsho rnams bran du bkol te ji ltar bsgo ba'i bka' bzhin de dag gis g.yel ba med par bsgrub pa dang / dge ldan pho brang nas phyag mdzod de yang bdag nyid chen po 'di la gus zhabs zhe nas mi 'dor ba zhig yin snang bas de nyid kyis nye bar len pa'i rgyu byas/ 'jam mgon bla ma'i gsung ngag gser gyi shing rta'i kha lo bsgyur ba mkhan chen rin po che de nyid lugs zung gi sgyu rtsal mtha' dag la thugs shin tu byang bas/ zhu mchid lcags kyi nyag phran rnams gnad du 'phog pa dang / gnang skyes kyang ja gos dar la sogs pa'i zang zing gi dngos spyad 'phangs pa med par stsal bas lhan cig byed pa'i rkyen byas nas/ rtsod pa rnams gzhi med du dengs te mchod yon nas lha sa gzhung dang / gling kha bde ba can gnyis gdam nga phul ba na/ gzhan mang pos lha sa gzhung 'di dgos pa'i 'thad pa mang du zhus kyang / bdag cag gi skyabs mgon dam pa 'di la/ sngon rgyal ba mus pa chen po de nyid kyis/ ma 'ongs pa na gnas tshul 'di bzhin 'byung ba sgrib med du gzigs pa'i lung bstan gnyer gtam gyi tshul du/ zhabs drung gis dgon pa 'di blos ma btang na 'u gnyis la dam tshig gi sel mi 'ong / blos gtang na dam tshig gi sel du 'gro bas thugs blos ma btang zhig ces sogs thugs dkyil nas bzhar ba'i bslab bya nan tan du gnang ba de nyid thugs khong du skad cig kyang bsnyel ba med par bcangs nas/ gling kha dgon pa nyid legs par bzhes te/ 'di ni sngags 'chang bla ma 'di nyid/ bla ma'i bka' las 'da' mi bya/ /zhes sogs kyi dam tshig rnams sku srog pas gces par 'dzin pa'i gtan tshigs rma med pa lags so/ /des na mkhan chen rin po che de nyid 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i lung bstan bzhin bzhed don rnams legs par grub ste yar byon pa na/

de lo char shin tu zhod pas/ lha sa'i skyid chur grags pa de rab tu brug nas kha khyer la shul lam yod pa yang non te/ rje dpon slob rnams phebs shin tu dka' ba byung nas phyag g.yog 'ga' zhig gis nam mkha'i gos can du byas te 'khar ba khyer nas sngon la lam btsal/ de rjes khal ma rnams dang / rje de nyid rim par phebs pa las/ ji zhig na dre'u gcig chu klung de'i steng na phar song ste lhag par zab cing 'jigs su rung ba'i klong gi dkyil na ye yed du 'dug pas/ sku 'khor rnams ni dre'u'i ming nas 'bod pa ma gtogs gzhan ci bya gtol med par lus/ de'i tshe rje de nyid kyis chibs thog de khar dbu btums te/ sngags 'chang bla ma dus gsum sgrib med du gzigs pa 'di nyid kyi mtshan nas brjod bzhin gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab pas/ re zhig nas dre'u de nye zho med par tshur 'khor gyi log byung ba na/ mkhan chen rin po che de nyid bla ma dang chos skyong la shin tu thugs yid ches shing / shes nas kyi dad pa lhag par 'khrungs/ gzhan dag ni rje de nyid la yang mi phyed pa'i dad pa bla na med pa thob par gyur to/ /zhes thos la/ 'di ni mthong chos 'bras bu can gyi las/ /zhing dang bsam pa'i khyad par las/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar te/ sngon lha mi'i ston pa shākya'i dbang po de nyid zhal bzhugs pa'i dus/ tshe dang ldan pa gang po'i jo bo zha nye'i rna rgyan can zhes bya bas/ rgya mtsho chen por zhugs te/ de'i gling phran tsan dan sa mchog gi tshal yod pa zhig tu son nas/ sta re rnon pos de dag bcad de gzings su bcug nas 'khyer bar rtsom pa'i tshe/ nags de'i bdag po gnod sbyin ma rung ba zhig yod pa de rab tu khros nas/ rlung nag drag po mi zad pa dag btang ste/ des tshong pa de rnams sbur ma ltar bskyod pa na/ ded dpon gyis/ rang gi gcung gang po la gsol ba btab ste ra mda' sbran pas/ de ma thag gnas brtan gyi skyes bu stobs dang ldan pas lag pa bskums pa las brkyangs pa tsam du/

'dzam bu'i gling nas mi snang bar byas te/ rgya mtsho chen por don mthun de rnams kyi gru'i rta mgor skyil mo krung bcas te bzhugs pas/ rlung nag chen po de ri rab la phog pa ltar brdungs nas/ gru rdzing de sgul ba tsam yang ma nus so/ /de nas gnod sbyin des gnas brtan gyi zhabs la btugs te/ tsan dan rnams bsnams par gsol bas/ 'phags pa gang pos rgya gar lho phyogs su tsandan gyi gtsug lag khang bzhengs nas/ ston pa 'khor bcas rgyal byed kyi tshal na bzhugs pa dad pas spyan drangs te/ rdzu 'phrul gyis byon pa la phul zhing der ston pas chos bstan nas gdul bya'i skye 'gro grangs med pa bden pa la bkod ces rtogs brjod brgya pa las 'byung ba dang mtshungs pas dpon slob gnyis ka'i shin tu ngo mtshar ba'i rnam par thar pa gzhan dang thun mong du ma gyur pa'o/ /de nas rim bzhin mkhan chen rin po che de nyid gdan sa chen por phebs te/ khrums zla'i dkar phyogs dga' ba dang po'i snga char phur pa'i sgrub mchod pa thams cad kyis/ lha khang chen mo'i yang rtser lha bsang shin tu gzab spros che ba sogs gtang rag gi cho ga mang du bstar bar mdzad do/ /de lo dpyid thog tsam nas bzung sku khams cung zad gzir ba dang / khyad par phyag sor yon pa shin tu ma bde ba'i tshul bstan te/ chos 'chad nyan mang po gnang ma thub cing / phur sgrub chen mo la yang skabs skabs su cho ga'i ring la gzigs rtog mdzad par rib tsam ma gtogs tshogs dbur ma phebs pas/ sa chog nas gtor skyong gi bar thams cad thugs sras 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid kyis rkang bzhes kho na mdzad/ phyag sor gyi bsnyun rnams ni da dung gzhi nas dwangs pa rang zhig mi snang zhing / 'di ni 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis/ res 'ga' snyung bar gshegs pa dang / /gzhan gyi bskur pa sna tshogs dang / /bde dang dgyes pa spyod pa sogs/ /rnam pa sna tshogs ston pa ni/ /sprul pa yin gyi rang rgyun min/

/zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sngags 'chang bla ma 'di nyid ston pa'i 'khor gyi gtso bo mau 'gal gyi bu chen po'i skye ba'i sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i zlos gar du nges par byed pa'i mtshan ma ste/ nyid kyi gsung las/ bsam yas chos skyong chen pos/ nged mau 'gal gyi bu'i skye ba yin pa skad gsungs pa bden na/ mau 'gal gyi bu'i yan lag dang nying lag rnams/ gcer bu dbyug thogs rnams kyis 'dam bu bzhin du bcom nas/ khong rang gi grogs gnas brtan shwa ri'i bus bus pa chung ngu mas rgyab la 'khur ba ltar chos gos kyis g.yogs te khyer nas 'byon dgos pa byung zhing / gzhan yang sku tshe mang por de 'dra ba'i lus 'tsher myong dgos byung 'dug de yang tshe rabs gzhan zhig la/ rang gi pha ma gnyis nyin mo dga' mgur rol ba mthong bas ma dad nas/ yan lag rnams 'dam bu bzhin du 'joms par bya ba khyed lta bu'i pha ma dang mi 'phrad par gyur cig ces pha ma la 'khyar kha byas pa'i 'bras bu yin par bshad/ des na nged kyi sor mo na ba 'di yang las de'i rnam smin gyi lhag mar snang / zhes yang yang gsung ba dngos su thos pas so/ /'di ni don 'di nyid/ rjen par zhal gyi 'ches pa'i bka' lung du snang bas dad ldan dag tsitta'i ga'ur chongs shig de dus kyi skabs shig bdag cag gi skyabs mgon bslu ba med pa 'di nyid kyis/ thugs dam gyi ngang nas lha khang chen mo'i lcags rir zhabs skor la byon pas/ lho nub kyi zur spe'i thad 'dir phebs pa na/ sku mdun gyi nam mkhar 'ja' 'od kyi dra ba rnam par bkra ba'i gur khang du/ ḍā ki'i gtso mo mkha' spyod dga' ma'i 'dzum zhal mngon sum du gzigs pas/ thugs bde stong gi ye shes zag pa med pa'i chang gis nye bar myos te/ sku 'khor rnams la nyams rtogs kyi gsang gtam de nyid 'chos med du bsgrags/ slad nas gzigs snang ngo mtshar can de nyid kyi bkod pa ri mor 'khod pa mdzad de/

tshes bcu mchod pa'i skabs sogs bskyed rim gyi ting nge 'dzin gsal 'debs kyi dmigs rkyen du 'grem par gnang ba 'di yin no/ /de nas 'bras ldan gyi ston gsar pa mngon du gyur pa na/ skabs gsum dbang po mchod sbyin brgya pas yon gyi bdag po byas te/ lha klu mi gsum gyi rin chen sna bco lnga spungs pa la/ mtho ris kyi bzo bo bi shwa karmas sgyu 'phrul gyis bzhengs pa rgyal ba nyid kyis shis pa'i me tog gsar pa jo bo shākya mu ni dang gnyis la mnyam du gtor te/ sa gsum gyi 'gro ba ma lus pa'i gdung sel du/ byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i 'od zer phyogs bcur 'gyed pa por su pra tiṣṭha'i cho ga mdzad pa'i thub pa'i zhal skyin 'od zer 'gyed dang / lung bstan sgrol ma la sogs pa sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sku brnyan ye shes kyi 'khor lo bzhugs nges pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa phyag tu 'byor ba rnams/ mchod pa'i sprin phung dpag tu med pa dang bcas rje nyid kyi gzim chung du tshogs kyi zhing dam par bzhugs pa las/ 'di thams cad gdan sa chen po 'di nyid las gzhan du nam yang 'khyar bar mi 'os pas na 'di rnams phyogs gcig tu bzhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang zur pa zhig ched du gtad nas bzhengs dgos par 'dug snyam pa'i thugs dgongs bzang po rgyun chags su yod pa de phyag thog tu 'gel bar bzhed nas/ de bzhin gyi dril rnga gsang mthor brdung bar mdzad/ de'i tshe ltas mkhan dag na re/ lo 'di nang du mkhar las cung zad byas na yang mi 'dod pa chen po 'ong ngo zer ba byung yang / spyir bdag nyid chen po 'di ni rnam rtog gi ra ba mthon po las ring du brgal ba'i phyir mthun 'jug gi bya ba ci la yang ltos mi dgos mod/ 'on kyang thub pas/ 'tsho byed gzhon nus gsos pas sman utpa la'i rtsa ba bzhes te gsol ba ltar/ bdag cag gi skyobs pa bla na med pa 'di yang 'jig rten pa rnams gzhug pa'i don du 'phral gyi spang bzhes gang la yang zhib len kho na mdzad pa zhig snang yang /

de dus rtog ge pa rnams kyi smra ba la ci snyam du yang ma dgongs par/ mkhar las tsham tshom med par brtsams pa na/ sang las mgo 'dzugs rgyu de nub mtshan lam du/ mi gcig gis gser gyi za ma tog shin tu mdzes shing 'od 'bar ba zhig phul nas/ 'di sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung bzhugs pa'i gtsang khang mdzad du gsol/ /zhes zhu ba zhig byung bas/ 'od gsal las bzhengs pa'i tshe/ rmi lam shin tu bzang / gtsug lag khang nyes skyon med par mthar phyin pa zhig 'ong ba 'dug snyam pa 'khrungs shing / thugs dgyes spro chen pos las kyi dbu btsugs te las mi rnams la yang zhabs drung du bzhugs gral ja chang ston mo dang bcas zhal ta legs par gnang bas/ thams cad gus shing mgu ste las la 'grus ston pas/ phyi'i spen bad nang gi rkyang nul dang bcas pa dgun stod tshun la myur bar grub/ de nas rje nyid dgung grangs lnga bcu rtsa brgyad du phebs pa rgyal ba zhes pa shing pho rta'i lo ba santa'i dus kyi lang tsho dar bar gyur pa na skya ser ris su ma bcad pa'i skye bo grangs med pa zhig la sbyin gtong gi dga' ston rgya chen po zhig kyang stsal/ nang gi zhal ba rnams so zin bstun ka gdung sogs shing brtsegs kyi tshon rtsi dang / ldebs ris kyi bkod pa rnam brtsams ste/ de yang byang ngos kyi steng la thub dbang gnas brtan bcu drug 'khor dang bcas pa dang / rgyan drug mchog gnyis rnams bzhugs shing / rten khri'i rgyab byin la mkha' spyod dbang mo/ rgyal ba mi 'khrugs pa/ 'od dpag med rnams kyi snang brnyan stong phrag la nye ba re/ bar mtshams su bla ma'i sku gzugs mang pos brgyan pa dang / shar phyogs kyi ldebs la rje btsun sa skya pa'i yab chos gsung ngag rin po che'i bla ma brgyud rim/ snang ba mtha' yas kyi zhing mchog bde ba can gyi bkod pa/ de'i steng na rje rdo rje 'chang yab sras gsum 'od khyim du bzhugs pa'i nye skor na/

de bzhin rdzu 'phrul gyis de sems can brgya phrag smin byed cing / /brgya phrag grangs dang rjes 'brel zhing dag tu yang 'gro bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar bdag nyid chen po nyid zhing 'di'i rdo rje'i khri las skad cig kyang ma g.yos bzhin du/ dag zhing gzhan du yang sprul pa 'gyed pa'i mtshon byed sprin 'phreng gi sne la phyag gis bzung ba'i bkod pa dang bcas pa sogs dang / lho phyogs kyi gyang ris la mgon po tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dbang brgyud dang / dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i brgyud pa/ padma ka ra jo 'brom yab sras dang bcas pa dang / chu lha'i phyogs kyi ngos la dpal gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod rdo rje'i chos skor dang / kun rig sa lugs kyi dbang brgyud rnams gtso bor bzhugs pa'i gseb tshags su rje nyid sngags 'chang yab sras/ mus chen rnams dang 'bral med kyi mtshon don mang po/ gzhan yang bde dges gsang gsum tshe lha du ma sogs yi dam dkyil 'khor gur zhal rnam gnyis sogs chos skyong srung ma/ dmar po skor gsum sogs nor sbyin dbang bsdud kyi lha rigs mtha' yas pa dang / gdung ma'i nang ldebs kyi ngos la rgyal dbang 'od dpag med kyi snang brnyan mang po dang / phyi logs la lañtsha'i tshe gzungs gser shog ma 'ba' zhig sked ris la 'chi med dpal mo'i gzungs ring lha yig tu bris pa ngo mtshar ba/ gzhan yang ka ba bre phul/ gzhu ring thung bad 'bur sogs steng logs thams cad tshon sna brgya rtsa gcig gis rnam par bkra zhing / mthong na mi mthun pa med la/ mig dang snying 'phrog pa/ mtho ris kyi them skas su gyur pa 'di nyid/ chu 'dzin gzhon nu'i 'dzum 'phreng rnam par g.yo ba'i mtshams nas/ sa zla'i lcug phran gyi zhags pa ring du 'phen zhing / sprin gyi rnga dbyangs zab mo snyan zhing brjid par bsgrags te/ bdud rtsi'i gru char gsar pa zil bur dal gyis phabs pas/ rgya mtsho'i gos can gyi khyon kun dbang sngon brtsegs pa'i lhun po nyin byed zer mas bzhus pa ltar 'jam zhing mthing kar snang ba/

rtswa ljang myu gu'i tshogs rnams mdog mdzes chen po la sogs pa me tog sna tshogs pa'i khyu dang lhan cig 'jo sgeg gis brtse bas/ gtsang bdag bde dang rtag pa'i ldog phyogs kyi don rnams thos shing bsam ste bsgoms pas srid pa'i phun tshogs thams cad chu zla'i rol gar du shes pa'i skyo ba'i lcags kyu rnon pos/ yid kyi thor to nas ma bzung ba'i skyes phran gzhon nu lang tshos dregs pa dag chog cing tshim pa med par sbrang rtsi'i brtul zhugs can rnams dang mnyam du rtsed mo'i dga' ba la bag yangs su spyod du 'jug pa'i dus kyi rgyal po chen po dbyar zhes bya ba'i 'byor pa rab tu rgyas pa'i tshe shin tu legs par mthar phyin te/ 'di ltar/ rten bzang po dang slob dpon bzang / /gnas bzang po dang dus bzang dang / /yo byad cho ga bzang po'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dpal ldan dgyes mdzad rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga khyad par gyi chos bzang po drug dang ldan pa rgyud sde rin po che nas ji skad bshad pa bzhin/ smin rgyas su mdzad de lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten kun la legs byas kyi dpal phun sum tshogs pa spel zhing dam par bsgrubs so/ /de nas sngar yod kyi rten khyad par can rnams mchod pa'i phung po dpal kun tu bzang po'i rnam 'phrul lta bur bkod pa'i khyad par yid du 'ong ba tshad med pa dang bcas gral gyi 'phreng mdzes tshar du dngar bar mdzad de/ de yang rten gral sde tshan gsum gyi dbus ma'i gtsug tor na/ sngags 'chang bstan pa'i nyin byed ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi gser sku/ dam pa de nyid kyi sku 'dra phyag nas brgya tshar ma sogs byin rlabs kyi gar bu'i nang bzhugs can/ 'jam dbyangs sku mched kyi phyag nas lan gnyis dang / rje nyid kyis phyag nas tshar gsum gnang ba'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dgos 'dod kyi 'byung khungs su gyur pa nyid bzhugs te/

'di ni sngar rig 'dzin lha khang gi gdung rten chen mo'i g.yas rol na bzhugs pa las/ sku tshab tu sngags 'chang de nyid kyi sku brnyan byin rlabs kyi dang rtser gyur pa zhig gsar du bzhengs te der bzhugs su gsol nas 'dir spyan drangs pa yin no/ /de'i g.yas gral gyi mchog ma na grub pa'i khyu mchog dam pa bsod nams dbang po'i zhabs kyi gser sku de nyid kyi phyag nas ma dang / rten gtso'i g.yon dang po na rgyal ba'i yab rje dam pa sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros kyi gser sku de nyid kyi phyag nas ma ste/ de ltar na sngags 'chang yab sras rnam pa gsum lha rdzas kyi khri stan/ na bza'/ rin po che'i 'phreng ba du ma'i sku rgyan sogs bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa dang bcas gtso bor bzhugs pa yin zhing / de nas thog mar bla ma sa skya pa chen po'i nye gnas gnyan gtsug tor rgyal pos bzhengs pa'i sa 'jam zhal sprod la lam 'bras lam skor dang bcas pa'i bla brgyud/ yi dam chos skyong nor lha sogs kyis bskor ba'i bris thang sa chen yab sras gsum ka'i phyag nas bzhugs pa la/ hor dus kyi khyad gos sngon po gser ma'i gong gsham/ zhal kheb lnga sbrags rgyab dar dang bcas pa/ rje nyid kyis gsar du phul ba/ 'di phyag tu phebs pa'i tshe mus srad pa'i dkar chag zhib 'khod dang bstun pas sgra ji bzhin du snang nas shin tu thugs ches pa rang byung gsungs/ grub mchog dbang po'i g.yas na/ rje btsun chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi sman sku phyag nas ma de nyid kyi dngos slob grags pa'i mtha' can bzhi'i nang tshan sa la dbang phyug grags kyis bzhengs pa/ de'i g.yas na 'jam pa'i dbyangs sa paṇḍi ta'i sman sku phyag nas ma/ de nyid kyi gzim g.yog lo bcu gnyis mdzad pa'i sdom phrug sgres pa dpal bzang po bcu gsum gyi nang tshan rin po che skyob pa dpal bzang pos bzhengs pa/ rje bla ma'i phyag tu byon nas ring bsrel gsar du 'khrungs pa'i ngo mtshar can/

'jig rten na ches dkon pa'i mu tig gi phreng bas spud pa'i bzhugs khyim rgya phibs dang bcas pa ste/ 'di'i gzungs gzhug la chos rje pa'i dbu lo bubs dang / gzungs sngags rnams chos rje'i phyag bris kyi lāñtsha dang / wartu 'ba' zhig tu bzhugs tshul zhabs bsdom la dkar chag tu thebs pa las cung zad bris pa rnams yar lung pa seng ge rgyal mtshan gyis gsal du btab pa yin gsungs/ de'i g.yas na 'dzam gling bstan pa'i mnga' bdag chos rgyal 'phags pa'i dngul sku phyag nas ma hor rgyal pos bzhengs pa sku chos snam sbyar dang / bzhugs 'bol thags grub ma/ khri gdan hor bzo khyad 'phags dang bcas pa/ de'i g.yas na yab rje'i sman sku phyag nas brgya tshar ma/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i gser sku phyag nas ma gting skyes chos rgyal rgyal mtshan dpal gyis bzhengs pa/ rgyal ba mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyi sku 'dra phyag nas brgya tshar ma sogs dang / de dag gi sku mdun na sa paṇa gyi hor sku phyag nas ma gcig sogs mang po/ rten star gnyis pa'i dbu na rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi sman sku kun mkhyen rgyal rong pa chen po'i phyag nas ma dkar me 'dzin nges pa/ de'i g.yas phyogs na 'brog mi lo tsā ba sogs du ma dang / rje btsun sems dpa' chen po/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rin/ mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub/ lo chen chos skyong bzang po/ sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen/ mus chen dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ lo chen ratna bha dra/ dpal ldan kun dga' grol mchog rnams kyi sku brnyan rang rang so so'i phyag nas ma sogs/ rten star gsum pa la yab rje chos kyi rgyal pos rgyal yum dam pa bkra shis dpal gyi bu khrid ma'i dgongs rdzogs su bzhengs pa'i zab lam brgyud pa/ rten gral bzhi pa dang lnga pa la 'jam mgon bsod nams dbang po/ sngags 'chang grub pa'i dpa' bo ngag dbang kun rin gyi dgongs pa skong ba'i phyir li khra las bzhengs pa'i rdo rje phur pa'i smin grol gyi brgyud rim dkar bdud gnyis dang bcas pa/

gzung rdzongs la sngags 'chang chen pos sa lo'i dgongs rdzogs su bskrun pa'i rig 'dzin brgyud pa/ zhabs sdoms so sor sa lo chen po'i dgongs pa rdzogs par gyur cig dkar bdud lcam dral rten la brtan par bzhugs su gsol zhes pa'i zhal byang 'byar ma rnams bzhugs pa'i/ sems dpa' gsum brtsegs byin rlabs kyi chu brgya 'bebs pa gtso bo sngags 'chang chen po nyid dang bcas pa/ rten star drug pa la thog mar rje chos dbang phyug dang / mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gnyis kyi sman sku so so'i phyag nas ma bzhugs khyim gcig gi steng 'og tu bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas su grub pa'i slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas kyi phyag nas ma bye ma a krong las grub pa'i nor sbyin dzambha la ste/ 'di ni rten gral rnams sgrig pa'i nyin de kho nar glo bur du byon pas legs tshogs kyi rten 'brel thams cad rang 'grig par gyur to/ /de'i g.yas kyi steng 'og na rje chos dbang pa'i sku brnyan phyag nas ma gnyis/ de'i g.yas na phar rim bzhin bla 'og tu rje grol mchog zhabs dang / mkhas dbang klu sgrub rgya mtsho/ bdag chen tshe nas/ 'phags chen dpal ldan bkra shis/ rje btsun sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan dang / nags dgon sbyin pa grags pa/ grub dbang zhu byas dngos grub dang / kong ston dbang phyug grub pa rnams rang rang gi phyag nas ma sogs ste/ zhu byas kyi sku 'di ba so las grub pa yin no/ /de dag gi g.yas na paṇa chen nags rin gyi ring bsrel bzhugs pa'i rdo rje 'chang sogs yi dam gyi gser sku dang li sku dngos gtsang zhing byin rlabs che ba du ma/ rten star bdun pa la thub pa'i dbang po/ byams pa 'jam dbyangs/ sgrol ma dkar ljang sogs gser li ci rigs byon legs shing byin rlabs kyi zer 'phro ba rab tu mang ba bzhugs so/ /gser sku 'di rnams slar gzim chung du bzhugs nas lha khang 'dir gtso bor bla ma'i sku brnyan grab cig bzhugs par dgongs te/

lam 'bras bla ma brgyud pa'i sman sku rdo rje 'chang nas sngags 'chang yab sras rje mus chen gyi bar gyi rtsa brgyud bla ma yongs rdzogs kyi sku brnyan sngags 'chang bla ma nyid dang rtse gdong nas bdag chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub kyi phyag nas smin rgyas lan 'ga' bzhugs pa'i byin rlabs can de dang / 'di'i gras la rje tshar chen dang mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyi sku gnyis bzhugs pa la snga ma la tshar chen rang nyid kyi zhal mal bub dang / phyi ma la rje ta ra ba bsod nams chos 'phel gyi zhal mal bub ma nyams pa sogs byin rlabs kyi gar bu lugs su bzhugs shing / de nas rten gtso'i g.yon gral bdun gyi dang po sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan can gyi g.yon na rim pa ltar/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ rje btsun grol mchog zhabs gnyis kyi sku so so'i phyag nas ma dang / grub mchog bsod nams dbang po'i sku 'dra phyag nas stong tshar ma/ de nyid kyi tshems gsum sogs nang rdzongs la bzhugs pa'i khyad par can/ de'i g.yon na yab rje sbas pa'i sangs rgyas kyis 'bral spangs mdzad pa'i sngags 'chang chen po'i sku brnyan li khra las grub pa/ de nyid kyi phyag nas brgya tshar ma'i sku 'dra nang du bzhugs pa'i ngo mtshar can/ de'i g.yon na rje nyid kyi dngul gdung rnams kyi bzo phud du bzhengs pa'i rgyal ba mus pa chen po'i dngul sku byin rlabs kyi 'od phung 'bar ba dang / rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal gyi sku phyag nas ma/ de'i g.yon na jo bo chen po dpal ldan a ti sha'i sku 'dra phyag nas ma sngags 'chang chen pos shin tu thugs rtsis che bar mdzad pa dang / grub chen thang stong rgyal po'i sku 'dra de nyid kyi phyag nas ma brgyud 'dzin mang dkar bas bzhengs pa sogs dang / rten star gnyis pa la bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis bzhengs pa'i mgon po'i brgyud pa zhal dkyil la rdul mi chags pa sogs byin rlabs yid ches kyi mtshan ma can bcu dgu dang /

slob dpon padma'i gter sku gzungs rdzongs la bzhugs pa'i gu ru drag dmar gyi sku yab rje'i phyag nas ma/ de dag gi bar mtshams na theg chen chos rje'i thugs dam rten gyi phur pa lha khra'i gtso phur thog thub ma sogs yi dam gyi sku du ma/ rten star gsum pa la 'jam dbyangs mthu stobs dbang phyug gis bzhengs pa'i mgon po brgyud pa'i dngul sku nyi shu rtsa lnga/ rten star bzhi pa la thog mar rdo ring kun spangs chos kyi nyi ma'i thugs dam rten rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi sku 'dra rgyan ma dang / na bza' brag phug pa'i gser sku lo phu ba chos rin gyi phyag nas ma/ de nas yar lung pa seng ge rgyal mtshan gyis bzhengs pa'i bla ma dam pa'i sman sku/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan gyi gser sku/ kun mkhyen bstan pa'i nyi ma bsod nams seng ge'i gser sku rnams rang rang gi phyag nas brgya tshar ma/ de nas paṇa chen byams pa gling pa'i gnyis/ bya btang kun dga' mchog ldan pa'i gcig rje btsun mkhas pa'i dbang po dkon mchog lhun grub kyi sku 'dra gnyis te so so'i phyag nas ma lnga dang / rje nyid kyis bzhengs pa'i yab rje'i sman sku de nyid kyi phyag nas brgya tshar ma sogs/ de nas yol mkhan chen gzhon nu blo gros/ rje 'gyur med bde chen/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags/ sngags 'chang bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs rang nyid/ bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal rnams kyi sku so so'i phyag nas ma/ rten star lnga pa la sa lo chen pos mdo chos gzim phug tu phur ba'i ljags bsnyen gnang dus bzhengs pa'i li khra'i lam zab brgyud pa dang / 'phags pa'i hor sku phyag nas ma sogs/ rten star drug pa la rje nyid kyis bzhengs pa'i gsung ngag tshogs slob gnyis ka'i brgyud pa yongs rdzogs kyi sku brnyan bzhi bcu rtsa gcig rten star bdun pa la rje btsun dam pa chos dbang pa la mkha' 'gros phul ba'i byams pa'i bzhengs sku dzhe kṣim las grub pa gang du bzhugs sar lo legs sogs 'dod dgu'i phun tshogs stsol nges pa dang /
