'phags pa shwa ri'i bus phyag nas mdzad pa'i bdag med ma'i dngul sku mkhas btsun chen po'i thugs dam gyi rten rgya gar ma shin tu ngo mtshar che ba sogs bla ma dang yi dam gyi sku khyad par can mang po/ sde tshan dbus ma la rten star rim pa lnga'i steng gi gtso bor bcom ldan 'das shākya'i dbang po nyid sems can gyi don du rang gi sku brnyan gyi zol du bzhugs pa thub pa 'od zer 'gyed/ de'i g.yas na slob dpon padma'i sku 'dra bye ma a krong las grub pa mnga' bdag nyang gis gter nas spyan drangs pa da lta ring bsrel 'dzag bzhin pa/ de'i g.yas na dus dgra'i dbang po ma he'i zhal can bsil tshal gyi rdo nag las grub pa 'phags yul gyi grub chen mang po'i thugs dam rten/ rwa lo rdo rje grags kyis rgya gar nas spyan drangs pa/ 'od zer 'gyed kyi g.yon na sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung bdag nyid chen po'i phyag tu gsar du byon pa mang po dang / jo bo rje la bod du byon na 'gro don 'phel ba sogs lung bstan mang du stsal pa'i lung bstan sgrol ma/ rten star gnyis pa la nyang ral gyis gter nas spyan drangs pa'i gu ru drag dmar/ sa skya pa chen po'i thugs dam rten la birwa pa'i li sku/ g.yang kri las grub pa'i sa paṇa gyi sku de nyid kyi phyag bzo ma/ slob dpon padmas mnga' bdag gi don du sku chung ngu bzhengs nas rdzu 'phrul bstan pa'i zhabs kyi rjes sogs/ rten star gsum pa la gong ma lnga'i dngul sku grol mchog zhabs dang / klu sgrub rje'i thugs dam phyag nas ma/ g.yas phyogs na bu ston rin po che/ byams chen rab 'byams pa/ grub chen thang stong pa rnams rang rang gi phyag nas can rnams dang / g.yon phyogs na thugs sras lo tsā ba de nyid kyi phyag nas ma dang / chos rje sa paṇa gyi gdung la rang byon du 'khrungs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku sogs/ bzhi pa'i dbus su bzhugs khyim gcig gi steng 'og tu/

'jam dbyangs gzi 'od 'bar ba'i bzo phud las bzhengs pa'i kha che paṇa chen chos rje pa'i phyag bzo ma dpon slob gnyis kyi phyag nas can dang / bu ston rin po che de nyid kyi phyag nas ma/ de'i g.yas kyi steng 'og na chos rgyal 'phags pa'i hor sku dang / glo bo mkhan chen pa'i gser sku/ theg chen chos kyi rgyal po dang / spyan mnga' ngag dbang chos grags/ rje btsun dam pa sangs rgyas dang / sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen/ mus srad pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang / yab rje grags pa'i mtshan can rnams/ g.yon phyogs la/ paṇa chen shākya shri'i rdza sku dang / mus chen dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i sman sku theg chen kun dga' bkra shis dang / rdzong pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ dge bshes kha rag sgom chung dang / to po ba rin chen gsal/ bdag chen blo gros rgyal mtshan dang / ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub rnams kyi sku brnyan so so'i phyag nas ma rnams bzhugs de/ de dag ni rje btsun sa skya pa rang gi bla ma gong ma grub rig dbang po chos kyi spyan ldan rnams kyi sku brnyan/ dpal ldan rtse mo yab sras kyi bris thang sogs so so'i phyag nas thugs dam ma dag gtso bor smos pa yin gyi/ gzhan yang gong ma lnga'i sku/ glo bo ma grol mchog rje'i phyag nas ma sogs mang po/ karma pa zhwa dmar nag gnyis/ grub thob gtsang smyon/ padma dkar po sogs so so'i phyag nas can dang / rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po dpal ha sa badzra sogs mdor na sangs rgyas nas bzung rgya bod kyi mkhas grub bgrang dka' ba zhig dang / rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i sku brnyan byin rlabs kyi gter mdzod/ byin rlabs kyi gar bu/ byin rlabs kyi rgya mtsho tshad med pa zhig bzhugs pa rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i dkar chag na rgyas par gsal zhing / de dag so sor gser dngul la sogs pa'i khri rgyab/ bzhugs khyim/ bla gab tog bcas sogs gang la gang 'tshams pa dang / dar gos bzang po'i bzhugs stan/

snyes 'bol na bza'i phon po dpag tu med pa/ spyan sngar mchod pa'i khyad par la ma na ho'i cog tse la sogs pa stegs bu khyad par can dag gi steng na/ 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i zhabs kyi dbang bum cha/ g.yang kri la sogs pa'i bya ma bum/ margad sogs kyi spos phor dang / spos glang / dngul dkar gyi mchod ung nor bu'i snang gsal gyis brgyan pa/ chos rgyal 'phags pa'i dung chos gsum brtsegs dang / byams pa gling pa'i dung chos nyis brtsegs sogs dri chab kyi skyogs/ yang 'phags pa rin po che'i gu gu sha'i gtor teb bdun tshar mgul rtse dang bcas pa sogs zhal zas kyi snod/ de nyid kyi phyag dril shin kun ma sogs dril bu dang / rgya dril theg chen ma dang dkar dril rtse lnga rtse dgu sogs ngo mtshar can grangs bcu phrag du ma dang / gzhan yang rgya hor gyi sil sbug shub bcas bla ma gong ma'i phyag rol dang gsar du 'phel ba sogs cha lang gi bye brag gzhan gyis 'gran par mi nus pa lnga phrag bzhi lhag tsam dang / shel gyi gaṇḍe dang / ba ri lo tsā ba'i chos dung sogs rol spyad du ma/ gzhan yang me long dang / ḍā ma ru dang / rin po che'i yol go dang / gan dkar khyad 'phags nyin bde ma dang / 'brug bzhi gdong bstan/ seng ge ma sogs grangs mang ba/ gzhan yang hor dkar ljang gu dang mar ser mchin kha'i kha dog 'dzin pa'i khyad 'phags du ma/ 'phags pa rin po che'i gser dam chen mo/ gdung rgyud gong ma na rim gyi shel dam che chung bgrang ba las 'das pa/ sder spyad dang / gzar blug dang / par bu dang / maṇḍal la sogs pa phyi'i 'dod yon gyi mchod rdzas/ mkha' 'gro ma bde ba'i rdo rje'i dbu thod sogs ka pā la du ma dang / rje bla ma nyid kyi bzhengs sku maṇḍal bsnams pa phyi'i mchod pa/ khri'u chung la bzhugs nas a mṛ ta 'bul tshul sogs nang bdud rtsi'i mchod pa/ gsang ba'i mchod pa mtshon byed rje nyid kyis gsar du bzhengs pa'i rig ma bcu bzhi'i snang brnyan/

gzhan yang spyang ki'i rwa dang / dung dkar g.yas 'khyil la sogs pa ngo mtshar rtags dang rdzas kyi cha byad rab tu mang po/ ka khongs gsum gyi gnam rgyan la mtha' ljang kha tshon khras spud pa'i khyad gos bkral rtags ma dang / ding phon sngo khras bskor ba'i hor gos tshon tshogs ma/ hor gos khyad can gling sgrig byas pa'i bla bre ngo mtshar can dang / ka rgyan la gser dang g.yang kri'i phom gyis mdzes pa'i bod yul chen po'i sa skyong yab yum gyi ske rags dang / khyad gos mang po'i 'phan tshar sogs/ phal pa'i shis brjod las 'das pa'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho kun bzang rnam 'phrul gyis phyur bur gtams te/ tshangs pa dang brgya byin yang yid 'phrog par byed na/ gzhan dag ni smos kyang ci dgos/ mtshan la yang bla ma lha khang khyad 'phags zhes don dang mthun par bshad 'jug gnyis ka tshang bar gsol ba yin no/ /de dang 'dabs 'byor bar mnyam du bzhengs pa'i mgon khang khyad par can na/ thog mar rten gyi gtso bo rje btsun sa skya pa la gur gyi mgon po'i sku dang chos kyi bka' bab bzhi bzhugs pa'i/ sku bka' bab kyi nang tshan bram ze mchog sred kyi spur sol las rang byon du 'khrungs pa'i shing mgon yid bzhin nor bu/ pu hrang lo tsā bas bla chen kun dga' snying po la gnang ba dang / ri bo ma la ya'i rtser rang byon du byon pa'i rdo mgon yid bzhin nor bu ba ri lo tsā bas sa chen la stsal pa gnyis/ g.yas g.yon na 'phags pa rin po che'i thugs dam rten gyi mgon po shel spyan mar grags pa dang / 'phags yul gyi paṇa grub mang po'i thugs dam ma'i mgon po kā ma ru'i rdo las grub pa rdo mgon dang shin tu 'dra ba kha che paṇa chen gyis bod du spyan drangs pa sogs dang bcas pa bzhugs shing / bang rim gnyis pa la bdag chen blo gros rgyal mtshan gyi thugs dam ma zhal bzhi pa'i sman sku zhal khra can shin tu gnyan pa/ 'phags pa rin po che'i thugs dam ma'i mgon po gtso 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi shing sku dang /

bsil tshal gyi gor ma las grub pa ste gnyis/ rten rdo zur gsum pa dkar gong gi tshul du rang byon pa'i bram gzugs chos skyong dngos dang khyad par med pa dkar chag gi yig rnying na gsal ba'i yid ches can sogs du ma/ bang rim gsum pa la 'phags pa'i thugs dam rten gur mgon lcam dral 'ju tshe ma zhal dkyil la rdul gyis mi gos pa sogs byin rlabs kyi mtshan ma gsal ba/ de'i g.yas na sngags 'chang bstan pa'i nyi ma ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyis/ dam nyams gdug pa'i dgra bo lha sa rdzong pa'i gshed du bzhengs pa'i mgon po srin zhal mar grags pa lcam dral sha trun myur du brlag pa'i mthu rtsal can dang / gnyan lo dar ma grags kyi thugs dam ma gdong bzhi yongs rdzogs kyi sku gtso 'khor gyi sngags bcas rang 'khrungs su byon pa'i rten rdo smug po phang tshad ma/ g.yon na tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i thugs dam ma gur lcam dral dang bram gzugs rnams/ grangs chen rtse'i mgon khang nas/ bdag nyid chen po'i 'phrin las sgrub par gdan sa chen po 'dir gsar du byon pa sogs dang / de dag gi sku mdun na 'jam mgon dbang po'i zhabs la rje gzhon nu blo gros kyis mgon po'i chos skor rnams dang mnyam du phul ba'i mgon po'i gser sku phra rgyan ma dang / stag zhon hor sku spyan snga kun dga' rdo rje la nga 'dir ma zhogs na lend+rar longs zhes gsung byon pa'i byin rlabs can sogs rten rdo chen mo'i mdun stegs la/ sa chen gyi thugs dam ma'i mgon po bzhengs sku li ma a dhiṣṭha na'i 'od chags 'bar ba dang / 'phags pa rin po che'i thugs dam rten gyi lcags kyi mgon po lcam dral/ byang chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyas pas ba so las bzhengs pa'i dur khrod bdag po/ zhe dgon pa bsod nams rtse mos rab gnas mdzad dus zhing skyong yab yum dngos su thim pa'i gzigs snang byung ba'i byin rlabs yid ches can sogs 'bur sku dang /

'gro mgon 'phags pa dang / theg chen rin po che'i thugs dam ma'i mgon po 'khor bcas kyi gos thang se'u ma dang / las mgon chen po'i 'dra 'bag pu tra nyid dngos su thim pa'i mthu rtsal can khams gsum zil gnon du grags pa sngags 'chang chen pos las mkhan ru 'dren dang bcas pa'i sku 'cham gnang dus kyi zhal 'bag 'jam dbyangs sku mched kyi pu tra'i zhal 'bag re re/ rje nyid kyis pu tra 'cham gnang dus kyi zhal 'bags sogs mdor na dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs ljongs 'dir brtan pa skyong phyir shing dang sman dang / rin po che dang / rdo lcags las grub pa'i sku brnyan gyi tshul du bstan te gnas pa brjod par dka' ba zhig bzhugs khang / na bza'/ rus rgyan sogs kyis spras te/ bdag chen blo gros pa'i thugs dam rtag gtor gsum dang / tshar chen dang / rta ra ba'i thugs dam rgyun gtor bdun dang bcas pa bzhugs shing / logs bris kyi bkod pa la/ rten gral gyi g.yas phyogs na/ rdo rje gur gyi mgon po la gnod sbyin yab yum dang / zangs gri can gnyis kyis bskor ba/ rnal 'byor dgra lha chen po la ru tra brgyad kyis bskor ba/ chos 'khor srog shing nag po la/ lha srin sde brgyad/ 'jigs byed mahā ka la la gshin rje gshed brgyad/ bstan srung nag po chen po la las mkhan brgyad/ mahā de wa'i sras po la mu stegs brgyad/ tshogs bdag mahā kā la la nor lha brgyad/ lha chen dpal 'bar mthu bo la lha mchog brgyad kyis bskor ba rnams bram ze'i gzugs can/ nor skyong yab yum sgo ma bzhi dang bcas pa dang / g.yon phyogs na yum chen e ka dza ti dang / lha mo 'dod khams dbang phyug ma/ rigs bzhi'i lha mo dang / chu srin gdong can sogs kyis bskor ba/ pu tra ming sring dkar bdud lcam dral bran bdud dang bcas pa sogs dang / lho nub kyi ngos gnyis la mgon po'i brgyud pa/ yi dam lha tshogs/ ru 'dren sde bzhi sprul pa'i pho nya dang bcas pa sogs/

gzhan yang 'phags pa klu sgrub nas sngags 'chang yab sras kyi bar bla ma mang po'i zhal gzigs kyi mgon po du ma dang / sngags 'chang bla ma nyid drag po'i chas su bzhugs pa la tshe sbyin dpal mos 'chi med kyi dngos grub stsol ba/ nyid kyi gzigs snang la shar ba'i gur lha brgyad dang bcas pa sogs ri mo'i bkod pa ngo mtshar ba kun gyi yid 'phrogs par bzhugs la/ de rnams kyi drung na gtor tshogs ri rab la 'gran pa nam mkha' rgyang bu drag po'i nyer spyod dang bcas pa dang / sa lo chen po'i sgrub rnga byin rlabs can/ 'phags pa dang / theg chen rin po che'i dbang rdzas kha ṭwaṃ ka bdag chen rgya gar ba dang / sngags 'chang chen po'i gtor bzlog gnang dus kyi phyag mtshan karta ri/ lcags kyi rdo rje dang phur pa gter ma ngo mtshar can sogs bgrang ba las 'das pa/ yab rje grags pa'i zhabs la dam can rdor legs kyis gzhis chen du skad cig gcig la brdungs nas phul ba'i lcags kyi rdo rje rnams zhal byang gis brgyan pa sogs/ spyan gzigs kyi tshogs dbyar dus kyi sprin phung ltar gtibs pas/ gdug pa can dag gis mthong ba tsam gyis snying lkog mar 'dren te/ dper na 'dod lha'i zhags pas dam du bzung ba'i sna bo sa skya pa'i ring lugs la gus zhen che rgyu rang med pa 'ga' zhig 'di mjal ba la bag tsha bas nem nur du gyur cing / nang du slebs pa na 'jigs shing skrag ste mig lta ba yang ma nus par/ gdong dngul gyi dbyugs te de ma khad bros ma stabs su phyir song ngo zhes zer ba 'dis mtshon no/ /mtshan la ni sngar ltar bshad pa rgyu mtshan du byas pas mgon khang khyad 'phags zhes gsol zhing / 'di gnyis la dus nyin mtshan 'khor mo yug tu mar me'i phreng ba rgyun mi 'chad pa dang / steng du rgyal mtshan dang / gse 'bru dang / rnga thug du ma dang / logs la dril bu'i phreng ba dri za'i glu dbyangs lta bu'i sgra skad 'byin pa dang /

thun mong du sgo khang / sgo glegs g.yab dang bcas pa tshon rtsi dang / gser shog phun sum tshogs pas brgyan pa sogs/ brgya byin gyi khang bzang rnam par rgyal byed kyang spa bkong bar byed pa 'di bzhengs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ rdzas las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po 'di dag dang ldan pa'i dad pa'i rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo ni/ rgyu yang rung / 'dug kyang rung / nyal yang rung / mi nyal yang rung ste/ rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par bsod nams mngon par 'phel ba kho nar 'gyur zhing / bsod nams nye bar skye ba kho nar 'gyur 'gyur te zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rang gzhan kun la legs byas kyi chab rgyun nar ma nyid du spel bar mdzad pa yin no/ /dbyar thog der 'bras spungs nas sprul pa'i sku thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang / dge ldan pho brang nas mchod yon rnams gtsang phyogs la phebs te/ gzhis khang chen po bsam 'grub rtser bzhugs pa la/ gtsang stod kyi bla ma sde dpon che rags phal cher rang rang gi longs spyod kyi shas stobs pa'i don du der 'dus/ dus der bdag nyid chen po nyid kyang mchod yon mjal phrad kyi phyir chibs kyi kha lo shar gyi phyogs su legs par bsgyur te/ bsam rtser phebs nas gzhol du bzhugs mthil mdzad cing / mchod yon nas zhabs tog yang dag par bsgrubs/ phyogs phyogs kyi bla ma/ slob dpon/ dpon rigs che phra sogs der 'tshogs kun 'dod chos dang / phyag dbang zhur byung bas nyin rang po mi rdzogs pa der bzhugs ring thams cad la byung zhing / de dus gser mdog can gyi lcang ra slob dpon dpon slob gnyis mjal du byung ba na slob dpon la rje nyid kyi zhal dkar gyi gsol ja khong rang gi dkar yol mer ba zhig dang / de lhag grwa pa der gnang ste rten 'brel zhig yod gsung byung bas/ khong gnyis dga' bdes myos shing blo rtse gnyis su gyur/ de nas mi ring bar slob dpon chos grwa de'i mkhan po dang grwa pa gzhan de slob dpon gyi go sar 'phos pa na/

bdag nyid chen po'i lung bstan mngon du gyur par kun yid ches so zhes thos so/ /de nas mjal phrad dngos gzhi'i tshe so so nas/ mjal ma thag ring nas 'grogs pa'i dga' 'dun gyi grogs ltar dag snang dang gus zhen shin tu che bar 'khrungs te mchod yon sogs so sor gnang skyes rgya dpang shin tu che bar stsal cing / phan tshun bag phebs kyi gsung gleng ci yang zhig mol bar mdzad/ bzhugs gral gyi dga' ston ja bur mar thud sogs bzhes dgu'i longs spyod zab cing gya nom pa ri ltar spungs shing bskyil bas/ las byed rnams kyis 'khyos dka' ba dang / 'bul nod kyang gser dngul gyi maṇḍal/ dar gos kyi yug ring sogs dngos gtsang zhing grangs mang ba rnam mang thos sras kyi mdzod kha bye ba lta bu'i 'dod yon gyi 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pas bsnyen cing bkur te shin tu gus par btud pas/ sa skya pa'i rigs su gtogs pa'i byis pa tshun chad dga' mgu yi rang par gyur/ de yang so sor phag rir zhal mjal ba'i tshe nas/ bdag nyid chen po 'di'i mdzad spyod la/ phyag mdzod de nyid thugs cher rangs te/ sku 'khor thugs nang dag pa 'ga' la/ sa skya zhabs drung 'di sku gdung rus btsun pa sogs nas/ khengs dregs dang g.yer bag chen po mdzad pa zhig yod snyam ste/ shin tu thugs dul zhing brling la 'grogs bde ba dpe mi srid pa'i bla mar 'dug ces kyang gsungs par grags pa bzhin dus 'dir yang / der skabs nyin gcig rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang dben zhing lhod par zhal 'dzoms te/ sprul pa'i sku des/ bdag cag gi rnam 'dren dam pa 'di la mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa las brtsams te 'bel gtam gyi bka' mchid rang nyid kyi ji tsam spobs pa zhig dri bar mdzad pa na/ 'jam dbyangs bla ma kun gzigs kyi dbang po 'dis/ bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor zla ba rgyas pa lta bu 'dzum phyung ste/ stabs shing myur ches pa dang /

thogs shing ha cang bul ba ma yin par/ dag gsal snyan pa'i gsung gis 'di skad du/ chos 'di'i ngo bo ni 'di yin/ dbye ba ni 'di tsam mchis/ brgyud pa ni 'di las 'ongs/ yul dus ni 'di rnams su dar/ bshad tshul ni 'di 'dra zhig bdog nyams su ni 'di ltar du len zhes sogs ji srid gting ma dpogs kyi bar du mdzad pas/ sprul pa'i sku de nyid ha las te/ e ma sa skya nas bdag chen rin po che 'di ni 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam sprul du grags pa don dang mthun nges pa'i thams cad mkhyen pa rang na snang ngo zhes snyan pa'i gdugs dkar phyogs kun tu bskor bar mdzad cing / slar dbus su phebs nas kyang / dpal gshin rje gshed kyi chos 'byung 'jam dpal chos kun gsal ba'i nyin byed sogs/ sngags 'chang bla ma'i gsung rtsom 'ga' zhig g.yar bar mdzad nas gzigs rtogs gnang bas shin tu thugs song ste/ snyan tshig gi phreng bas spud pa'i bsngags brjod dpyid kyi pho nya ngo mtshar can zhig kyang mngag par mdzad do/ /de ltar mjal phrad shin tu legs par grub nas thugs dgyes bzhin pas/ ston zla dang po'i nang du chibs thog tu 'khyon par mdzad de/ phebs bsu ser phreng gi bkod pa zab spros ches che ba dang bcas gdan sa chen por phebs/ de nas bzung sku khams kyang je dwangs la song ba yin no/ /don de dag la 'di skad smra ste/ snyan grags a ka ru yi bsung zhim pos/ /zhal dkyil li kha ra yi dga' ston gyi/ /ltad mo'i mgron la chos kyi rjer grags pa'i/ /'byor ldan 'dus pa'i khyu de ring bar bos/ /bung ba'i tshogs de dad ldan utpa la'i/ /ze'u 'bru'i 'phreng ba mang du gzhib pa'i bcud/ /rgya ja'i btung ba la sogs 'dod yon gyi/ /sbrang rtsi gsar pa'i skyes kyi cho ga bstar/ /sa gsum rgya mtsho'i rgyan gcig paṇḍi ta'i/ /gtsug tor bsnyen rdzogs nor bu tog gi blo/ /mang thos grags pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser mchod nas/

/legs spyad bdud rtsi'i dga' char dus der phabs/ /tshul chen lam gyi chos grwa ha ri'i nags/ /log 'dren dug gi me lces zar brtsams tshe/ /sngon med mkhyen bzang rgyal ba'i 'phrin las pa/ /bdud rtsi'i char de dal bur phebs te bzlogs/ /de tshe khur ldan dre'u'i ri bong drag po'i klung / /sreg za 'bar ba'i nang du rang nyid mchongs gyur pa/ /mthu stobs drang srong lag pas bton pa'i ngo mtshar gzugs/ /bden 'dom brgya sbyin 'phrul gyis kun la ngom min nam/ /kye ma mi dge'i las la byol nyog tu/ /bag med dga' mgur spyod pa'i 'gro mang la/ /blang dor ston phyir sgrib bral rgyal ba yang / /bsnyun gyis gtses pa'i tshul de bsam bzhin skyo/ /skyo shas nges 'byung skyed byed 'di skad du/ /duḥkha'i khur 'di sngon rab pha ma gnyis/ /gnyis sbyor bde bar rol la bsting ba'i las/ /las byung rnam smin lhag mar nges zhes gsungs/ /gsung 'di nyan thos chen po mau 'gal bu/ /bu ram shing pa'i 'khor gyi gtso de nyid/ /nyid kyi skye ba'i gar du yid ches blo/ /blo chung dag la'ang dpyad cing dpyad cing skyes/ /de tshe mkha' spyod nyams dga'i grong khyer nas/ /de bzhin gshegs kun yum mchog ḍā ki'i dbang / /de nyid 'dzum zhal mngon sum bstan ma thag /de dang gnyis med bde chen dpa' bor gyur/ /rol mtsho 'gog pa'i btung ba dang / gser ri smad pa'i zas nor tshogs/ /rdul grangs 'gran pa'i 'gror bkyes pas/ /dge don skyengs te ga shed song / /mtshan mkhan ca co'i chu gter mdog la ma 'jigs par/ /lhag bsam gru gzings brtson pa'i rlung g.yor bcas zhugs pa/ /bzang po'i rmang lam mthun pa'i dri bzhon gyis bskul bas/ /ngo mtshar 'phrin las nor bu'i gling du bde bar son/ /de lta'i legs byas bdud rtsi'i mtsho/ /bsrubs pas phun tshogs sbyor ba las/ /lha dang bla ma chos srung gi /bsti gnas nyi zla zung 'di shar/

/sngon nas goms pa'i bsod nams nor can dag /dag zhing padmo can de 'dir 'phos kyi/ /kyi hud 'khor ba'i gnas tshul bsam byos la/ /la gor nyid du 'di ru skyabs song dang / /'di ni sa rdo chu las bskrun pa mi yi longs spyod ma yin te/ /te por dag pa'i ye shes rang snang nor bu brtsegs pa'i gzhal med khang / /khang bzang mchog 'di mthong ba tsam gyis thog med nas bsags nyes pa'i dri/ /dri bzang chab kyis bkrus pa bzhin du dag par 'gyur ba gdon mi 'tshal/ /yul dus kun khyab kun bzang rnam sprul gyi/ /mchod sprin dbus na dbus 'gyur bstan pa'i gtso/ /thub dbang mchog sogs mchog gsum rten gyi tshogs/ /bgrang yas byin rlabs byin za 'bar bzhin bzhugs/ /phur bu'i bla ma mig stong lha'i/ /khang bzang rnam par rgyal byed las/ /khyad par du mas ring 'phags pa'i/ /mtshan grangs phyogs kyi rna ba'i rgyan/ /de yi 'dabs na dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal yas khang / /de yi nang na bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /de yi 'khor na pho nya mang po 'phro zhing 'du/ /de yi drung na gtor tshogs spyan gzigs sprin ltar gtibs/ /nye dbang sum cu gnyis kyi gtsug tor la/ /mchod sbyin brgya pa'i rkang pa'i stegs 'cha' zhing / /gang de'i yid 'phrog ral pa'i cod pan rtser/ /thub pa'i zhabs sen dmar 'od mdangs kyis 'khyud/ /chu skyes 'dab 'phreng mdzes pa'i thal sbyar tshe/ /nyin byed dbang pos zer brgya spros pa na/ /ge sar rab tu bzhad pa'i lding khang du/ /bung ba gzhon nu snyan pa'i glu dbyangs 'tsher/ /bsdus te brjod pa'i rgyan/ de nas 'jam dbyangs bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa'i dbang po 'di nyid dgung grangs lnga bcu rtsa dgur son pa myos byed de shing mo lug gi lo/ yab rje grags pa'i mtshan can de nyid kyis/ nged kyi rten bzhengs blo la yod pa 'di rnams kyi mjug khyed la sgril dgos pa yong zhes sogs lung bstan gyi tshogs mang du stsal pa ltar/

de nyid kyis mgon khang gi dmigs su dgongs pa gtad pa'i rig 'dzin lha khang gi 'og 'di sngar tsha tsho ches pa'i shis kyis cung zad stem tsam yod pa/ ka ba dang gdung ma lhag por bsnan te brtan zhing brling bar mdzad/ de nas sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan can dang / rje btsun bla ma rang nyid kyis bzhengs pa'i gur lcam dral gyi 'cham sku ngo mtshar can bzhi/ mgon khang nub nas gdan drangs te bzhugs su gsol/ nub byang gnyis kyi ldebs logs steng gi cha la sa lo chen po'i gsar bzhengs thugs dam ma'i lam 'bras brgyud pa dang / rgya nag nas rta 'bul bas phul ba'i gos si kha gang dum bur byas nas bzhengs pa'i bde mchog brgyud pa'i bris spu si thang ma rnams dang / de dag gi kha skong du sngags 'chang chen po'i bla ma rnams kyi bris sku/ bzo rig dbang po sbyin pa rnam rgyal gyis gzab ris mdzad pa gnas pa la dgar grags pa rnams ka star bar ma'i ngos la bzhugs shing / gzhan yang tshar pa chos rje/ grol mchog zhabs kyi bris thang rang rang gi phyag nas ma sogs bla ma dang / bde kyai yang phur yi dam dang / yab rje grags pa'i zhabs kyi phyag bris ma'i mgon po/ zhal/ pu tra gsum/ rje nyid kyi phyag bris kyi dmag zor ma/ rje btsun chen po'i thugs dam ma'i zhal bzhi pa dang / chos rgyal 'phags pa'i thugs dam ma gur lha brgyad kyi bris thang sogs chos skyong mang po'i bris sku grangs dang tshad med pas ka ba dang phyogs logs thams cad go mtshams med par gtams shing / de dag gi drung na gtor tshogs dang / mchod rdzas shin tu rgya che bar bshams te/ bskang gso 'chag med kyi rgyun btsugs/ gzhan yang khrab rmog gri mdung sogs go mtshon gyi tshogs dang / zhing lpags kyi bla bre dang / rgyu ma'i dra phyed/ gri thod dang / rtse gsum sogs so so'i rten rdzas phyag mtshan spyan gzigs nam mkha'i ltos gang bas brgyan te/ bstan srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams mngon sum nyid du/

padma'i ze'u 'bru la bung ba ltar 'du ba'i mgon khang khyad par can bdud dpung kun 'joms zhes bya ba 'di nyid gsar du bskrun nas/ yab rje dam pa grags pa'i mtshan can de nyid kyi dgongs pa zab mo yongs su skong bar mdzad do/ /de'i lo dgun skal ldan mang po la rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i chos skor gyi cha lag chos nyid dngos su ston pa'i byin rlabs gzhan la med pa'i dkon chos khyad par can de sogs chos mang po stsol bar mdzad ces thos la/ de nas dpyid kyi dpal mo'i 'dzum zhal gsar du bstan pa na/ dpal e waṃ chos ldan gyi zur 'chad pa chos kyi rje bsod nams rgya mtsho bas gsol ba btab nas/ zung 'jug dgyes mdzad rdo rje'i rgyud gsum gyi bshad pa sogs chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor bar mdzad de/ de yang thog mar rje nyid kyis 'jam dbyangs sku mched la rtsa rgyud 'phags mchan dang bcas pa'i bshad lung gsan pa'i brgyud rim/ rje nags dgon pa chen po nas rtsa rgyud dang / de'i 'grel pa dag ldan/ de'i gsal byed dag ldan go sla dang bcas pa/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags las/ rgyud gsum ka so so'i 'grel pa dang bcas pa gsan pa'i brgyud 'debs tshan pa gsum gyi kha skong dang bcas pa'i brgyud 'debs kun khyab par grags pa rje btsun dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i lung gnang nas/ dpon slob kun gyis snyan zhing brjid pa'i gdangs kyi nga ros gsol ba 'debs par mdzad cing / brgyud 'debs 'di e waṃ pas/ sa lo chen pos mdzad pa'i rdo rje phur pa'i brgyud 'debs dpal ldan brtan g.yo ma la thugs song nas/ de la dpe mdzad de brtsams pa yin pas shin tu legs gsungs thugs rtsis dpe med gnang / de nas de lta bu'i brgyud pa la ring brgyud dang / nye brgyud gnyis las/ ring brgyud ni mngon par rtog pa rin po che'i ljon shing las/

rdo rje 'chang dang dpal ldan ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ /rje btsun chos skyong mthu stobs dbang phyug birwa pa/ /nag po ḍā ma pa dang a wa dhu ti pa/ /rje btsun ga ya dha ra shākya ye shes mchog /ces rgyud kyang man ngag gi bshad pa'i brgyud rim dang / yang ljon shing las gnyis pa ḍombhi he ru ka dpal de rjes su/ /a la la dang dpal ldan nags khrod garbha ri/ /rgyal ba dpal gyi ye shes sbyangs dka' zla ba dang / /dpa' bo rdo rje ye shes zhabs la gdams pa'o/ /zhes rgyud don yan lag lnga'i dpe dang sbyar te 'grel pa'i steng nas rgyas par 'chad pa 'grel pa lugs kyi brgyud pa smos nas de ltar bka' srol chu bo gnyis 'dus kyi rgya mtsho chen po 'brog mi lo tsā ba nas ji ltar 'phel zhing / de dag las rje btsun sa skya pa chen po la bka' babs tshul ni/ ma dros ye shes zhabs las rgyun bzhi'i bla ma ni/ /rgyal po'i rigs dang snying po snang ba'i mtha' can te/ /rigs dang snying po'i zhabs las 'bar ba 'bar ba'i mtha'/ /rgyun bzhi 'dzin pa'i bla chen de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /zhes 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po/ bla ma se ston kun rig mnga' ris pa gsal ba'i snying po/ 'khyin lo 'od kyi snang ba ste/ 'brog ma dros pa'i mtsho las 'ongs pa'i rgyud man ngag gi chu klung chen po bzhi yod cing de thams cad kyi bka' bla ma sa skya pa chen po chos kyi chu gter du babs par gsungs pa ltar yin la/ nye brgyud ni rje btsun pa'i stong thun sa bcad las/ bla med phyogs ni ris bsgyur mig bcas pa/ /rig byed kyis gsal lag pas me la bgo /de 'od kun gsal chu gter 'byung bar babs/ /blo ldan don 'di shes na smra bar gyis/ /legs 'ong mig gis yon tan gsal bar byas/ /me dang chu bos 'byung ba rab tu bskyed/ /zla bas kun kyang gsal bar byed mod kyi/ /mig gis legs par bltas pas bdag blo dad/ /gzugs gnyis yon tan zung gi thog ma ste/

/gang gis gang ston lo rgyus dang bcas pa/ /gzhung 'dir legs par bltas pas blo ldan gyis/ /legs rtogs gzhan la ston na bdag blo spro/ /legs 'ong 'chad pa bshad gzhi lo rgyus bcas/ /rnam 'grel bcas pas sdig 'joms gzhan mi ldan/ /mkha' mtshungs 'dzin bcas dri ma kun spangs te/ /yi ge bzhi ldan nyid du 'gyur bar shog /ces gsungs pa ltar te/ 'di don la bla med ni bla med ltar bkral ba'i rgyud sde/ phyogs ni bcu/ ri ni bdun te phyogs ris bsgyur bas bdun cu mig ni gnyis te de dang bcas pas na bdun cu rtsa gnyis/ rig byed ni bzhi ste tshul bzhis gsal bar mdzad pa'i rdo rje 'chang ngam/ yang na sku bzhi'i bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang gis gsal ba de nyid lag pa ste brgyud pa gnyis pa birwa pas sam bdag med mas/ me ste gsum pa birwa pa'i sa skya pa chen po la bsgo zhing / de'i gsung gi 'od zer kun tu gsal ba/ 'byung ba ste lnga pa rje btsun chen po la babs kyi/ kye kye blo ldan dag brda' 'di 'don shes na smra bar gyis zhes pa'am/ yang na don 'di shes par byas nas/ gzhan la smros shig ces 'dom pa ste/ de ltar na shes na zhes pa dang / shes nas zhes pa'i gzhung gnyis 'byung zhing / 'di ni rnal 'byor bla med ltar bkral ba'i rgyud sde bdun bcu rtsa gnyis kyi nye brgyud yin la/ rig byed ces pa snyan brgyud bzhi la sbyar ba'i bshad pa yang snang ste/ skabs thob kyis snga ma ltar legs/ bye brag dgyes pa rdo rje'i brgyud gsum gyi nye brgyud ni/ legs 'ongs sogs te/ de yang rdo rje 'chang nas legs par 'ongs te mig ste sngags lugs dang / 'grel pa lugs kyi bshad srol gnyis/ de gnyis kyi yon tan te rgyud gsum gsal bar byas pa de me ste sa chen la bka' babs shing / de dang chu bo ste bzhi pa dpal ldan rtse mos/ 'byung ba ste lnga pa rje btsun rin po che'i yon tan rab tu bskyed pa yin la/

zla ba ni gcig ste dang po'i rdo rje 'chang gis rgyud sde kun gyi don gsal bar byed pa yang ngo mtshar che mod kyi/ de bas mig ste brgyud pa gnyis kyi bshad tshul gyis bltas pas/ grags pa rgyal mtshan bdag gi blo gros rgyud gsum gyi don la shin tu gsal bar gyur te rgyud don la yid ches kyi dad pa rnyed pa 'di ya mtshan zhes pa'i don yin la/ yang mig gnyis la bdag med ma dang / yon tan gsum pa birwa pa dang / me de nyid dang / chu bo sa chen gyis/ 'byung ba rje btsun sku mched la gnang zhes 'chad kyang / zla ba ste rdo rje 'chang gis rgyud kun gsal bar byed mod/ de dag gi don man ngag dang mi ldan pas rtogs par mi nus pas na/ mig ste gnyis pa bdag med mas bltas shing byin gyis brlabs pa birwa pa nas brgyud pa 'di la man ngag gi 'chad tshul yod pa'i phyir bdag gi blo dad ces pa'i bshad tshul yang yod/ 'o na me yan gyi brgyud pa ji ltar snyam na/ gzugs gnyis sogs te/ de yang gzugs zhes pa gcig gi brda' yin la/ de gnyis ni nag po pa dang ga ya dha ra'i bar man ngag lugs dang / ḍombhi ba nas dpa' bo rdo rje'i bar gyi 'grel pa lugs gnyis yin zhing / yon tan ni gsum yin la de zung ni drug ste man ngag lugs la/ 'brog mi/ se ston/ zhang dgon pa ba ste gsum/ 'grel pa lugs la 'brog mi/ mnga' ris pa gsal snying / 'khon sgyi chu ba dang gsum ste drug po de dag sngar gyi me'i thog ma'i brgyud pa yin zhes pa ste/ de gnyis las 'ongs pa'i brgyud gsum po gang gis don gang ston lo rgyus te brgyud pa smos pa dang bcas pa gzhung 'di kun tu 'am legs par bltas pas/ ji lta ba bzhin rtogs pa'i blo ldan rnams kyis/ skal ldan gzhan la yang brtse bas ston na/ bdag grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi blo rab tu spro zhes pa'am/ yang tshigs bcad 'di rgyud 'chad tshul la sbyar te bshad na/

gzugs gnyis ni tshul dang po gnyis dang / yon tan zung ni tshul gsum pa bshad de thabs gdams ngag drug yin la/ de dag ni thog ma'am sngon 'gro ste de nyid rgyud tshig gang gis brjod bya gang ston lo rgyus te mngon par rtogs pa dang bcas pa'i tshul bzhi po spyi don gyi tshul gyis kun tu bltas pas/ blo ldan rnams kyis rgyud don rtogs par 'gyur zhing / de nyid gzhan la ston na bdag blo spro zhes pa'i don yin/ de lta bu'i bka' srol las legs par 'ongs pa'i yig sna la 'chad thabs kyi man ngag tshul bzhi ston pa rgyud sde dum bu/ spyi rnam/ ljon shing / stong thun sa bcad/ bshad gzhi rgyud gsum lo rgyus can te brgyud pa gnyis ldan/ rnam 'grel gsum bsdus don dang bcas pa/ sdig 'joms ni yum gyi bstod pa/ de las gzhan min par ldan pa ni bdag med bstod 'grel rnams bzhugs zhes pa ni legs 'ongs 'chad pa zhes sogs kyi don yin/ yang tshul dang po gsum 'chad pa spyi rnam/ bshad gzhi lo rgyus bcas ston pa ljon shing / dngos gzhi rnam 'grel so so bsdus don dang bcas pas/ ma dag pa sdig pa'i dri ma 'joms pa gzhan dang mi 'dra zhes 'chad pa'ang yod/ 'di ltar na ldan zhes pa 'dra ba'i don te/ dper na/ 'dul ba las phyi ma yang de dang ldan pa nyid min no zhes pa dang mtshungs shing / lugs gzhan la mi ldan pa'i khyad chos la sbyar ba yang snang / gang ltar yang dge ba bsngo ba ni/ mkhas mtshungs zhes pa'i gzhung ltar na/ mkhas pa snga ma de dag dang snyan brgyud kyi sgos mtshungs pa'i rje btsun chen po/ rgyud gsum 'dzin pa'i slob ma dang bcas pa/ sgrib gnyis kyi dri ma kun spangs te/ shrī he ru ka zhes pa'i yi ge bzhi'i don dang ldan pa nyid du 'gyur bar shog ces pa yin la/ mkha' mtshungs zhes 'byung ba ltar na/ sems can thams cad nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa'i chos sku brnyes nas/ gzung 'dzin dang bcas pa'i dri ma kun spangs te zhes sogs sngar ltar 'chad pa yin/

de na 'di la gzhung dang bshad tshul mi 'dra ba du ma snang / 'on kyang tshigs bcad dang po'i don kun mkhyen chen po'i brda' grol nges pa'i dpal ster ltar khas len dgos te/ rje de nyid kyis sna ro'i bandhe gshin rje grags kyis bzhengs pa'i rje btsun rin po che'i sku brnyan la mchod pa phul te gsol ba btab pas/ bar skabs su bsnyel ba dran gsos pa'i tshul gyis bkral ba yin pas/ 'di khyad par du 'phags gsungs nas thugs rtsis su mdzad de/ 'dis kyang rje nyid kun mkhyen chen po'i skye sprul du 'grub bo/ /de ltar brgyud pa'i bshad pa rgya cher mdzad nas/ de dang 'brel bar ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gi brgyud pa'i lo rgyus kyi yi ge'i lung stsal/ de nas bshad pa'i sngon du 'gro ba la/ rnam gzhag mtshan gyi don dang bshad thabs dang / /mngon par rtogs pa zhes bya tshul bzhi yin/ /zhes pa ltar bzhi po thams cad la gsung bshad shin tu rgyas shing zhib par gnang ste/ mjug tu don bsdu'i tshig bcad re 'dren par mdzad/ de dag gi rgyab rten du rje btsun sku mched kyi spyi rnam dang / ljon shing / glo bo mkhan chen pa'i gsung la sa los zin bris mdzad pa'i sngon 'gro'i yig sna gnyis/ dkon mchog lhun grub kyi gsal rgyan dang / mdzes rgyan gyi lung rnams gnang ste/ dpon slob thams cad brel ba ches pas ha cang yun ring ba 'gor na mi yong ba 'dug gzhan ma sbyor dngos kun la zin thun re btang na snyam pa yod gsungs/ 'di ni rje nyid spyir mdo sngags yongs rdzogs/ khyad par lta ba rim pa can gyi skabs dang bstun pas grub mtha' bzhi'i rnam gzhag la shin tu mkhas pas 'jigs med seng ge'i nga ror snang ste/ thams cad mkhyen pa klu sgrub rgya mtshos/ rang re sa skya pa'i phyag srol sngon 'gro tshul bzhi dang rgyud kyi dngos gzhi gnyis nges par dgos pas thog mar bshad bya'i rgyud/ 'chad thabs kyi man ngag

des ji ltar 'chad tshul gsum pa ni rgyud sde spyi rnam yin pas de'i zin thun btang / de rjes rgyud kyi mngon par rtogs pa lag tu blang ba'i rim pa mngon rtogs ljon shing yin pas de'i zin thun btang / 'di rnams kyi zin thun gtong ba la spyir mdo sngags zung 'jug khyad par grub mtha' smra ba bzhi'i rnam gzhag legs par phyed pa'i rnam dpyod dang ldan pa zhig ma byung na mgrin pa thung hril 'gro bas/ gzhan gyi rtsom chos la klog sgrog re ba tsam las mi 'byung ba yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa yin gsungs te/ lta ba rim pa can gyi gsung bshad gnang ba'i skabs su ljon shing nyid dang / rje ngor chen gyi gong ma'i dgongs rgyan/ ljon shing mdzes rgyan rnams dang sbyor bar mdzad cing / gzhan yang 'dul ba mngon pa gong 'og phar phyin dbu ma rnams kyi gzhung chen tha dad so so'i ṭikka spyi don rnams nas rgyas bshad kha skong bar mdzad de zhib cing mtha' chod pa sems thog tu smin pa zhig bstsal pas/ sku tshe hril por 'di kho na la sbyangs pa mdzad 'dug snyam pa'i mdo phyogs la sbyangs pa'i bshes gnyen chen po kun kyang 'di lta bu e ma mtshar 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam par sprul pa yin nges su 'dug snyam pa'i dad pa rang dbang med par bskyed par mdzad cing / rgyud gsum so so'i dngos gzhi'i gsung bshad kyi skabs/ rtsa rgyud la dag ldan dang / de'i gsal byed dag ldan go sla shar pa ye rgyal gyis mdzad pa dang / theg pa'i dag ldan go sla rnams kyi steng nas shin tu zhib pa dang / sampu ṭi la gnad kyi gsal byed dang / rdzong pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi ṭikka'i steng nas zab bshad dang / rdo rje gur la gur rgyal mtshan dang / lu phu ba/ chos rje nam mkha' smon lam gyis mdzad pa'i ṭikka'i steng nas rgyas bshad don bsdus sogs zhib tu gnang zhing / de dag gi rgyab rten du yig cha rnying ma so so'i lung dang /

rje btsun dam pa 'di nyid kyis mdzad pa'i tshul bzhi sngon 'gro'i rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis rkyang pa'i don 'grel khog phub rgyud 'grel sgo brgya'i lde mig dang / mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags la rgyud gsum gyi bshad pa gnang dus zin bris su gnang ba'i tshul bzhi sngon 'gro rgyud gsum ka'i don 'grel khog phub kyang tshul bzhi rgyas bshad dang bcas pa'i brtag gnyis kyi 'bru 'grel chen mo rnams kyi lung bshad sbrags mar stsal te/ de skabs der 'dus kyi slob ma'i tshogs rnams sa skya pa'i yab chos rgyud gsum la blo gros kyi mig bu rab tu phye nas/ legs bshad smra ba'i 'jigs med kyi spobs pa seng ge'i nga ro ltar sgrog nus pa'i dga' ston spel te/ dpal sa skyar bstan pa'i 'byung khungs su rgyud gsum gyi bstan pa'i me ro rmang nas bslangs te/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyi dgongs pa chos dbyings su rdzogs par mdzad pa yin no/ /lo de'i ston phyogs nas byon pa'i don gnyer du ma dang / 'dir bzhugs 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug lcam sring / mkhan chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs mai tri dhya na sa mu dra/ byang bdag po bla ma'i drung / ngam ring mkhan chen klu sgrub chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ chos 'khor lhun po'i mkhan po sangs rgyas shes rab/ bzang ldan slob dpon bla ma lags/ gdan sa'i chos las pa gnyis sogs chos pa brgya phrag lhag tsam la dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'phags lugs kyi rim lnga'i khrid 'gos lugs gtsang ma sogs de skor gyi chos tshul rgya che ba zhig stsol bar mdzad pa yin te/ de yang thog mar bskyed rim gyi bshad pa gnang ba'i tshe/ paṇa chen gung ru/ rje nyi zla seng ge sogs kyi rnam bshad kyi steng nas rgyas shing zhib la mtha' chod pa mdzad cing / de nas ngor chen rdo rje 'chang dang kun mkhyen gyis mdzad pa'i rim lnga'i yi ge rje blo gros rgyal mtshan gyi zin bris dang bcas pa la gzhan mkhas pa mang po'i gsung gi legs bshad kyis brgyan pa'i rim lnga'i khrid shin tu smin pa thams cad nyams khrid du stsol bar mdzad nas/

de dag gi rgyab rten du rgya bod kyi gzhung mang po'i lung bshad rgyas par gnang ba'i tshe/ rje btsun dam pa nyid kyi gsung las/ gsang 'dus 'phags skor gyi rgya gzhung 'di rnams gang zag gcig gis nyams su len pa na/ gzhung so so'i brjod bya'i don rnams lam rim du bsgrig tshul 'di ltar du shes dgos pa yin te/ de yang thog mar rgyud ma smin pa smin par byed pa'i rgyu dbang rdul tshon du bskur tshul/ klu byang gis mdzad pa'i cho ga nyi shu pa ba tshab nyi ma grags kyi 'gyur/ smin nas rgyu dbang lam du byed pa ras bris la brten nas bskur tshul sgra gcan 'dzin bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i zung 'jug gsal ba sa paṇa gyi 'gyur te dran pa gcig pa bsgom pa'i sngon 'gro'o/ /dran pa gcig pa bsgom pa la gnyis/ dran pa gcig pa bsgom pa dang po dang / de'i cha lag go /dang po la 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i mdor byas lo chen gyi 'gyur/ 'di nyid rtsa rgyud kyi lung dang sbyar ba mdo dang bsre ba lo chen gyi 'gyur/ mdor byas kyi skabs su mi gsal ba gsal byed kyi kha skong klu byang gis mdzad pa'i rnam gzhag rim pa lo chen gyi 'gyur/ gnyis pa de'i cha lag la/ mdor byas kyi sngon 'gro tshogs bsags ston pa rdo rje sems dpa'i mchod chog nag po dam tshig rdo rjes mdzad pa 'gos 'gyur/ sgrub dkyil thams cad kyi kha skong mngon shes can gyis mdzad pa'i gtor chog 'gyur byang med pa/ rab 'jigs rdo rjes mdzad pa'i sbyin sreg lo chen gyi 'gyur/ zla grags gnyis pas mdzad pa'i rdor sems sgrub thabs 'gyur byang med pa/ 'di sgron gsal mdzad pa po dang mi mthun te/ mdor byas/ mdo bsre/ rnam gzhag rim pa/ sgron gsal rnams 'gal ba mang po snang bas so/ /rdzogs rim la 'phags pas mdzad pa'i rim lnga lo chen gyi 'gyur/ 'di'i rim pa gnyis pa'i/ 'khor ba'i gzeb las rnam par grol/

/zhes pa yan chad kyi sems bsgoms pa'i 'bras bu bstan pa yar bcad 'phags pa'i gsung yin la/ de las 'phros pa'i gsung 'phros mang po 'byung ba shākya bshes gnyen gyis chad dogs nas 'phags pa'i gsung rab la mthud nas bris pa ni/ shes rab ngo bo nyid 'di ni/ /zhes pa man chad do/ /'di sems dben gyi kha skong du ārya dāe was sems kyi sgrib sbyong mdzad pa nag tsho tshul gyi 'gyur/ klu byang gi las mtha' rnam 'byed mdzad pa chag lo chos rje dpal gyi 'gyur/ sgyu lus kyi kha skong du ārya de was bdag byin rlabs mdzad pa 'gos 'gyur/ 'od gsal gyi chos can bde ba chen po'i kha skong du arya dāe was mngon par byang chub pa'i rim pa mdzad pa chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ chos nyid spros bral du ston pa'i kha skong 'phags pas mdzad pa'i byang chub sems 'grel lo chen gyi 'gyur/ rim lnga rim pa re re la yang rim pa lnga re tshang bar bstan pa klu byang gis mdzad pa'i rim pa khongs su bsdu ba pa tshab nyi ma grags kyi 'gyur/ de rnams kyi rim pa lnga rgyas par bstan pa'i don bsgoms pas nyams myong skye ba ngo sprod pa arya dāe was mdzad pa'i spyod bsdus sgron ma lo chen gyi 'gyur las 'gos kyis bcos pa/ rim lnga sbyor ba yan lag drug tu sbyar ba'i sbyar drug sgra dbyangs bcu gcig pas mdzad pa/ lo chen gyi 'gyur/ 'gos kyis mdzad pa shog ril gsum/ nyi ma seng ges mdzad pa'i btsun mo can gyi shog ril gyi 'grel pa sogs kyang de dag gi zhabs 'degs su sbyar nas 'chad cing nyams su len pa'i gnad shes dgos pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs shing / yang de dus rje btsun dam pa'i gsung las/ deng sang ni dus ngan gyi dbang gis gsang 'dus skor la yang dbang rgyun re tsam ma gtogs/ chos skor gzhan rnams rtsad chod mkhan dang don gnyer byed mi re re tsam yang med par thug pa'i tshod du song gda' ba/

sngon ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gi skabs su gsang 'dus 'phags skor kho na la 'chad nyan mdzad tshul yang chos rje srad pa kun blos zin bris su btab pa las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ dpal gyi chos grwa chen po e waṃ chos ldan du rje thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' bzang po pa dgung lo bdun cu rtsa gnyis bzhes pa/ srad pa kun blo rang dgung lo nyi shu rtsa gcig pa chu mo bya'i lo gsar shar ba nas dgun dpyid zla ba bzhi'i bar du rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i chos skor gsungs la/ sngon du zla ba gcig tsam gyis spyi'i byung tshul rgyas pa gcig gnang ste/ de la yang zin bris srad pa kun blos mdzad pa shin tu legs pa zhig 'byung zhing / de na snga chos la bskyed tshogs gzhung dang bcas pa gnang zhing / dgong chos la rgyud 'grel gyi bshad pa rgyas par gsungs/ tsha rting ma'i gsol ja'i thog tu bskyed rim gyi bshad pa gsung dus bu ston rin po che'i mdor byas kyi ṭī ka la snga gzigs re mdzad nas/ ja grol ma thag snga chos gsung du 'byon pas ngor dgon pa'i tshogs khang du rdo rje 'chang nyid sgo nang du phebs tsam nas yig brgya'i mgo 'dren mdzad de khrir bzhugs nas/ chos rim la dpon slob kun gyis rdo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya nyer gcig re dang / sku rkyang gis gsang 'dus nyid kyi gtor chog ltar 'jig rten pa'i gtor bsngo mdzad nas chos gsungs te/ bskyed rim gyi bshad pa 'gos rdog gi bzhed pa gtso cher rang lugs su bzhag nas/ bu ston gyi bzhed pa res 'thad pa dang / skabs su sun 'byin dgos pa yang snang zhing / phyis kyi 'dus pa la sbyangs shing mkhas par rlom pa dag gi rtog btags la dgag sgrub cher mdzad/ rang lugs kyi sgrub byed kyi sngon 'gro dang / lhag mos lta bu'i don tshan re song rim gyis nyid kyang rang lugs 'phags pa'i bzhed pa dang mthun par bstan pa'i phyir mdor byas/

de yang rgyud kyi lung gis bsgrub pa dang / mdor byas su cung zad kha skong dgos pa yang yod pas mdo bsre/ don dam pa'i dkyil 'khor/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor/ phyung pa'i dkyil 'khor/ sbyang gzhi snod bcud kyi srid pa'i rim pa ltar sbyong byed ston pa'i rnam gzhag rim pa rnams kyi 'bru snon/ rgyas bshad/ dka' gnas rnams lung rigs man ngag gi sgo nas zhib par ston cing / zla grags kyis mdzad zer ba'i rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs kyang bshad pa dang bcas par gnang / rdzogs rim gyi bshad pa rgyas pa'i theg pa'i bsam pa la bslabs nas bden gnyis zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi bar du spyod bsdus las 'byung ba'i bslabs tshigs ring mo rgyas par gsungs/ de dus snga gzigs la rje 'gos kyi stong thun chen mo/ shog ril gsum/ 'gos kyi gsung 'phros yig sna dang bcas pa mdzad nas/ rim lnga 'gos lugs de las kyang paṇḍi ta btsun mo can gyi shog ril la thugs rtsis su mdzad de/ gzhan mar lugs la dmigs pa'i byed lugs 'di ltar yod do/ /zhes dmigs rkang tshang bar gnang ste/ bu ston gyi khrid yig dben pa gsum 'gos lugs gtso la/ bden pa gnyis mar lugs rang du yod cing / zung 'jug gnyis ka ltar yod ces gsungs pa las dgag sgrub cher mi mdzad/ deng sang gi 'dus pa bar grags pa rnams kyi gsung la yi ger bris pa la nor ba 'di 'dra yod cing / nged kyis gsung gleng gi sgo nas rtsad bcad pa la 'di 'dra yod do zhes sogs phyogs snga rgyu mtshan dang bcas pa longs pa'i dgag sgrub cher mdzad/ klu sgrub kyi rim lnga dang / 'phags pa'i spyod bsdus la bshad pa rgyas pa mdzad/ gzhan gzhung rnams la lung bshad pa tho re ba gnang / de'i tshe bskyed rdzogs kyi bshad pa zhib rgyas che ba dgag don 'gril ba/ sun 'byin sgrub byed nus pa che la tshig ris gtsang ba/ nyams len sems thog tu 'khyer bde ba gnang bas/

srad pa kun blo'i slob dpon mkhas pa'i dbang po don yod dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas/ snga chos de gsan rjes byams chos gsungs pa'i chos grwar nyin re bzhin chos rje rin po che'i de ring gi chos de gcig pos mkhas pa'i khyad par dgag sgrub kyi rnam gzhag nyams len la sbyor tshul ye rang tsho'i yon tan phyogs gcig tu dril ba la med gsungs/ chos thun yang 'tshams par byung bas dgyes par mdzad/ gung ja'i bar la rje 'gos kyi mchan chen po la snga gzigs mdzad cing / re 'ga' rdog pa'i 'grel bshad kyang gzigs nas/ dgong chos la sgron gsal gyi mchod brjod rgyan bdun gyi stong thun rnams la sngon la gzhung thog tu mi gzigs par skam bshad rgyas pa re mdzad/ de nas bu ston rin po che'i mtha' drug rab gsal gyi steng nas bshad pa dang 'bru snon lung tshun chad yi ge gcig kyang ma lus pa mdzad rjes/ mang ra'i dka' mchan dang rdog pa rlan gyi ṭīkkar de 'dra'i nyag nyog mang po mi byed par/ go rgyu che ba tshig nyung ba'i hril pa 'di 'dra re byed pa yin gsungs nas/ snga rabs pa'i lugs kyi bshad pa rno thag chod pa re mdzad de/ dper mtshon na sgron gsal gyi mchod brjod bshad par dam bca' la/ bu ṭīkka na 'bru snon dang / bshad yams rgyas la/ dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' la spyi sbas mthar thug sogs bskyar gyin mang po dris pa de gsungs rjes la/ snga rabs pa rnams 'di 'dra'i go rgyu chung la zer rgyu mang ba mi byed/ rgyud tshig la bzhi bshad dgos pa du ma byung yang / bstan bcos kyi 'bru snon la bzhi bshad byed pa ci 'dra yin ma shes/ 'di la mang ra seng rgyal 'di ltar gsungs te/ bshad do zhes sbyar/ gang bshad na/ dpal ldan rgyud rgyal zhes dang / rgyal ba'i 'dus gang min par bshad/ gang gis bshad na/ zla ba grags pas bshad/ sngon du bya ba ci byas nas bshad na/ khyab bdag dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' la btud de bshad/

tshul ji ltar bshad na/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyi shin tu gsal bar rnam phye legs bshad pa/ mtha' drug gi ni 'ching bas bcing ste bshad/ snod gang la bshad na/ rgyal sras yul gyur te dbang rnon skal ldan la bshad/ slob dpon su'i man ngag la brten nas bshad na/ de ni klu sgrub las rnyed pa/ de lta bu'i man ngag la ma brten na bshad par mi nus te/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rim gnyis gnas kyi rgyas btab ces sbyar/ tshogs gnyis kyi dpal dang ldan pa dpal ldan no/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po ni gsang 'dus so/ /gang 'dus na rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba 'dus pa dang / rgyal ba nyid kyis gsungs pas rgyal ba'i 'dus gang yin pa'o/ /khyab pa ni gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyis so/ /bdag ni 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha'i bdag nyid du gyur pas so/ /dpal ldan zung 'jug rdo rje don dam/ sems dpa' kun rdzob/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyis ni bshad rgyud bzhis so/ /shin tu ni mi shes pa dang bral te ma nor bar ro/ /gsal ba ni the tshom dang bral te sgra zur ma chag pa'o/ /rnam phye ni log rtog dang bral te rgyud kyi don tshig re re nas so/ /legs bshad pa ni tshig rang yang ldebs legs par ro/ /'chad lugs kyi chings sgra ji bzhin pa dang / ma yin pa dang / dgongs dgongs min/ drang don/ nges don/ tshig dang / don dang / tshig don gnyis ka'i mtha' drug gi chings kyis bcings nas so/ /de lta bu'i 'chad tshul dka' zhing zab pa ni rgyal sras te/ rin po che lta bu'i gang zag gi yul du gyur pas de la bshad do/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rim gnyis gnas ni/ rgyud kyi dgongs pa thugs kyi nying khu bskyed rdzogs gnyis so/ /rgyas gdab ni mtshan pa'i rgya'o/ /zhes pa de'i don bka' mchan las 'byung bas mdor na dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal nas/ rgyud kyi rgyal po gsang ba 'dus pa zla grags bdag gis bshad pa'i rgyud bzhis mtha' drug gi chings dang ldan par klu sgrub kyi gdams ngag la brten nas sangs rgyas kyi dgongs don rim gnyis kyis rgya dang ldan pa de/

slob ma dang rin po che lta bu'i gang zag rnams kyi don du bshad ces pa'o gsungs te/ de lta bu'i mtshon don gleng gzhi'i bshad pa'i skabs su rim lnga'i bshad pa rgyas par gnang ste yun ring po song / de man chad la sngon la rgyud kyi steng du 'bru snon dang bshad pa go sla ba re/ de nas 'grel pa'i 'bru snon rgya che re/ de nas bu ṭīkka ltar 'bru dang bshad pa sbyar ba re/ de nas ṭīkkā 'dir de bzhin bshad kyang / mchan chen dang / rdog dang / rlan gyi go bde ba don bzang ba 'di ltar mdzad gsungs pa dang / skabs mang por ni mchan chen gyi yin tshod du 'dug ste/ mngon shes can gzhung 'di la 'di ltar 'chad/ btsun mo can 'di 'dra byed/ nag po pas 'di skad gsungs te/ khong kun gyi bshad lugs ya mtshan che ba/ rje 'gos kyang gsung bgros 'di tsam yang so sor ma 'dres par bkod pa thugs bsam dge ba bstan pa la bsam pa a tshi ba a tshi ba/ 'di lta bu sngon gyi sa skya pa rnying pa tsho la kyai rdor birwa pa'i lugs dang gzhan mi bsre/ man ngag lugs dang 'grel pa lugs mi bsre/ man ngag lugs kyi yang thun mong du gsungs pa dang lam 'bras kyi lung sbyor mi bsre ba yod/ deng sang yin na rgyal khams kyi lung 'khyams kun yo bsres tshar/ bslad tshar/ rje 'gos kyis 'di bzhin mdzad pa sku drin che gsungs/ dus phyis kyi gsang 'dus kyang gsar pa rnams ni sgron gsal gyi mchan dang mtha' dpyad zer ba'i rigs lam nas drangs zer/ spyir bla med kyi grub mtha' dang mi mthun/ sgos su mar 'gos sogs la ye med pa'i/ sol ba brdar bas dkar por mi 'byung ba ltar rang lus 'dis sangs rgyas mi 'grub/ rnam smin gyi lus dor te rang bzhin gnyug ma'i yid lus gcig gis zung 'jug bsgrub bya la sogs gsung rab la dbang chen po mang po byas yod de/ bla med kyi rgyud rgya gzhung gi go ba snal ba re chags na yig cha de kun bklags pa tsam gyis rang skyon rjen cher te rig rgyu cig yong bya ba sogs dag sgrub kyang mang du mdzad pas chos thun shin tu che/

rjes na mar la mkhas mchog don yod dpal ba'i drung nas chos grol nas rang gi gnas su phebs nas 'di skad gsungs te/ gsang sngags pa'i chos kyi 'chad lugs bu ṭīkka yig tshogs can de phyag tu bsnams/ de'i yi ge gcig kyang ma lus pa la 'bru bsnan/ der rting des go chod mod/ yang de bkag nas snga rabs pa'i bzhed pa re/ yang na snga rabs pa la thugs rtsis mdzad rting bu ṭīkka gis gang mdzad/ bshad lugs de rno la bzang ba/ nyung ba 'dug pa de ka gnang bas chog mod/ phyogs snga la yang kha cig na re zhes mi chen gyi tshig sbram po mdzad pas chog pa la/ chos rje dge ldan pa chen pos 'di ru 'di skad bris/ 'di dus 'di skad gsungs/ de 'dras ga nas 'ongs/ a pha pha zhes gsungs pa sogs de 'dra gsungs ga la dgos/ bla ma chen po 'di tsam du song nas mi chos gru bzhi lam pa byas pas chog pa yin gsungs te/ drung nas rang spyir dga' ba gdong la 'byon dgos pas rgyud myur bar grol na dgongs pa dang / khyad par mtshan nyid kyi chos mang po 'chad dgos pas chos thun cung tsam la chos 'gro che ba byung na dgongs pa 'dug go /de dus srad pa kun blo rang gi thugs bsam la ni/ sngon la rgyud rkyang la 'bru bsnan te/ ting nge 'dzin 'dis nyams len 'di ston gsungs pa des brda' chad lam pa re chags/ de nas sgron gsal la 'bru bsnan te tshul bzhi sogs bshad tshul 'grel pa rang skad gsal sing ste 'ongs/ bu ṭīka phyag tu bsnams nas 'chad cing tshig re re bzhin 'bru bsnan te gsungs pa ni/ chos rje shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan pa de bu ston la shin tu mos pas bu ston bka' 'bum bzhengs/ cung zad ma grub pa la chos rje nyid la gsob gsung gnang ste gsab kyang yod/ rjes kyang bu ṭīka steng nas tshar gsum gsan pas de'i 'brel dang zhen par gda'/ rjes su yig cha rnying pa rnams kyi lugs de man ngag thon che ba dang go sla ba sogs dgos pa mang po gzigs pa yin te/

de tsho'i gsung skyor tsa na khong kun gsang 'dus la mi tshe phyi zhing dril ba rnams zhes gsungs pa sogs che brjod mdzad pa yig cha bzang po de rnams kyi bshad sgrub dar la re bar 'dug bu ston gzigs rgya che yang / rdog dang rlan gyi yig cha rnams las 'gos kyi stong thun dang / mchan chen shog ril gsum dang ma mjal tshod du 'dug ste/ khong pa nan tan ltar bshad yams mang pa la rdog pas 'di ltar gsungs pa las/ 'gos kyi yig cha na 'di yod ces ma bkod do/ /'dus pa phyi ma rnams la dgag sgrub mdzad pa'i tshe yang rje'i zhal la lta snying 'dod cing / da dung sun 'byin dang tshig nyams 'dra byung na bsam dga' rgyu tshor ba dang / chos thun 'di da rung ma grol na snyam pa dang / 'di lta bu'i rgyud sde khyad par can rje 'gos lta bu'i lo tsā ba rang bzo mi mdzad pa la man ngag che ba'i gsung la btug rgyu yod pa chos rje srad pa rang yang bsod nams che snyam pa byung zhing / zha lu pa'i drin las kyang gsang 'dus kyi bshad srol bzang po da lta'i bar du byung bar 'dug snyam pa dang / dge ldan pas kyang gsang 'dus go la ma go'i yig cha mdzad/ deng sang dar bas rjes kyang dge ldan du sku mdun du yang khong tsho'i lugs dpyis phyin par zhus/ yig cha rnams kyang bzhengs/ bshad pa mdzad pa khong tshos rigs lam nas 'dren/ zhes smras pa de'i gnyen por rje snga rabs pa'i lugs man ngag thabs kyi khyad par mang po'i mdzod brtol te lhug par gnang ba 'di khong tshos 'ben bzang po btsugs pa'i drin yin par dgongs pas chos rje srad pa rang la ni dge ldan pa la log lta'i rnam pa dus nam yang ma byung / zhes sogs khong rang gi zin bris de nyid du gsungs 'dug cing / de ltar zla ba gsum gyi bar du snga chos dgong chos gnyis ka 'dus pa la dril te rgyud 'grel/ bshad srol gsar rnying phyogs snga'i tshul gyi dge ldan pa'i grub mtha'i gnad la dgag sgrub sogs dpyis phyin pa gnang bas/

de dus chos grwar 'dus pa'i don gnyer can rnams zla ba gsum po de'i ring la gsang ba 'dus pa la mkhas pa'i phul du phyin pa re byung yod pa gda' 'o zhes sogs gsungs shing / de ltar gsang ba 'dus pa'i khrid rgyas par gnang ba de dang 'brel bar/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud bshad kyang stsal pa yin te/ de yang thog mar gsang ba 'dus pa rgya bod du dar tshul gyi rnam gzhag rnams gsung ba'i tshe/ bu ston gyis mdzad pa sgo 'byed dang / sngags 'chang nyid kyis mdzad pa'i gsang 'dus chos 'byung snga rtsom phyi rtsom gnyis kyi steng nas gsung bshad lung dang bcas pa stsal cing / dngos gzhi'i rgyud bshad kyi skabs dpal ldan zla ba grags pa'i 'grel chen sgron gsal dang / bu ston gyi mtha' drug rab gsal sbyar ba'i lung bshad spel ma dang / sngags 'chang bla ma rang nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rgyud kyi don 'grel khog phub kyi ljags lung sngon la mdzad nas/ slar de dag gi snying po'i don 'di ltar yin no/ /zhes ljags bshad shin tu zhib pa re stsal te/ de dus kyi slob ma rnams gsang ba 'dus pa'i bskyed rdzogs rgyud 'grel dang bcas pa'i dgongs don la blo gros kyi snang ba rab tu rgyas pa'i dga' ston stsol bar mdzad cing / gzhan yang de dus mar gos thun mong ba'i dgongs pa bkod pa'i bu ston rim lnga'i khrid yig kun mkhyen 'phags 'od kyi khrid yig sngags 'chang chen po'i gsang 'dus sgrub thabs kyi 'grel pa chen mo bdag nyid chen mos mdzad pa dang / mar lugs kyi yig cha mang po phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i pod chung / bla ma ser sdings ba nas brgyud pa'i glegs bam gyi lung sogs 'di skor gyi rgya bod kyi gsung rab bgrang ba las 'das pa zhig gi lung gi bka' drin zla med kyang stsol bar mdzad de/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs kyi bstan pa nam langs ba la/ nyin byed 'od kyis spa ba ltar ches cher gsal bar mdzad pa yin no/

/de dag gi rjes tsam la sngar gyi slob tshogs de rnams dang / ngor mkhan po bsod nams rgya mtsho ba sogs gsar du 'dus pa mang po dang bcas pa rnams la/ sa skya pa'i chos skyong rdo rje nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa'i chos skor rgya che ba zhig stsal pa yin te/ de yang thog mar bsnyen dus kyi rjes gnang / sgrub dus kyi rjes gnang thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis/ brtsegs pa zhal can/ gdong gnyan can/ gsang khrid 'grel pa'i rjes gnang / bram nag dom mchong nag po'i rjes gnang sogs tsa turmu kha'i rjes gnang gi rigs phal che ba zhig dang / gnod sbyin bag rtse ba'i rjes gnang rnams sngon du stsal nas/ zhal bzhi pa'i gsang khrid shin tu zab pa nyams khrid du 'doms par mdzad pa'i bar la/ de dag gi rgyab rten du bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gis bsgrigs pa'i zhal gyi chos skor/ ngor pa'i gser pod kyi nang na bzhugs pa'i zhal bzhi pa'i skor sogs de thams cad 'dus pa'i tshar chen gyis sgrig par mdzad pa'i zhal bzhi pa'i po ti chen mo'i lung dkar chag nang bzhin yongs rdzogs rnams song rjes/ rje tshar pa'i ha la nag po'i be bum dang de'i kha skong / rje dbang phyug rab brtan gyi bka' bzhin sngags 'chang bla ma nyid kyis sgrig par mdzad pa'i dkar chag nang bzhin gyi lung 'di spyir chig brgyud kho na yin kyang / de dus bla ma dang chos skyong la gnang ba zhus nas bstan pa'i rgyun kho na la dgongs te slob ma rags bsdus shig la lhug par stsal ba'i tshe/ chos skyong gi 'khu ldog gi rnam pa tsam yang ma byung ba 'di ni sa skya pa'i bstan srung dbang po rnams rje nyid la 'go zhing ches pa'i de nyid dang rnam dbyer ma mchis par nges pa gzhan las phul du byung ba'i ngo mtshar gyi rnam thar du snang ngo / /don de dag la 'di skad smra ste/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi yum mchog gtso/ /bdag med ye shes ḍā ki'i zhal sgo las/

/smin byed bdud rtsi mchog gi ro bda' po/ /dngos su gsol bas sa drug mthar son pa/ /dpal ldan birwas rjes bzung sa skya pa'i/ /bka' srol dri med dgyes rdor rgyud gsum gyi/ /tshul bzhi sngon 'gro'i bshad bka' zla med pa/ /rgyas par stsal pas gangs ljongs rdo rje gdan/ /dpal ldan sa skyar yab chos dri bral gyi/ /bstan 'gror phan bde'i mdzad 'phrin 'di mthong tshe/ /'phags pa'i yul gyi dpal ldan chos skyong ngam/ /sa skya'i bla chen slar yang byon pa snyam/ /pha rgyud gtso bo dpal ldan 'dus pa yi/ /rgyud dang man ngag sbrel ba'i legs bshad kyi/ /sngon med nyi ma gsar pa 'di shar bas/ /don gnyer blo yi padmo che cher rgyas/ /'di ni sngon tshe e waṃ chos grwa ru/ /rgyal bas lung bstan kun dga' bzang po yis/ /gsang 'dus chos 'khor bskor ba'i rnam thar la/ /'gran par nus 'di ngo mtshar gnas min nam/ /gzhan yang bstan srung dbang po zhal bzhi pa'i/ /dkon zhing gnyan pa'i rjes gnang khrid man ngag /yig skor bcas pa'i zab chos sprin dbyangs kyi/ /dga' ston gdong ldan tshogs la spel 'di mtshar/ /e ma bla ma gong ma'i gdan sa mchog /mchog 'dir chos char rgyun chad med pa phab/ /phab pas zab rgyas chos tshul rgyun bzang 'phel/ /'phel ba 'di la dpyod ldan kun kyang smon/ /nyid kyi rigs kyi cod pan mkhan chen rje/ /dpal ldan sa skyar gdung rgyud dri med kyi/ /chos 'khor bskor 'di gzhan las ngo mtshar zhes/ /snyan brjod lha yi rnga chen sgrog par mdzad/ /lha brgya'i thor cog ngo mtshar nor bu'i khrir/ /zhabs sen dbyig gi khu ba ngal gso ba'i/ /'gro mang kun dga'i byed po 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /bsod nams bdud rtsi'i mgron du 'dir spyon cig /lo de'i ston so hor zla brgyad pa'i tshe/ dge ldan pho brang nas lho nang du dbus gtsang kong sogs kyi dmag dpung nyi zer gyi rdul la 'gran pa lta bu 'jug par mdzad pas/

de'i tshe sngar nas lho bod g.yul lan gnyis sprad pas gnyis ka la bod rgyal rgyu rang ma byung ba sogs kyis 'di phyogs kyi dmag mi thams cad shin tu dpa' bkong bar gyur te/ ngag nas kyang ca co 'di skad du/ bdag cag rnams gson bzhin du dmyal bar 'gro ba 'di la/ mgon gzhan med/ skyabs gzhan med kyi dpung gnyen gzhan med kyi/ dpal ldan sa skya nas bdag chen rin po che 'gro ba kun la bu gcig pa ltar dgongs pa'i thugs rje can gang yin pa de kho na bdag cag rnams kyi mgon skyabs/ dpung gnyen du gyur ro zhes smre zhing / gsod sar khrid pa'i phyug bzhin du rang dbang med par 'gro bar byed do/ /dus de na rtse gdong nas phyag mdzad bgres gzhon gnyis dang / skyid gshong zhabs drung sogs bla ma dang mi chen mang po zhig chig 'dom gyi khul du sgar gyi phyir rjes non par byon zhing / khong rnams kyis bdag nyid chen po 'di'i drung du lhor spyan 'dren gyi pho nya zhu mchid dang bcas mngags pa na/ re zhig 'dul ba'i dus la ma babs par gzigs kyang khong dag dang / dmag mi rnams spro bsring ba'i phyir sngon la mi sna zung sbrel zhig rdzong lta gnang / slar phebs bzhed kyis bzhugs skabs nub gcig mtshan lam du rje nyid bla brang phun tshogs gling gi tshoms chen mo'i shar lho'i mtshams na bzhugs 'dug pa'i sku drung du/ bdag nyid chen po'i zhabs tog gi bgyi ba la rtag 'grus kyi ngal ba lhur len pa'i mchod dpon smon lam rin chen pa dang / chos rje kun dga' blo gros pa sogs 'ga' zhig gi khrol ma chen po rgya khyon phyar ba tsam byas pa byi'u 'chi la khad pa shin tu nyam thag pa'i rad rod mang pos yongs su gang ba bzhi khyer byung nas/ srog chags sdug pa 'di rnams gso bar mdzad du gsol zhu ba la/ rje nyid kyis legs par 'tsho ba'i cho ga mdzad pas/ de thams cad nye zho med par gsos nas nam mkha' la 'phur song ba'i tshul shin tu gsal ba zhig byung ste mnal sad pa na/

yong da lam lho rong la byon pas sems can la phan pa chen po rang 'ong ba 'dug 'on kyang khrol ma bzhi po 'di gang gi ltas yin nam dgongs pa shar zhing / mkhan chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs sogs sku 'khor rnams la yang de bzhin gyi bka' stsal pas/ rjes sor bod dmag rnams lho rong nas 'thon pa'i tshe/ mkhan chen rin po che'i drung nas/ sngar gyi mtshan ltas de bzhin bdag nyid chen po la mngon mkhyen thogs med mnga' ba da gdod kyang mngon du gyur/ des na 'di lta bu'i ngo mtshar ba'i gnas las bsgrags te/ nyid kyi rtogs brjod yon tan rin po che'i 'dus pa'i rgya mtsho'i kha skong rnams myur du spel dgos pa snang lags/ zhes kyang zhu yi 'dug phyis su bsam pas khrol ma bzhi po de ni spa gro dgon gling bzhi sogs kyi dmag kha bzhi la lta ba 'dug ces bdag nyid chen po'i gsung las dngos su thos pa yin pas skal ldan dag shin tu yid ches par zungs shig de nas rje btsun dam pa 'di nyid ston zla 'bring po tha skar gyis nya ba'i dmar cha rgyal ba gnyis pa'i nub/ zla ba de'i phyi ma'i mjug la dus kyi rim gror mgon po drug cu pa'i gtor bzlog gnang dgos yod pa bsu bar mdzad nas/ de'i phyi de nyin bar ri dwags kyi rgyal po seng ge ral pa can gcan gzan gyi tshogs kyis bskor ba'am/ zla ba rgyu skar gyi tshogs kyis bskor ba'am/ 'khor los bsgyur ba bu stong gis bskor ba'am/ stobs bcu mnga' ba slob ma'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba ltar/ rje btsun bla ma mkhas pa'i khyu mchog don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te mkhan rin po che 'jam dbyangs blo ldan pa'i zhal snga nas la sogs pa chos srid kyis bsdus pa'i shes bya'i dkyil 'khor la mkhyen pa'i spyan ras nam mkha' ltar yangs pa mang po'i mdun du bdar te chibs kyi kha lo legs par bsgyur nas phag rir phebs te gdan chags skabs rje nyid kyi mnal lam du/

gur gyi mgon po zhal skyin 'od dang ldan pa zhig shar phyogs su khyu ru ru sgyur ba'i spyan 'bur tshugs su gzigs pa dang / pu tra chen po zhal dkyil zla ba ltar dkar zhing spyan gsum gser mig ltar 'khyil ba zhig gis thugs la bzhed pa'i don rnams 'phral du 'grub pa'i las mdzad pa gzigs snang khyad par can zhig dang / yang lan gcig zhing skyong tsa turmu kha bram ze'i gzugs su sku mdog sngon po rol stabs kyis bzhugs pa gzi brjid can zhig skyed lhas mgon khang gi nub phyogs kyi logs ngos la bzhugs pa'i sku'i bkod pa gsal bar gzigs pa sogs mnal ltas ya mtshan che ba du ma zhig bstud nas byung bas/ de dus chos skyong so so la bstod pa re gsar du mdzad pa yang 'di lta ste/ hūm̐/ bstan srung gtso bo dpal ldan mahā kā la/ /zhal dkyil 'od 'bar dbang po'i phyogs gzigs shing / /'phrin las mgon po zhal dkyil zla ba ltar/ /dkar zhing spyan gsum gser mig 'khyil der 'dud/ /ces sogs dang / zhing skyong stobs 'phrog dbang po bram ze'i gzugs/ /sku mdog ind+ra ni la'i lhun po ltar/ /rab brjid phyag g.yas thod pa mi snying 'dzin/ /zhabs gnyis rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs la bstod/ /ces pa 'di gnyis kyang gsung rtsom mdzad pa yin la/ yang lan gcig mnal lam du bya rog chen po gcig gis gcan gzan stag cig sder mo gnyis kyi bar du khyer nas lcags mchu rnon pos lus la 'debs cing / stag de shi la khad pa'i ngang nas gdan sa chen po'i sa dkar logs nas bzhi thog gi bar snang la phar 'phur tshur 'phur dang bcas gshog 'gyur mang po byed bzhin pa'i de ma thag rje nyid kyang sked lhas mgon khang gi steng na bzhugs yod do dgongs pa la skye lhas kyi mgon khang rgyab kyi brag logs der stag gi ro de bskyur nas/ sngar gyi bya nag de bya nag chen po gnyis su gyur nas gzi brjid chen po'i gshog 'gyur dang bcas skad snyan po sgrog bzhin pas zhabs drung du thud dud du byung ba la/

bdag nyid chen pos kyang bshos 'chang mang po gnang ba la sogs pa'i rmi lam shin tu gsal ba zhig byung 'dug pa dang / yang lan gcig gi tshe yab rje chos kyi rgyal po dang bzhi thog tshoms dmar du mjal ba na yab rje'i phyag tu sdig pa ra tsa zhig bsnams 'dug pa la slar yang sdom kha brgyad byin chen khu lu sogs srog chags ma rung ba 'ga' zhig sngar gyi sdig pa ra dza dang lhan cig tu me tsha mo zhig la 'debs pa mdzad song bas/ rngog dud kyis lung pa khengs pa tsam dang / me de tshoms bar gyi mgon khang du skyol cig gsung ba snyam byed pa la mnal sad pa'i snang ba byung gsungs pa 'di dag ni/ bdag nyid chen po sems can rnams bde thabs dge 'brug legs spel gyi chings 'doms gnang ba la/ gegs byed kyi log sgrub kho nar gcig tu phyogs pa'i mi srun pa mtha' dag chos skyong rnams kyis bsgral te/ lho bod kyi chings 'dom thog mar lo lnga'i bar dang / de nas gtan chings thams cad rim gyis 'byung ba'i rten 'brel thams cad rang 'grig tu gyur te/ rje nyid kyi thugs bzhed bzhin du grub pa 'di yang kun dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam thar du snang zhing / yang nyis thog gi mgon khang bca' bsgrigs kyi zhal bkod thog mar mdzad pa'i nyin/ de nyin glo bur du a tsa ra mdog gzhan las sngo ba sgang yol zhig byung nas sngags 'chang nyid la sman phrog mang po dang / 'phags pa klu sgrub yin zer zhing 'jam dpal nā ga raka sha'i sku li ma ya mtshan can zhig dang / khyad par rdo nag gi zhal bzhi pa'i rten rdo lag mgo tsam rang byon gyi rnam pa mang po byas pa zhig la/ dzo ki kho rang rtsis shin tu che zhing tsa turmu kha tsa turmu kha zer zhing rten bshad kyi tshul gyis gtad nas brda sprod mang po byed pa la/ mgo thog tu yang yang 'jog cing / de'i rten rdzas 'dra ba'i rdo nag mtheb skor tsam dbus mtho la mtha' ri mos brgyan pa zhig dang /

yang rdo nag phug ron gyi sgo nga tsam la shin tu 'gril ba'i ngo mtshar can rnams la yang tsa turmu kha'i pha la hos zer zhing rten rdzas yin tshul brjod pa sogs ya mtshan gyi rnam 'gyur du ma dang bcas sngags 'chang bla ma nyid kyi phyag tu 'byor bas rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa 'dug gsungs shing dges spro dang bcas da lta mgon khang na rten rdzas gsum ka dar zab kyi na bza' dang bcas bzhugs pa 'di yin zhing / gzhan yang nyis thog gi gtsug lag khang gsar bzhengs bde ldan mngon dgar mtshan gsol ba de nyid du gza' skar bzang ba'i nyin zhig sku rten che rags 'ga' spyan drangs gtsug lag khang la sa rtsi dang steng du gser 'bru rgyal mtshan sogs btsugs pa'i nyin yang / glo bur du a tsa ra zhig zhabs drung du byung nas rma bya'i sgro phod phon che ba zhig dang / dung dkar rwa can skyon med gcig bcas phyag du phul 'dug pa 'di yang chos skyong rnams kyis 'phrin las bsgrubs nas/ thugs kyi bsam pa thams cad mthar phyin te chos kyi dung rgyun mi chad par 'bud bzhin pa dang bcas zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo rtag par bskor ba'i dge mtshan yang dag par snang zhing mngon gyur du mchis pa 'di yang shin tu ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar du snang ngo / /bzhi thog mgon khang chen mo zhal bkod kyi skabs thog mtha' bar gsum du phyi nang gi rten 'brel ngo mtshar can blos mi 'khyud pa rnams rje nyid la mtshan ltas khyad par can mang du byung ba rnams ni chos skyong gnyan pa'i bka' ma gnang ba'i phyir 'dir thun mong du 'bri bar nus so/ /de ltar phag rir bzhugs pa'i ring la 'brug pa'i dmag gi las byed gtso bo rnams la spang blang 'di bzhin byed dgos tshul gyi phebs sgo ci yang zhig stsal kyang / sa sgo btsan pa sogs kyis mngon pa'i nga rgyal brdo bas dang len gdengs khel zhig ma zhus nas/ rgyang tsam na ring rdzong chung du phebs/

tshur lam lha lung du skya ser mang por khrom dbang zhig kyang stsal/ na ring du bzhugs skabs dgon pa ba ri'i bla ma sogs skal ldan mang po la/ mgon po trag shad kyi rjes gnang / rnal 'byor ma'i bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid/ thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid sogs chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor/ de nas/ chu srin gnas kyi dug can pa/ /dus rlabs yol bar 'gyur srid kyi/ /gdul bar bya ba'i sras rnams la/ /sangs rgyas dus las yol ba med/ /ces pa gser 'phyang zhes pa me mo bya lo'i dbyar zla ra ba'i nang du na ring nas chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur te/ spa gro'i mthil rang du phebs/ der phebs tsam nyid na der yod kyi dmag mi thams cad blo gcig dang tshig mthun par ma 'dres pa'i mdza' bshes/ srid gsum gyi skyobs pa/ 'gro ba'i bla ma dam pa khyed 'dir byon pa ni bdag cag rnams kyis rnyed pa legs par rnyed de/ bdag cag ma bsgral ba rnams ni bsgral du gsol/ ma grol ba rnams ni sgrol du gsol zhes gsol ba 'debs shing shin tu dbugs phyin par gyur to/ /yul phyogs der spyir yang nyes dmigs che zhing / khyad par de dus rong tshad che ba rang gi skabs yin pa de lo sgar der dal yams drag po gso dka' ba dag gis khebs pas/ bod dmag byin dang sna bo gzhan ma tsho thams cad ni sa dug la sogs pa'i bro nad kyi rigs rnam pa mang pos tes por gtsos te gyag grum shin tu che ba byung yang / bdag nyid chen pos sku 'khor rnams la snga dro re bzhin ljags chab kyi bsrung ba rgyun ma chad par stsal pas/ de nyid kyi mthus rje nyid dpon slob rnams la de lta bu'i nyes pa ma byung zhing / dmag mi blo ldan grangs dang tshad med pas kyang chu gtsang stobs che ba khyer nas ljags chab zhu bar rgyun ma chad par byung ba de rnams la yang sngar nad kyis thebs pa rnams kyang srog skyon med cing / ma byung ba rnams phyis nas bsrung thub pa sogs byin rlabs kyi rtags mtshan mngon gyur de bzhin byung ba'i tshe/

der gnas kun na re/ 'di 'dra ba'i rkyen ngan pa ru 'dzings pa'i dkyil du/ gzhan ma thams cad ni 'di ltar nyam nyes par gyur pa la/ bdag chen rin po che'i dpon slob rnams la nyes dris gtse ba lta ci/ dmag mi ljags chil gyi bdud rtsi reg tshad bro 'tshal med par bde ba'i dga' ston la ci dgar rol ba/ e ma sa skya bdag chen gyi byin rlabs nus mthu/ zhes dad pa'i sprin sngon drag tu g.yos pa'i rum nas/ ro 'dzin gyi glog zhags ring du bskyod de bden tshig gi 'brug sgra stong gsum ldir bar byed cing / rje nyid bzhugs pa'i gzim khang la dmag mi rnams kyis nyin mtshan rgyun chad med par skor ba byas pas/ bzhugs yul gyi mtha' ma skor lam shin tu byang ba'i shul lam dod pa da lta yang yod par thos shing / de nas sngon bdag cag gi ston pa thub pa'i dbang pos/ yul 'khor mo 'jig gi drang srong lhung ba ri dwags kyi nags su/ lnga sde 'dul ba'i don du gshegs pa na/ de dag ma gus pa'i 'og khrims bcas pa ston pa'i zil gyis rang dbang med par dral te la las bsu/ la las stan bting / la las zhabs bsil ba'i chu bshams te bsnyen zhing bkur ba'i sgo nas thub pa'i gsung mchid thod du blangs pa bzhin du/ srid pa gsum gyi yongs 'dren dam pa gang gi sku'i nyin byed yul phyogs de'i skye bo rnams kyi yid mkhar shar zhing / gsung zer sgra 'dzin gyi bu gar reg pa tsam gyis/ 'brug pa'i dpung gi kha lo pa rnams kyang dad pa'i 'dab brgya rang dbang med par bzhad de/ 'di skad ces sprel mo la tshun gyi rong 'di nang gi dmag tshogs ka ca dang bcas pa thams cad ci byed nged rang dbang btsan pa yin na'ang / da lam sa skya zhabs drung sangs rgyas mi'i zol 'dzin bgres po 'di lta bu btsal kyang rnyed dka' ba yin pa la/ sems can gyi don du nged rang gi bkad sar bde blag tu byon pa 'di bzhin long bas mig rnyed pa dang 'dra bas 'di nyid la skyes su 'bul ba yin gyi/

khyed rang gzhan ma chings pa'i gzugs brnyan tsho don 'di la bcol gnyer ye med pas ci dgar song zer/ snyem tshig gi do ker chen po rje nyid kyi zhabs stan du bkrol te/ bdag nyid chen po'i bka' stsal gser gyi cod pan dang ba'i gtsug rgyan du shin tu gus par blangs so/ /de ltar sngags 'chang 'gro ba'i skyobs pa zla med pa 'dis/ dge 'brug rnam gnyis lo lnga'i bar phan tshun gnod pa med pa'i chings sdom legs par mdzad de/ mi rta phyug gsum la sogs pa drin can gyi pha ma sems can dung phyur bgrang ba las 'das pa/ 'jigs rung gshin rje'i kha sgo mi zad par drag cing rtsub pa'i duḥkha yid la mi 'phrod pa'i mche ba rab tu gzings pas yun ring por mnar ba de 'dra ba nas 'byin par mdzad pas/ de thams cad zab gsal gdod ma'i chos sku gsar du mthong ba'i dga' ba la 'gran pa'i bde bas/ yid shin tu myos pa'i gdung dbyangs kyis mgrin gcig tu/ mtho ris kyi 'gro ba las tshe 'phos te ngan song gsum gyi gcong rong du lhung ba nas 'don pa'i 'dren pa 'ga' zhig ni yod do zhes grag gi bdag cag mi lus mngon sum la sems can dmyal ba'i g.yang sa nyam nga ba 'di lta bur lhung ba las 'dren pa'i skyobs pa sngar mthong ba lta ci dgos/ thos pa yang med na/ de ring mngon sum du gyur pa 'di 'dra ba/ kye ma 'jig rten gyi mgon po skyabs su mchi'o zhes zer zhing / 'ga' zhig ni rang la gang bdog pa'i dngos po/ tha na rna rgyan re las med kyang de nyid rje nyid la stobs par byed/ la la ni rje nyid kyi zhal dkyil la mig mi 'dzum par lta/ kha cig ni de lta bu'i skal bas dben kyang / rje nyid bzhugs pa'i phyogs su phyag 'tshal ba dang / skor ba byed pa dang / thal mo sbyor ba la sogs pa dga' mgu'i rnam 'gyur ci yang zhig ston par gyur to/ /'di lta bu'i 'phrin las dper na skyes bu zas kyis brnangs pa ni skyug tu yang med la mid du yang med par duḥkha ba ltar/

lho rong gi dmag tshogs ci bya'i tol bor ba dag la mi 'jigs pa skyabs kyi mchod sbyin zla med pa ni/ 'o skol gyi ston pa thugs rje can de nyid tshong dpon gyi bu khye'u chu 'bebs su 'khrungs skabs/ sems can nad sna tshogs kyis gdungs shing gzir ba mang po/ tshe'i rig byed kyi cho gas sngar kho ltar nad med stobs dang ldan par mdzad pa dang / 'brog stong gi rdzing bu chab dang bral bar/ nya khri phrag chu dang zas kyis bskyangs shing / rten 'byung zab mo'i chos kyis sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha'i bde ba la bkod pa dang / gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' zla 'od du 'khrungs dus/ zhi dul des dpal gyis/ 'bar ba po rkang khra mi srun pa btul te/ rgyal po'i bu brgya rtsa la sogs pa skye 'gro mang po bskyabs par mdzad pa las kyang lhag na/ cher rlom 'ga' zhig phyir rgol la thub na ni bsdo la/ gzhan du na byer chog pa'i sog dmag ngan pa nor la ha cang brkam pa dag gzhan gyi zang zing gi 'byor pa de dag gi mig khengs pa spungs te/ bod sog stong phrag 'ga'i chings sdom bgyis pa la/ 'di ni kho bo cag gi rnam par thar pa bzang po'i shos yin no/ /zhes khyi zug gi sgras gzur gnas kyi rna ba rtsub mor byed pa dag ri rab kyi drung na rgya shug gi tshig gu ltar zil gyis gnon pa lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de de nyid kyi mdzad pa bzang shos yin du chug mod/ de nyid las khyad par du 'phags pa tsam gyis ni/ bdag cag gi rnam 'dren dam pa 'di'i mdzad pa ngo mtshar bar yang mi 'grub ste/ 'jig rten pa yi dge ba la/ /srid rtse'i sems dpa' 'bras rab che yang / de nyid kyis/ chos kyi bzod pa zag pa med pa la nam yang 'gong par mi nus pa dngos po'i gnas lugs yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de lta na yang bdag nyid chen po 'di ni de lta bu'i dregs pa til 'bru tsam mi mnga' ste/ gsung las/ da lam sems can la phan pa cung zad byung ba 'di kho bo nus pa med kyang /

bla ma dang chos skyong gi thugs rje dang mthu rtsal yin par snang / nged phar 'gro ba'i tshe mkha' 'gro srung ma rnams zhal lho phyogs rang la gzigs nas 'byon/ tshur log tsam na 'di phyogs rang la gzigs nas 'byon gyin 'dug pa'i rmi lam rgyun chags su byung gsungs so/ /de ltar bdag nyid chen po 'dis/ skye bo khri phrag du ma bla na med pa'i phan bde la nye bar bkod nas/ hor lugs zla ba drug pa skar mchu stod kyis nya ba'i dkar phyogs kyi tshes la spa gro nas gdan btegs te phyag phebs pa'i tshe/ bod sog gi rgyal po rnams kyis gtso mdzad/ dmag sde rnams mgrin gcig tu gsol ba btab pa la/ chings gzhan rnams snga phyi gang la 'byon yang khyad par mi snang yang / bdag nyid chen po dpon slob rnams dpung chen spre mo la ma bud par rjes su bzhugs pa'i mi 'jigs pa skyabs kyi sbyin pas brtse bas ma bskyangs na/ rong dmag don ma go ba mang pos rjes gcod kyi tshams rngam mang pos kun kyang nyam thag par 'gyur bar sha chags pas/ de na thugs brtse ba chen pos dpung chen sgril ba'i rjes su phebs dgos par gsol ba btab nas/ de nyid kyis kyang zhal gyis bzhes te phyag bzhes su btab pas bod kyi dmag mi rnams lta ci smos/ rkang bzhi phra mo tshun chod la nye zho med par phag rir 'byor bas/ dmag mi drag zhan thams cad 'di lta bu bden nam rdzun snyam pas slar yang yid dga' bdes khyab par gyur te/ bdag nyid chen po'i snyan grags phyogs kun tu sgrog pa la rtag 'grus su gyur cing / rje nyid sa skyar phebs nas kyang stod mnga' ris spre nag tshang dbus gtsang gi ljongs kong sog mdo khams phal cher dang bcas pa'i de dus lho na dmag la yod pa'i skye bo 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyis ma dgos bzhin du dad pa'i rlabs chen po g.yos te/ so so nas zang zing 'bul nod kyi mchod sprin dbyar dus kyi chu 'dzin ltar rgyun chad med par 'du zhing bka' drin dran pas snyan brjod kyi tshig 'phreng dbyar skyes kyi rnga bo che ltar kun tu sgrog par gyur to/

/de dus lho rong du chings 'doms kyi bka' mchid grub mtshams 'brug pa'i dbu rje so so rdzong dpon tha dad dang bcas pas bdag nyid chen po sogs su zang zing gi 'bul nod kyi mchod sprin blo'i ra ba las 'das pa grangs dang tshad med pa dag gis bsnyen bkur rgya chen po bsgrubs shing / gzhan yang sa skya pa rang gi dgon so so'i bla ma grwa slob sbyin bdag dang bcas pa dang / rong gi dmag mi phal cher dang bcas pas 'khrugs rtsod kyi lus sems dub pa'i sdug bsngal las bskyabs pa'i dga' spro chen po dang bcas 'bul nod bsam gyis mi khyab pa lcags ras 'bras sogs kyi phung po ri bo la 'gran nus pa ltar byung zhing / rje nyid kyang so so'i 'dod dang bstun pa'i slob dpon rin po che'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ thugs rje chen po'i bsgom lung sogs ci la ci 'dod kyi chos kyi char chen po phab ste/ slob dpon gyi gsol 'debs le'u bdun ma dang / bzang spyod ma ṇi sogs dung phyur mang po'i dam bca' bzhes shing stobs 'byor ldan pa du ma la lo re bzhin sems can bcu phrag gcig nas brgya'i bar gyi srog blu byed dgos pa'i bka' stsal nan chen po phebs shing / so so nas bka' stsal dang du len pa'i dam bca' 'bul ba dang / snga sor rong du phebs gong phag rir bzhugs skabs kyang rkang bzhi che chung 'dres pa stong phrag gnyis lhag tsam gyi srog blu mdzad pa sogs rgyal ba'i sras kyi spyod pa rlabs po che sku nyams su bstar ba'i sgo nas skal bzang las 'phro can rnams dang ba'i dad pa lhag par 'phel ba'i sa bon grangs med pa zhig 'debs par mdzad pa yin no/ /phag rir phebs 'phral bod sog gi rgyal po gnyis kyis gtso byas drung 'khor stobs che ba'i bka' drin gsob pa'i 'bul ba rgya chen po phul zhing / rgyal rtse nas kyang dbyangs sa phyag mdzod chen pos dkar spro dmar spro dbul dpang dang bcas pa/

da lam sa skya zhabs drung nas sku ngal dub la ma ltos par thugs 'khur bsnam bzhes gnang ba la brten chings 'dom don 'khyol byung ba 'di bzhin lho bod gnyis ka la bka' drin che ba byung 'dug pas/ ngos rang dngos mjal gyi gsung gleng zhib pa zhig zhu bsam kyang / da lam brel ba'i stabs kyis ma thub pa slar 'gyang med du dbus phyogs su chibs kha bsgyur ba zhig dgos 'dug pa/ de bzhin dgongs yul du bcags pa dgos tshul gyi snyan 'bul lhug stsol du gnang zhing / de nas rim gyis chibs kha bsgyur te gan pa lhun grub stag rtser rdzong sdod rnams kyis zhabs tog phul du phyin pa bsgrubs shing / der yang dmag mi mang po cher gtad mjal du yong ba'i 'bul ba rgya chen po dang bcas/ sngon chos rgyal 'phags pas rgya'i mi yur chen mo gcod par mdzad pa'i phul du phyin pa'i rnam thar du snang yang / da lo sa skya zhabs drung nas gtso bzhes gnang bas nged lho rong gi dmag mi rnams lus sems ma bral tsam la bde bar log chog pa 'di dus kyi dbang gis sngon gyi de las kyang ngo mtshar che zhing bka' drin che bar byung ngo zhes legs so'i snyan tshig 'bul ba yang mang du byung 'dug go /de nas na ring dgon pa dang rin chen gling sogs su rim par phyag phebs te so so'i bsam pa dang mthun pa'i dbang rjes gnang lung gi tshogs du ma dang bcas chos kyi char chen po 'bebs bzhin pa dang lhan cig par lus can mang po smin cing grol ba'i sa la 'god bzhin par phebs pa'i ngang nas/ zla ba de nyid kyi dmar cha rgyal ba dang po'i nyin/ dpal sa skya nas thugs sras 'jam pa'i dbyangs ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug zhabs 'bring pa chab 'bangs kyi rta pa'i tshogs/ chos skyong 'cham mgon byin rlabs can rnams kyi bsu ba dang / chos sde lho byang gi phebs bsu ser 'phreng zab pa dang bcas/ slar yang rang gi bsti gnas dam pa bzhi thog bla brang du legs par phebs/
