chos sde lho byang du mang ja sbrel 'gyed bcas sogs phebs ston rgya che bar stsal/ lho rong du bzhugs skabs shig rje nyid kyi mtshan lam du/ lha khang chen mo'i shar lho'i mtshams 'di 'jig la khad pa sogs mtshan ltas cung mi legs pa 'ga' byung nas/ mkhan chen du sku dog cung zad 'dug pas/ rim gro zhig mdzod phebs pa ltar/ mkhan chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs de nyid snga sor nas bsnyun gzhi ngan pa zhig yod pa de langs pas sku shin tu dub pa'i ring nas/ dbyim lung gi zug gu la brgyud de bdag nyid chen po dpon slob rnams las dgung gsum gyis snga bar bla brang du phebs te/ 'di ni dpon slob mnyam du phebs na/ shul bar du mya ngan 'da' ba'i nyes pa spangs pa'i phyir dpon slob gnyis kas ma 'ongs pa mkhyen pa'i rnam 'phrul yin par gor ma chag go /de nas sang nyin slob gnyer ba rnams kyis brtan bzhugs shig phul bas/ cung bde ba byung nas/ las tshan tshor gsol bya dang gsung gleng lhug par stsal/ de nas nyer gsum gyi nyi dros tsam la/ dbon bsod nams rgya mtsho ba sku drung na yod pa la/ nged kyi phreng ba de tshur gtod dang gsungs phul bas/ da re zhig khyed rang rim 'gro 'dra'i kha lta byed du song / nged gnyid cung zad byed gsungs te 'da' kha ma zab mo'i rnal 'byor la mnyam par bzhag nas zhi bar gshegs so/ /de'i tshe lha rnams kyis puṣpe'i dga' char phabs pas sa phyogs de'i skye 'gro phal cher gyis mthong / de nas dgongs rdzogs dngos gzhir tshogs chen du kun rig gi cho ga mang ja bzang ba zung 'brel/ skam rlon gyi 'bul 'gyed gya nom pa dang bcas sgrub pa'i tshogs dbur bdag nyid chen po phebs te/ thugs brtse ba chen pos gsung bsngo smon lam rgyas shing smin pa'i bka' drin stsal/ spyir yang mkhan chen rin po che 'di nyid lugs gnyis ka la mkhyen pa shin tu yangs pas/ dgung lo nyer bdun pa nas bdag nyid chen po'i zhabs drung du bcar bzhugs kyi phyag phyi lhur bzhes/

zhe bzhi par thub bstan lha chen gyi mkhan por phebs te 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi mdzad 'phrin phul du byung bas/ gsung skyes kyi tshogs kyang rags shing mang ba sogs chos sde yang 'phel rgyas shin tu che bar byung / de ring nas gling kha bde ba can sogs byang phyogs bstan pa'i pad tshal dus min gyi ba mos za bar brtsams pa na/ rje de nyid kyi mkhyen bzang nam mkha'i dbugs kyis bzlog par mdzad pa sogs/ rje btsun sa skya pa'i bstan pa'i zhabs tog 'grub phul che ba/ sngon nas kyang bdag nyid chen pos rang re phyi ma la yang dag pa'i zhing du nges par mjal bar bgyi'o zhes gsungs pa sogs dpon slob thugs yid gcig tu 'dres pa'i ngang tshul shin tu gsal zhing / khyad par de dus thugs lhag par brtse bas dgongs rdzogs su mang ja 'gyed bcas shin tu bzang ba stsal pa'i thog bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam mang du btab/ de ltar bdag nyid chen po'i mkhyen brtse'i mthu dang / rje rang nyid kyis lam zab mo goms pa'i nus pas/ 'chi ba 'od gsal chos sku mngon du mdzad nas mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing du thogs med du byon par nges te/ mkhas pa'i dbang po klu sgrub rgya mtsho'i rnam thar las/ khong rang gi bla ma blo gros rnam rgyal de nyid gshegs pa'i tshe/ dbu zil pa khrom pa tsam 'dug pas/ 'od gsal ma bu zhal mjal ba'i nyams len phul du phyin pas/ rten 'di la grub mtha' snyogs par gdon mi za zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bdag cag gi yongs 'dren dam pa 'di la yang / thugs dam las bzhengs pa'i rtags gsal po gzhan ni ci yang mi snang bzhin ras kyi dmangs gsal zhing / dbu skra thams cad zil pa khrom pa dang / gtsug tor gyi slar skyes rnams phod de gyen du phyogs par snang bas so/ /de nas zla ba phyi mar sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i dus mchod kyi phur sgrub chen mo sngar mkhyud ltar gnang zhing / lo de'i ston mjug la/

thugs sras 'jam pa'i dbyangs lcam sring gnyis kyis gtso mdzad/ gdan sa'i bla ma slob dpon/ rgyal byang nas bdag po bla ma khu dbon/ ngam ring mkhan chen klu sgrub chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ ngor mkhan chen bsod nams rgya mtsho/ yar lung bkra shis rtse nas rje dbang phyug rab brtan pa'i dbon po/ chos kyi rje bka' 'gyur ba chen po mgon po bsod nams sogs chos nyan brgya phrag du longs pa la/ jo bo a ti sha nas brgyud pa'i tshe sbyin sgrol ma dkar mo'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang sngon du 'gro bas/ de'i gzungs 'jug gi khrid nyams khrid du stsal nas/ lung gi skor la sgrol ma'i chos skor bla ma gong mas phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i glegs bam gyi lung / sa lo/ sngags 'chang chen po/ rje tshar pa/ sngags 'chang bla ma rang nyid dang bcas pas mdzad pa'i 'di skor gyi yig cha mang po'i lung dang bcas pa zhib cing mtha' chod par stsal cing / de'i rjes kho na la rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug birwa pas bkral ba'i gshed dmar lha lnga'i byin rlabs sngon du 'gro bas spros med kyi khrid nyams khrid du shin tu smin par gnang ba'i rgyab chos su birwa pa'i rgya gzhung yongs rdzogs glo bo lo tsā ba'i spros med stong thun/ rje rdo rje 'chang gi spros med mdzes rgyan sogs 'di'i yig cha mang ba rje klu sgrub rgya mtsho'i chos 'byung spros med byin rlabs khrid yig rgyun gyi nyams len sogs yig skor cha tshang ba/ rje mkhyen brtse ba'i khrid yig sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ sngags 'chang chen po rje rang nyid rnams kyis mdzad pa'i gshed dmar gyi sgrub thabs khrid yig bskyed rim rnam bshad sogs 'di skor gyi yig cha bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i lung rnams lhug par stsal te/ de dus rje'i gsung las/ gshin rje gshed skor gyi chos tshul rnams 'chad pa la/ nag po'i skor byung tshul dang dmar po'i skor byung tshul gnyis yod pa'i/

phyi ma 'di la rgyud rgyas pa dang bsdus pa sogs dang / de dag gi dgongs pa birwa pa dang dpal 'dzin sogs kyis bkral tshul sogs mang du 'byung mod 'dir bod du dar tshul tsam zhig smos na/ 'di rje btsun grags pa yan gyi sku ring la ni bod du ma 'gyur la/ phyis chos rje sa paṇa gyi sku ngo man chad la/ dpyal lo tsā ba/ chag lo tsā ba/ g.yag lo tsā ba/ glo bo lo tsā ba/ gshong lo tsā ba ste lngas dar bar mdzad do/ /de yang dang po ni/ dpyal lo tsā ba chos kyi bzang po/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dngos su rjes su bzung ba'i bal po'i paṇḍi ta nis ka laṃ ka de ba la/ gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang zhus/ birwa pa'i lha lnga'i sgrub thabs dang / dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs dang / blo bzang snying po'i bskyed rims kyi gzhung gi gsham du/ rdzas sbyor/ 'khrul 'khor bsnyen pa'i kha skong la/ lha dbang du sdud byed/ me tog dmar po la brten pa'i sbyin sreg sogs ston pa bdag byin rlabs pa'i rim pa zhes pa dang / 'di byas med pa'i maṇḍal mchod chog gi gzhung bzang po gcig dang / byang chub bzang po'i snying pos mdzad pa'i 'khrul 'khor bri ba'i gzhung dus 'khor dang mthun par bshad pa'i las tshogs rnams bsgyur te/ lugs 'di ni gdon thog tu shin tu bsngags pa yin gsungs/ gnyis pa ni de'i rjes su chag lo tsā ba chos rje dpal gyis bal por byon pas ni ka laṃ ni grongs/ de'i slob ma ra went+ra bha ṭa ste bod skad du nyi ma'i dbang po 'od zer zhes pa bcom ldan 'das kyis dngos su byin gyis brlabs pa de nyid la/ lha lnga ma dang bcu gsum ma gnyis ka'i dbang zhus/ sngar gyi dpyal gyis bsgyur pa rnams la 'gyur bcos mdzad/ sngar ma 'gyur ba'i birwa pa'i gtor chog dang / blo bzang snying po'i gzhung rnams bsgyur/ snga 'gyur zer ba yang 'dug ste ma 'gyur ba dag grub chen dpal 'dzin gyi lha bcu gsum ma'i gzhung bcu gsum yod pa dang /

birwa pa'i spros med kyi nang tshan mnyam med snying rje'i rnal 'byor gyi gzhung zur du bkol nas bsgyur pa rnams kyi lung rgyun yang da lta yod de/ chag lugs 'di ni 'gyur bde zhing mkhas par yang grags pa yin te/ lo tsā ba nyid kyis mdzad pa'i yig cha yang mang du yod do/ /gsum pa ni chos rje sa paṇa gyi slob dpon paṇḍi ta dā na shī la la/ g.yag sde ba bsod nams seng ges lha lnga'i dbang zhus/ lha lnga'i bir gzhung la rang 'gyur mdzad/ 'khrul 'khor 'phreng ba'i gzhung rgyud 'bum phrag gsum pa la brten nas mdzad pa lhag por bsgyur te 'di rnams la g.yag sde bas bcos cung zad byas so/ /lugs 'di ni rgyud thag nye ba'i byin rlabs che bar grags pa yin te/ 'di la yang dā na shi las mdzad pa'i gong gi 'khrul 'khor 'phreng ba'i gsal byed dang / bcu gsum ma gtso bor byas pa'i dbang mchog rdo rje phreng ba zhes pa rgyas bsdus gnyis rang 'gyur du byas pa sogs yig cha du ma snang ngo / /bzhi pa ni glo bo lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyis bal po ra went+ra la dbang tsam zhus/ phyis mnga' ris kyi cha pu hrang gi dgung mkhar nyi bzung du bcom ldan 'das kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i paṇḍi ta darpan ā tsarya ste lnga 'dzin slob dpon zhes bya ba la/ gshed dmar bcu gsum ma'i dbang dang / dpal 'dzin gyi bcu gsum ma'i rdzogs rim rim bzhi dang / de nyid kyi gegs sel gyi gzhung dang / bogs 'don gyi gzhung dang / lha mo 'od 'chang ma'i sgrub thabs sogs gzhung phran bco lnga tsam dang / rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug birwa pas mdzad pa'i lha lnga'i rdzogs rim ston pa rdo rje tshig rkang dang / de'i dbang chog ston pa 'od gsal 'char ba'i rim pa dang / bdud rtsi byin gyis brlabs pa'i gzhung dang / paṇḍi ta dhar pan nam darpan gyis mdzad pa'i 'tsho ba'i de kho nyid rnams bsgyur cing / de rnams kyi man ngag rnams kyang thugs su chud par mdzad nas/

lo tsā ba nyid kyis mdzad pa'i spros med kyi khrid dang / byin rlabs la sogs pa'i yig cha mang du yod do/ /lugs 'di yang khungs btsun zhing byin rlabs che ba ste khyad par du 'phags par shes par bya'o/ /lnga pa de rnams kyi rjes su gshong rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi gcung po/ gshong lo tsā ba blo brtan gyis/ paṇḍi ta ba shrī la gshed dmar gyi rgyud le'u bcu dgu ma 'di zhus nas bsgyur te/ 'di nas gshed dmar lha bcu gsum ma bstan pa yin no/ /yang phyis kun spangs chos grags dpal la gshed dmar gyi rgyud 'khyar po gcig byung nas chos rje bu la phul bas/ chos rjes bsgyur nas 'gyur legs po yang thon te/ 'di phyis 'gyur ba ma gtogs blo bzang snying po'i lha lnga ston byed yin zhing 'di lung rgyun yang med gsungs so/ /de yang de dag gi lam sgrig tshul cung zad gcig bshad na bcu gsum ma la shrī dha ra nyid kyi dbang chog dang bskyed rdzogs kyi gzhung sogs gzhung phran rnams bsdebs pas bod du de nyid kyi dgongs pa phyin ci ma logs pa'i lam srol tshang la ma nor ba thon cing lha lnga ma la chag gis bsgyur pa'i bskyed rim gyi gzhung rnams la brten/ da na shī la'i 'khrul 'khor gyi las tshogs gsal bar byas/ dpyal chag dha gsum las 'byung ba'i dbang bka' gsum dang / glo bo lo tsā ba nas brgyud pa'i rdzogs rim gyi gzhung rnams bsgrigs nas/ brgyud pa so so nas byung ba'i lha lnga'i lam yongs su rdzogs pa gcig bod na bzhugs pa yin no/ /de la phyi ma 'di rnal 'byor dbang phyug birwa pa'i dgongs pa ltar nyams su len pa'i tshul ni 'od gsal 'char ba'i rim pas smin byed lha lnga'i sgrub thabs kyi bskyed rim spros med rdo rje'i tshig rkang gi rdzogs rim ste gsum gyis lam gyi lus bsgrigs nas/ dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs bdud rtsi byin rlabs/ gtor ma'i cho ga

'khrul 'khor gyi phreng ba gnyis te lnga lam de'i yan lag tu sbyar ba/ dbang gi skabs su bcu gsum ma'i thun mong ba rnams dang / 'khrul 'khor gyi skabs su dā na shī la'i gsal byed blangs pas lam yongs su rdzogs pa yin la/ bod gzhung ni rje rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i lha lnga'i sgrub dkyil gnyis/ de'i sgrub thabs rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs kyis gzhung che chung gnyis dang sbyar ba'i lung sbyar/ glo bo lo tsā ba'i khrid yig byin rlabs kyi yi ge dang bcas pa/ de'i khrid yig gi zur 'debs su rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i spros med mdzes rgyan rnams bsdebs pa las 'byung ba yin no/ /rgyud la le'u bcu dgu pa 'dis le'u dang pos lha lnga ma dang brgyad pas bcu gsum ma bstan zer te/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi lha lnga'i sgrub thabs 'di ni gtso bor rgyud rgyas pa la brten pa yin gyi bod na bzhugs pa 'di gnyis gtso bo ma yin no/ /nag po'i skor la mkhas na bcu pa 'di yang bshad thub cing / le'u nyer gnyis pa 'di na gzhan na med pa'i rdzas sbyor la brten pa'i las tshogs mang po zhig bzhugs te/ dmar nag gnyis las/ 'khrul 'khor mthar thug gi gshin rje gshed/ zhes 'byung bas shin tu zab pa yin zhing / rgyud gzhung de rnams kyi man ngag thun mong ma yin pa rnams ni/ rje btsun mkhas pa'i dbang po ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal birwa pa dang zhal mjal ba'i dus su legs par zhus nas thugs su chud de/ des sras kyi dam pa rdo rje 'chang a nanda bha tra la gdams/ de nas rim par brgyud de bdag gi bla ma mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags kyi bar rgyun ma chad par byon pa'i zab chos khyad par can 'di 'chad pa la/ sngon 'gro dang / dngos gzhi gnyis yod pa'i tshul snyan zhing 'jebs pa'i gsung gis legs bshad bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig stsol bar mdzad kyang /

rang gis gang zin tsam zhig dad pa'i dbang gis bkod pa yin no/ /de nas lo de'i dgun stod zla ba bcu gcig pa gsar du shar ba'i tshe/ sngar gyi chos nyan pa rnams la jo bo bka' gdams pa nas brgyud pa'i blo sbyong gi chos skor rgya che ba zhig stsol bar mdzad de/ de yang rgyal sras pa dang 'gro mgon dpal ye ba'i yig cha'i steng nas blo sbyong don bdun ma'i khrid kyi tshul du gnang ste/ de'i rgyab chos su yig cha de gnyis kyi lung / chos rje gzhon nu rgyal mchog pa dang / mus chen sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyis phyogs gcig tu sgrig par mdzad pa'i blo sbyong be bum yongs rdzogs dkar chag nang bzhin gyi lung / jo bo'i rnam thar chen po mdzad pa po mi 'dra ba gsum gyi lung / bsngags 'chang bla ma rang nyid kyis mdzad pa'i bka' gdams chos 'byung chen mo rnams kyi lung gnang zhing / de la 'phros nas jo bo rje'i rnam thar rags rim/ rgya bod du bstan pa spel tshul/ bod du chos rgyal lha bla ma ye shes dang / lha btsun byang chub 'od kyis jo bo bod du spyan 'dren pa'i ched du ngal ba brgya phrag dang du bzhes tshul/ slar jo bo bod du phebs nas dbus gtsang du 'gro don mdzad tshul/ de la brten nas slob rgyud 'phel tshul/ mthar jo bo mya ngan las 'das te dga' ldan du byon tshul gyi bar gyi rnam thar rnams shin tu rgyas shing zhib par gsungs te/ de ltar chos 'di gang las 'ongs pa'i bla ma brgyud pa rnams la yid ches par byas nas/ de nas sems dpa' chen po mus chen gyis mdzad pa'i sngon 'gro'i skabs ltar dal 'byor rnyed dka' sogs rgyas par dmigs khrid bstan nas/ sngon 'gro'i rten gyi chos rdzogs par byed do/ /de nas sems dpa'i rim pa dang / thun brgyad ma gnyis kyi sgo nas kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems bdag gzhan brje ba'i gsang tshig rgyas par bstan nas/

rnam dag gtsug gi nor bu ltar stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can/ dpe du ma'i sgo nas zhib tu ngo sprad par bya'o/ /dngos gzhi byang chub sems gnyis bsgom pa'i tshul bstan zin to/ /'dir 'chad dka' bas dang por don dam byang chub sems dang / de nas kun rdzob byang sems bsgom par bzhed kyang / 'dir jo bo nyid kyi bzhed pa bzhin/ dang por kun rdzob byang sems dang / de nas don dam byang chub kyi sems bsgom par bstan to/ /de nas gong gi sems rim pa'i mjug gi sha khrag sbyin gtong gi skabs dang mtshon cha 'khor lo dang rma bya dug 'joms gnyis kyi rang gi rgyu dge mi dge las 'bras bu bde sdug 'byung tshul dang / de ltar 'byung ba'i le lan thams cad kyang bdag gces par 'dzin pa'i blo gcig pus bskyed tshul dang / gnas skabs sha khrag lus 'bul gyi tshogs rdzogs shing / mthar thug bdag tu 'dzin pa'i bud shing bsregs nas/ stong nyid ye shes kyi don rtogs par 'gyur tshul rnams kyis khog phub nas/ lam 'khyer gyi chos bco brgyad nyid zhib tu 'chad do/ /rkyen ngan byang chub kyi lam du bsgyur ba bstan zin to/ /de nas blo sbyong thun brgyad ma ltar/ zas kyi rnal 'byor sogs nyin zhags phrug gcig gi bya lam sogs thams cad phan sems dang ldan pa la bslab bo/ /tshe gcig gi nyams len dril nas bstan zin to/ /de nas slar mtshon cha 'khor lo dang rma bya dug 'joms nas bshad pa ltar rang nyid gces par 'dzin pa'i rang don yid byed kyi blo'i 'khris med par/ lus srog longs spyod kun gyis gzhan don rjes su bsgrub pa'o/ /blo sbyong ba'i tshad bstan zin to/ /de nas spyod lam kun tu lus ngag yid gsum gcig tu dril nas gzhan gyi sdug bsngal bdag la len cing / bdag gi bde dge gzhan la 'bul ba'i bsam sgom rtse gcig pa'i blos/ ngag tu byams pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i gyer sdom rdo rje'i mgur nyid dus rgyun du kha don bya ba ni dam tshig mtshon la/

dpal glang ri thang pa'i tshig rkang brgyad ma nyid kyi nang ltar la nan tan du byed pa ni blo sbyong gi bslab bya mtshon la/ gzhan yang skyes chen dam pa rnams kyis mdzad pa'i blo sbyong gi yig cha rnams kyang gong gi rim pas/ thad sor thad sor sbyar te nyams su len pa yang man ngag go /zhes gsungs pa sogs/ sku tshe hril po blo sbyong kho na la sbyangs pa lta bu'i legs bshad kyi tshogs ci yang zhig stsal par mdzad de/ der 'dus thams cad dad pa dang nges 'byung dang byang chub sems kyi dge blo gong 'phel du gyur te/ bka' gdams chos kyi bang mdzod la dang 'dod kyi dad pa phyogs med du rgyas shing / legs byas kyi 'bras bu bgrang ba las 'das pa zhig bskrun par mdzad pa yin zhing / de dang rjes mthun la sngar gyi chos nyan rnams kyi steng du/ mkhas pa'i dbang po khro phu mkhan chen dus zhabs nas dang / byang chub gling bla ma ras pa zhi ba 'od kyi sprul sku/ kha ba lhas kyi bla ma gzhan phan 'od zer sogs khong dpon slob rags bsdus shig bsnan pa la/ dam pa sangs rgyas nas brgyud pa'i zhi byed chos skor cha tshang ba zhig dang / kha che paṇa chen nas brgyud pa'i 'jam dbyangs dkar po'i chos skor yongs rdzogs/ zhal bzhi pa'i rjes gnang gi rigs mi 'dra ba du ma/ lha mo dud gsol ma'i rjes gnang thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa/ de'i man ngag be bum yongs rdzogs kyi lung rnams dang / rje grol mchog nas brgyud pa'i khrid brgya/ de dang 'brel pa'i yig skor mtha' dag gi lung rnams stsal cing / khrid brgya gnang dus zhen pa bzhi bral dang sum pa lo tsā ba'i snyan brgyud/ skyid sdug lam khyer rnams nyis khrid kyi tshul du smin par gnang nas/ der tshogs pa thams cad zab rgyas kyi chos tshul mtha' dag la blo gros kyi mig bu gsal bar mdzad pa yin no/ /don de dag la 'di skad smra ste/ kye ma dus ngan snyigs ma'i snang ba'i cha/

/smra shes don go mi yi 'dus rten la/ /'jigs rung ngan song gsum gyi duḥkha'i rgyun/ /lhan cig myong ba'i lho bod dpung gi tshogs/ /sdug bsngal bye bas nyen pa'i 'gro rnams la/ /brtse ldan khyod kyi dmigs med thugs rje yis/ /bde bar 'dren phyir rang nyid ngal dub cha/ /khyad du gsad pa'i mdzad 'phrin legs byas las/ /mtshon gyi char dang 'bru tsha bro nad kyis/ /gtses pa'i nyam thag 'gro ba mang po'i srog /bskyabs te rang gnas bde ba'i drung 'byin pa'i/ /mdzad bzang 'di ko rnam bkra kun gyi rgyan/ /e ma ston mchog thub pa'i dbang po yis/ /rgyal ba'i sras kyi spyod pa rlabs po che/ /ji ltar mdzad dang dpal ldan 'phags pa yis/ /rgya yi mi yur bcad dang 'di mtshungs zhes/ /skal bzang dpyod ldan mtha' dag mgon khyod kyi/ /bsngags brjod lha yi rnga chen phyogs kun tu/ /sgrog dang lhan cig dga' bdes sems gang nas/ /gus pas sor bcu spyi bor lan brgyar sbyor/ /de ltar 'gro kun bde ba'i sar bkod nas/ /rang gi bsti gnas bho ṭa'i rdo rje gdan/ /gang der 'dus pa'i tshogs la tshe sbyin ma'i/ /zab rgyas chos kyi bdud rtsi ci yang spel/ /gzhan yang dpal ldan gshin rje gshed dmar po'i/ /zab chos snying po spros pa med pa'i khrid/ /byin rlabs dang bcas de dang 'brel ba yi/ /chos tshul rgya mtshos blo yi bum pa bkang / /byang sems bdag po dpal ldan a ti sha /brgyud par bcas las 'ongs pa'i bka' gdams kyi/ /chos sgo brgya phrag dus gcig la phye ste/ /kun kyang rgyal sras spyod pa gong 'phel mdzad/ /nag po spyod pa gzugs gzhan zlos pa'i gar/ /grol mchog zhabs kyi spel ba'i khrid brgya dang / /dud gsol lha mo'i rjes gnang rnam pa gnyis/ /de yi man ngag be bum lung dang bcas dang / /gzhan yang bstan pa'i bdag po sa skya pa'i/ /bka' srung tsa turmu kha'i chos skor 'ga'/ /dam pa sangs rgyas thugs bcud zhi byed kyi/

/chos tshul rgya mtshos don gnyer re ba bkang / /e ma rgyun chad med par dus kun tu/ /zab rgyas chos kyi char chen rtag phab pas/ /rang rang skal ba dang 'tshams chos kyi mig /gsal zhing rgyas pa'i mdzad 'phrin 'di ngo mtshar/ /de nas dgung gi bgrang gzhi re gnyis su phebs pa rnam 'phyang zhes pa sa pho khyi lo gsar du shar ba la/ sngon phag rir dbyings pa phyag mdzod nas phebs gsol gyi snyan gsan dbab pa ltar/ rtse chen grong stod pa dpon g.yog bcas spyan 'dren gyi mi sna btang pa zhabs drung du 'byor te/ lha sar lo gsar chen mo'i thog tu phebs dgos tshul gyi snyan 'bul byung ba bzhin las sne so sor phebs chas sogs tshags chud kyi zhal lta gnang / de dus gdan sa na nad rims phran bu yod pas skya ser kun gyis gsol ba btab nas/ dkar phyogs dga' ba gsum pa'i tshes la chos khri chen mor phebs te/ tshe dpag med grub pa'i rgyal mo'i dbang dang / ri khrod ma'i rjes gnang zhig skya ser gyi tshogs la stsal pas nad rims kyi rgyun gtan med du gyur cing / de dus dgun grang ba'i skabs yin yang / dbang mo che gnang nyin nas bzung dpyid sos ltar gdugs 'jam zhing sa gzhi ri klung thams cad drod kyis khyab par gyur nas/ chu 'khyags rnams kyang zhu ba sogs byung bas skye bo kun gyis byin rlabs kyi rtags mtshan 'di 'dra ba ngo mtshar che zhes dad gus lhag par 'phel bar gyur la/ de nas tshes bco lnga rjes kyi nyi shar phyogs su dpon slob rags bsdus shig chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur bar mdzad de dgon pa rgyas su bzhugs/ de nas dar lung gnyan gyi pho brang / gsing ma chu mig sogs rgyud de rkang bzhir phyag phebs pa'i tshe/ gzhi kha bsam 'grub rtse nas sa dbang nor bu'i drung gi zhabs tog dang 'bul nod rgya chen po sgrub cing / de dus rje 'dis bka' gnang nas chu mig bla brang 'di sa skya pa'i rje btsun gong ma du ma'i bzhugs gnas yin pa la da lta phal cher zhig ral du song 'dug pas 'di'i lha khang dang mgon khang la zhig gsos shig mdzad na sku bsod dang sems can gyi bde skyid la phan nges pa 'byung bas de bzhin gyi zhal bkod gnang dgos tshul gyi phebs sgo stsal pas/

sde pa nas kyang bka' bzhin bsgrubs te/ gnas de'i lha khang mgon khang sogs nyams gso/ zhabs tog phul du phyin pa mdzad nas/ gzungs gzhus rab gnas sogs kyang sa skya nas las chen dpon slob rnams rdzong lta mdzad de tshul bzhin du bgyis te kun gyi bsod nams gyi zhing du gyur pa 'di yin la/ de nas dpon slob rnams kyis dpal nam klu lding / bkras 'brong gnyis/ rgyal mkhar rtse/ 'om thang / sna mkhar rtse/ dpal sde/ gan pa 'jigs skyobs dgon pa/ byang thang / chu shul/ ljang / snye thang rnams su rim par phyag phebs te/ gdan sa nas thog mar phebs pa'i dgon pa rgyas nas bzung 'di'i bar la gnas pa'i skye bo skya ser drag zhan kun gyi sangs rgyas mi yul du byon pa lta bu'i dad gus dang bcas/ zhabs tog 'bul snod blo'i ra ba las 'das pa zhig so sor bsgrubs shing / rje nyid kyis kyang rang rang gi bsam pa dang mthun pa'i chos dang 'jig rten gyi bka' mchid zang zing gi gnang skyes rgya che ba stsal pas kun kyang yid mchog tu mgu bar gyur cing / lhag par rgyal rtser phebs nyin dar snar gung tshigs mdzad thog dpal 'khor chos sde'i grwa tshang so so'i bla ma slob dpon las tshan tha dad dang bcas pa'i chibs bsu gzab rgyas kyis spyan drangs te/ rtse chen gyi rdzong gi rtsa bar bzhugs gur yol gor dang bcas pa'i nang du chibs bshol en tsam mdzad nas/ rtse chen gyi grwa tshang so so dang / de phyogs kyi mi sde drag zhan gyis zang zing gi 'bul nod ri ltar spungs shing / dkar spro'i mchod sprin rgya che ba dang / ro brgya ldan pa'i yon chab mtsho bzhin du bskyil bas/ so so nas bdag nyid chen po'i spyan lam du 'bul ba ma thob dogs lta bu'i phan tshun phar phul tshur phul gyi 'phrang la sku 'khor rnams kyang mi thar ba lta bu'i ngang nas/ so so'i bsam pa ltar dgyes par bzhes te tha dad du chos kyi 'brel pa dang /

lugs gnyis kyi bka' mchid gnang skyes bzang po sogs tha dad du bstsal nas/ kun kyang dga' mgu yi rang ste rje nyid la mi phyed pa'i dad pa bla lhag tu 'phel bar gyur pa yin la/ de nas chibs thog khel ba'i dpal 'khor chos sde nas ser 'phreng rgyas pa dang bcas/ gur khang du phyag phebs te bcags mal zhig gdan chags pa'i ring la/ grwa tshang so so'i bla ma las tshan dang bcas pas zang zing gi 'bul snod bgrang ba las 'das pa dang / bsnyen bkur/ zhabs tog ci yang zhig bsgrubs shing / bdag nyid chen pos kyang chos sde spyi dang grwa tshang so sor mang ja bsngo rten spyi 'gyed gya nom pa'i gnang skyes bzang po stsal cing / so so'i bsam pa dang mthun pa'i gsung chos kyi rim pa yang mtha' yas pa zhig stsal te/ der 'dus thams cad bdag nyid chen po la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes lta bu'i dad gus gong 'phel du gyur pa yin no/ /der bzhugs thog sde bdag nas sna dkar rtser phebs bzhugs gsol bar klu lding pa dpon g.yog 'byor don zhal bzhes kyang mdzad/ de nas rim gyis 'om thang du phebs pa'i tshe kha ba chen po 'bab la nye bas dpon slob rnams phebs mi la dka' tshegs chen po byung dogs pa la/ rje nyid kyis gnod sbyin gang ba bzang por gtor ma rgyas pa zhig gnang zhing bka' bsgo mdzad nas/ mchod g.yog par steng du song la rkang gling bus shig ces bka' stsal gnang ba bzhin grub mtshams de ma khad lha lam gyi rang zhal gsar du tshes pas kun kyang grub pa'i dbang po'o zhes ya mtshan du 'dzin par snang la/ de nas kha ro la brgyud ya 'brog sna dkar rtser phebs pa'i tshe sde bdag chen po'i chibs bsu rgya chen po dang / de skor gyi dgon pa so so'i ser 'phreng dang bcas pho brang gi rtser spyan drangs te gnas der zhag gsum gdan chags pa'i ring la dbang dang rjes gnang lung man ngag sogs chos kyi char chen po phab ste der yod thams cad dga' mgu yi rang ba dang bcas sde bdag chen po yang mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob ste rnyed bkur zhabs tog 'bul nod lha'i dpal 'byor la 'gran nus pa lta bus mchod cing /

rgyang ring po'i bar du phebs skyel mdzad pa sogs sri zhu ci yang zhig dang bcas/ slar yang 'di phyogs su phebs dgos pa'i snyan 'bul gsol 'debs zhus shing / de nas dpal sder phebs pa'i tshe/ der yod kyi dpon g.yog kun gyis zhabs tog bla lhag tu bsgrubs shing / de nas 'jigs skyabs dgon pa'i bla brang du bzhugs pa'i tshe/ der yod kyi grwa slob kun la mang ja 'gyed bzang ba dang / so so'i bsam pa dang mthun pa'i gsung chos kyi rim pa du ma stsal pas kun kyang yid tshim par mdzad cing / de'i nangs par bar tshigs su chibs bshol gnang skabs/ skyid tshal phyogs kyi bla ma slob dpon dgon pa'i grwa rigs yon bdag dang bcas pa thams cad 'dzoms nas rje dpon slob rnams la dkar spro dmar spro'i bsnyen bkur/ zang zing gi 'bul ba dpag tu med pa bsgrubs shing / bdag nyid chen pos kyang grwa tshang spyi dang / sger gyi 'dod chos du ma gsol ba btab pa so so'i bsam pa dang mthun pa stsal cing / grwa tshang so sor yang mang ja bsngo rten zang zing gi khal 'gyed sogs lugs gnyis kyi bka' drin chen po stsal pas kun kyang gus pa'i sor bcu spyi bor sbyor zhing / snyan grags phyogs kun tu grags par gyur to/ /de nub gam pa byang thang du phebs pa'i tshe gong dkar rdo rje gdan gyi slob dpon pa rnams dang grwa rigs kyi tshogs du ma dang bcas zhabs drung du 'byor te zhabs tog gya nom pa dang bcas/ yar lam dgon par phebs dgos pa'i gsol ba nan chags su btab cing / bdag nyid chen pos kyang zhal gyis bzhes/ de nas cha shul dang ljang du phebs pa'i tshe/ sngar khog zhugs med pa'i bud med dar ma zhig la glo bur du lha babs te/ nga bdag nyid chen po'i drung du smon lam zhig 'debs par thongs zhes gzim chung gi 'gag tu slebs byung ba sku 'khor rnams kyis bskyil nas ma btang ba la/ rje nyid kyis yar yong mi dgos pa'i phebs sgo bcas stsal pas gnas der rang yal du gyur cing /

'di ni sngon rje nyid dbus la phebs skabs sku 'khor ba grwa pa yan pa zhig gis phyag gi dar 'bog brkus pa la/ chos skyong gi 'khor du gtogs pa zhig grwa pa de rang la khog bzhugs byas nas dar 'bog phyag tu smin 'dug pa de dus kyi chos skyong gi 'khor de ka da lam yang yus kyi tshul gyis nged 'phrad du yong ba yin pa 'dra zhes/ rje nyid gsungs par grags shing / snye thang du phebs pa'i tshe yang / dgon pa so so gra sgrig gi ser 'phreng rgya chen pos spyan drangs te/ grwa tshang tha dad mi sde dang bcas pas bsnyen bkur zhabs tog shin tu zab pa bsgrubs shing bka' chos kyang tshan pa mang po so sor stsal cing / dgon gnas rnams su mang ja bsngo rten spyi 'gyed bzang ba sogs kyis yid tshim par mdzad nas/ nangs par shun rdzong du phebs pa'i tshe 'bras spungs nas rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa dang / lha sa nas dbyings pa phyag mdzod chen po'i drung 'khor rags bsdus kyis chibs bsu gzab ma dang bcas pas lha sar spyan drangs te phebs pa'i nub de nyid la zhabs tog gi rnyed bkur blos mi 'khyud pa tsam bsgrubs shing / de nas lha sar bzhugs ring la skabs skabs su zur chas kyi tshul dang / rgyun par dkar spro'i zhabs tog sogs nar mar phul te/ de nas zhag gnyis song ba'i gza' tshes bzang po'i nyin/ rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa phyag mdzod chen mo gnyis dang mjal phrad gnang bas/ khong dpon slob kyis rje nyid sku 'khor dang bcas pa la ston mo'i gzab gshom rgya che ba dang / phan tshun thugs nang dag pas gsung gleng gi rim pa rgyun ring po'i bar du mdzad cing / de rjes zhag 'ga' nas sog po'i rgyal po rnams dang rje nyid mjal te bar du lo tsā bcug nas gsung gleng mang du mdzad pas rgyal rgyud rnams kyang dad pa lhag par phebs nas thal mo snying khar sbyar te/ bdag nyid chen por gus 'dud kyi rnam pa ci yang zhig byed cing /

slad nas rgyal po so sos kyang zhabs tog tu ci 'gyur byed pa'i dam bca' yang phul ba yin la/ de nas gza' skar bzang ba la jo bo rin po che rang byon lnga ldan bcu gcig zhal sogs lha sa mthil gyi gtsug lag khang rnams kyi rten so so la zhal gser 'bul ba dang bcas mchod pa'i bye brag kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin lta bu gshom par mdzad de/ dpon slob rnams rten mjal la phebs nas/ rten so so'i drung du yan lag bdun pa sngon du 'gro bas phyag dang mchod pa smon lam rgya chen po 'debs par mdzad cing / de nas zhag 'ga' song ba na po ta la'i gtsug lag khang gi rten khyad 'phags phyogs kun nas byon pa thams cad dang / khyad par skyid grong gi 'phags pa wa ti jo bo lo ke shwa ra sogs smon lam gang btab 'grub nges pa de dag gi drung du mchod pa'i bye brag dpag tu med pa dang bcas rje nyid dpon slob rnams kyis yan lag bdun pa phyag mchod sngon du 'gro bas thugs bskyed dang smon lam rgya chen po 'debs par mdzad cing / de nas bzung ste lha sa'i jo shākya'i drung dang po ta la'i rten rnams kyi drung du gzhan la yon gnang nas smon lam gyi rgyun 'dzugs par mdzad de/ dpon slob dag pa'i zhing du 'khrungs pa'i smon lam 'bum ther tshar gnyis dang / yang sa skya rab 'byams pa dpon slob sogs la yon gnang nas smon lam 'bum ther tshar gsum te yongs bsdoms rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i smon lam rnams 'bum ther tshar lnga sgrub par mdzad cing / de mtshams nas rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa dang / bdag cag gi rnam 'dren mtshungs bral dam pa nyid dang zhag bdun gyi bar la snga dro nyi ma shar dros nas/ dgong snur gyi bar phan tshun gdan 'dzoms te mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i dka' gnas mtha' dag la dri ba dris lan gyi tshul gyis so so nas legs bshad kyi rim pa rgyun ma chad pa 'bel gtam du mdzad pas skyes chen gnyis ka so so nas dang 'dod kyi thugs dad lhag par 'phel te/

sngon bsam rtser mjal ba'i skabs las kyang thugs nang dag cing bag phebs par gyur te/ phan tshun thugs gnyis gcig 'dres lta bur gyur pa yin la/ de dag gi gnas skabs thams cad du phyag mdzod chen mo thugs dgyes pa'i ngang nas rje dpon slob rnams la gsol ston rgya chen po rgyun par bsgrubs pa sogs zhabs tog ci yang zhig bsgrubs par mdzad de/ de ltar bdag nyid chen po lha sar zhag bco lnga tsam bzhugs pa'i ring la/ rtse gdong nas bdag chen dbon drung / dwags ma sgom po'i sprul sku/ yongs 'dzin sprul pa'i sku/ rdo rje brag nas sprul sku sogs sprul sku du ma dang / na lend+ra nas bco brgyad dbon po/ ra ba smad kyi mkhan po kun spang / rnam rgyal gser khang bla ma/ skyid tshal bla ma/ sa skya rab 'byams sogs chos sde du ma'i bla ma slob dpon grwa rigs bcas pa mang po dang / sna dkar rtse sde bdag sku mched sogs mi chen du ma dang / gzhan yang skya ser don gnyer can mang pos gsol ba btab pa bzhin/ rje nyid kyis kyang rang rang gi blo dang 'tshams pa'i dbang rjes gnang / lung man ngag khrid che chung sogs gang la gang dgos su thogs med du stsal pas kun kyang dga' zhing mgu nas/ sangs rgyas mi yul du byon pa zer ba de 'di lta bu yin zhes phyogs kun tu sgrog cing / rje nyid la so so nas mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob ste 'bul nod kyang blos mi 'khyud pa tsam byung ba yin no/ /der skabs lha sa'i smon lam chen mo dang stabs 'grig pa nas tshogs chen mor mang ja 'gyed bcas bcu phrag tsam dang / dbus phyogs kyi dgon che phra phal cher la yang mang ja 'gyed bcas rgya dpangs che ba so sor stsal cing / de nas dpal na lend+ra'i bla ma grwa rigs yon bdag so so dang bcas pa'i spyan 'dren gyi pho nya yang yang byung ba dang / bdag nyid chen po rong ston thams cad mkhyen pa de bstan pa spyi sger la bka' drin che ba nas sku gdung mjal ba dang smon lam 'debs par phebs bzhed kyi thugs 'dun rgyun chags su yod par brten/

'phan yul du phebs zhal bzhes tsam stsal skabs/ dpal bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang nas chos skyong chen pos da ni lha mi myur du ma phrad na sgug yun shin tu ring bas 'phral du phebs dgos shing 'phan yul phyogs la byon na rje nyid la sku dog kyang yod tshul gyi rting bskul nan chags byung ba na 'phral du bsam yas la phebs rtsis kyis mchod yon du yang bslab ston zhu ba mdzad de/ de'i nangs par rgyal dbang phyag mdzod dang bcas pas zang zing gi 'bul nod rgya dpang che zhing spus gtsang ba rnam thos bu'i 'byor pa la 'gran par nus pa lta bu'i dpal 'byor gyi mchod sprin blo'i ra ba las 'das pa lta bu bsgrubs shing / gzhan yang mkho dgu'i rnyed bkur gya nom pa dang / slar chos gzhis shig 'bul ba'i zhal bcad bzang po phul/ de nas bsam yas su chibs kyi kha lo phyogs te mchod yon nas drung 'khor rags bsdus skya ser gyis gru kha bar chibs skyel zhus/ der gnang skyes rgya dpang che ba dang lugs gnyis kyi bka' mchid 'phral yun du phan pa stsal pas/ khong rnams gus spros myos te rje nyid kyi zhal dkyil las gzhan du lta bar ma mchis so/ /de nub gung thang du phebs pa'i tshe de phyogs kyi dgon pa'i grwa rigs mi ser bcas pas zhabs tog 'bul nod kyang rgyas par zhus shing / bdag nyid chen pos kyang so so'i bsam pa dang mthun pa'i gsung chos kyi rim pa du ma stsal te so sor yid tshim par mdzad/ de nas gzhi kha bde chen gyi klu lding skyid shod zhabs drung gis gdan drangs te gzhis len rgyas pa'i bsnyen bkur dang zang zing gi 'bul ba dpag med phul te/ de nub pho rog thang du bzhugs pa'i nangs par gser la brgyud de zur mkhar du phebs pa'i tshe/ bsam yas nas mkhan tshang rab 'byams pa thar pa rgyal mtshan sogs lcog pa dpon g.yog rnams dang / chos skyong chen po'i sku rten pa bcas phebs bsur 'byor zhing /

de'i nangs par bsam yas su phebs pa'i bar lam du rab byung grwa tshang gi mkhan po las tshan so sor bcas pa dang / skyid shod zhabs drung nas phebs bsu'i bkod pa rgya chen po dang bcas spyan drangs/ de dus chos skyong chen po bdag nyid chen po'i zhal skyin mjal bar thugs rings par 'phral du phebs pa zhig yong nges zhes kun gleng yang / rje nyid kyi gsung las/ nged na so mtho ba dang lus shed chung bas bsam yas su slebs pa'i nyin chos skyong phebs na lcog sogs su 'gro dgos pa'i lus sems dub pa zhig yong 'dug pas de nyin ma 'byon cig snyam pa byas pas sku phebs mi yong thag chod gsungs pa ltar/ dpon slob chibs rags rnams rdo mchod thang ka'i thad du phebs pa na sku rten par rta thog tu chos skyong phebs la khad pa zhig la yal song bas rje nyid kyi bka' las chos skyong chen pos cung zad kyang mi 'da' bar der yod kun yid ches nas thams cad ha las par gyur cing / de nas rab byung pa rnams kyi ser phreng dang / rnga bo che dang 'cham mgon rnams kyi bsu ba dang / chos skyong chen po'i ljags bkod gnang ba'i 'bag dang / chas gos mi 'dra ba du ma gyon pa'i gzigs mo mchod pa'i bye brag mang po dang bsam yas sde shar nub kyi mi rnams kyi dbu rgyan rus rgyan sogs dpa' bo'i chas sprad pa dang 'bag gyon zhing rol stabs dang bcas 'cham pa'i bkod pa sogs bsu ba'i bye brag mi 'dra ba dpag tu med pa zhig gis rje dpon slob rnams pho brang gong du spyan drangs pa'i nangs par/ chos skyong chen po'i bzhugs gnas sde brgyad rba klong 'khrugs pa'i dpe har lha'i pho brang gi yang rtser rje dpon slob rnams kyis bsang mchod rgyas par mdzad de lha mi mjal phrad mdzad par nye ba na/ smod nas sogs la ma ltos par chos skyong rang babs su byon nas/ re zhig bdag nyid chen po dpon slob rnams lcog gi phyir phebs te/

chos skyong gi gsol go mchod grub bstun rten 'brel legs cha dang bcas mkhan tshang rab 'byams pa rje nyid spyan 'dren la byung bas/ dpon slob rnams lcog gi khyams ra 'og ma'i sgo nang du phebs mtshams/ de gong nas sa skya'i zhal ngo bgres gzhon sogs yul gnyan su phebs kyang chos skyong chen po rdo skas kyi mgor bsu ba la phebs pa tsam kho na yin pa la/ de dus ni 'gro 'dren yongs kyi skyabs gnas bdag nyid chen po la gnod sbyin chen po de nyid shin tu ches pa'i rdo skas kyi sen la mchong zhing lding ba'i rgyug bral dang bcas/ khyams ra 'og ma'i phyi sgo la nye ba'i bar du phebs bsu mdzad de/ lha mi mjal 'phral chos skyong chen pos dbu rmog phud te gus pa'i rnam 'gyur du ma dang bcas spyan drangs te rje dpon slob rnams rdo skas kyi rtser phebs pa dang / chos skyong chen pos sa paṇṭi ta'i bstan pa dar ba'i phyir du lha rgyal thengs gsum bos zhes gsungs pa ltar/ der 'tshogs kyi khrom dmar smug tu 'khyil ba rnams kyis 'brug stong dus gcig la ldir ba lta bu'i lha rgyal thang gsum bos mtshams rje nyid dang chos skyong gnyis khri'u chung so sor bzhugs shing / sku 'khor gyi tshogs rnams zhabs 'bring du 'khod mtshams de ka la/ 'phrin las kyi mgon po dmar po nyid shin tu dgyes pa'i mdangs dang ldan zhing / sku 'khril li li 'dar ba'i sgo nas gus 'dud kyi nyams 'gyur du ma dang bcas/ lha mi gnyis dri ba dris lan gyi tshul du gsung gleng mang du mdzad cing / de dus chos skyong gi gsung las/ dge bshes/ sngon slob dpon chen po'i phyag nas phog pa'i gdug 'dre'i sdig khrab sha gos dang bcas 'di la/ khyed sa skya pa dge bshes rnams kyis zhig gsos mdzad pa las/ gzhan sus kyang byar mi rung bas/ sngon sngags 'chang chen po yab sras rnams kyis nyams gso mdzad pa ltar/

da lam kyang dge bshes kyis phyag len la thebs pa mdzad dgos shing / bzo bo sogs dge bshes rang gi blos bcad pa byas pas chog de nam grub bar dge bshes rang yang bzo bo rnams dang lhan cig tu 'bral med du phebs dgos so/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar de'i nangs par rang nas phyag bzhes su mdzad de bdag nyid chen pos gsung brtag mdzad pa'i 'os bab kyi bzo bo rnams dang bcas gsol khrab/ khrab gdan dbu rmog dang bcas pa'i nyams gso la rtsol thon mdzad pas phal cher grub kyang / tshes gsum sku phebs dang thug ches pas ma tshar dogs sku rten pa dang / rgyun par gsol khrab 'bul ba'i lcog gi grwa pa de gnyis kyis bka' ma byung yang bzo bo rnams kyi las grogs byas pa la chos skyong gi 'khu ldog gi rnam pas khong gnyis la de ma thag lus la shu 'bur mi zad pa du mas btab ste so sos nas 'jigs shing ha las par gyur nas/ bdag nyid chen por ljags sngags zhus te byung bas gzhi med du dwangs pa'i byin rlabs mngon gyur can byung zhing / de dus chos skyong chen po'i gsung gi gdug 'dre'i dpe dkar gyi dngos spyad rnams la gzhan gyi 'jug cha med pas dge bshes kyi deb du khyon pa'i phyag dam 'byar ma zhig mdzad dgos zhus pa la/ nyid kyi 'phrin las pa chen po phyag mdzod bsod nams rab brtan kyi zhal bkod kyi rgyas btab lugs gnyis spyan yangs pa mi dbang rnam rgyal rdo rjes phyag bris 'khur bzhes nas zhag gnyis kyi khongs su deb bris su btab ste bdag nyid chen po'i phyag dam 'byar ma mkhan tshang rab 'byams pa'i lag tu 'jog par mdzad cing / de nas tshes gsum gyi nyin sku phebs zab ma dang bcas gsol khrab khrab gdan dbu rmog dang bcas pa nyams gsos mdzad pa de thog mar bzhes pa de dang bstun/ bdag nyid chen pos kyang 'phrin las kyi mgon po dmar po de nyid la/ bkral thag kho na las grub pa'i khyad gos kyi khrab gdan de khas thog drangs/

khrab rmog gri gsum ja gos dar stag lpags grwa sder ma nyams pa lha rta bzang ba sogs spyan gzigs 'bul nod rgya dpang chen po stsal cing / chos skyong chen po'i dgongs bzhed ltar du 'grub pas shin tu dgyes te khrom chen por ngom pa ltar mdzad de/ de nas lcog gi sbug tu lha mi gnyis bka' bgros kyang yun ring du mdzad la/ de dus chos skyong rang gi dgongs pa la rje nyid bsam yas su bzhugs ring la yang yang du lha mi mjal ba zhig dgongs par 'dug kyang rje nyid sku khams ngan pas skabs skabs su mjal chog pa'i sed bkrol gnang bas chos skyong gis kyang zhal gyis bzhes shing / de dus stag rtse nas skyid shod zhabs drung bsam yas su phebs pa rje nyid dang mjal ba'i tshe zhal dkyil gzigs ma thag dad pa lhag par g.yos shing / slar sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad 'phrin gzigs pas mi phyed pa'i dad pa skyes te bka' chos kyi rim pa yang mang du zhus shing / brnyed bkur gyi zhabs tog kyang rgya dpang chen po rgyun du bsgrubs pa dang / lhag par kong yul gyi dkar lugs kyi bla ma zho kha bar grags pa dbyings sa chen mo nas btson du bzung ste/ stag rtser gtad 'dug pa slar 'bab ldan ma'i dkyil 'khor du dag byed kyi cho ga bskrun par mdzad dgos shar zhing / de'i tshe khong gis smon lam log pa du ma btab pa'i rkyen gyis 'byung po gdug pa can zhig tu skyes te/ skyid shod zhabs drung mtsho skyes rdo rje de nyid 'byung po des khog zhugs dang bcas glo bur du khyer pa'i thugs rtog shin tu che ba yod pa la/ bdag nyid chen pos sa skyar bzhugs dus gshin 'dre gdug pa can 'ga' zhig la lam ston bskyar nas mdzad pas/ gnas ngan nas 'phos pa'i rtags mtshan gsal por byung ba'i snyan grags la brten/ bdag nyid chen por nang sbyar gyi bslab ston zhus te zho kha bla mas thog drangs de dus bsam yas na gshin 'dre gdug pa can sum cu rtsa grangs shig yod pa thams cad dus gcig la lam ston mdzad dgos pa'i gsol ba btab pa la/

rje nyid kyis chos skyong sku phebs byung ba zhig la de bzhin gyi grogs dan mdzad dgos pa'i bka' stsal gnang ba na/ gdug 'dre la yang las 'chol ba la kho bo yod kyang / da lam dge bshes kyi ngo la btang bas chog gsungs pa bzhin/ nangs par lam ston gnang rgyu'i do nub 'byung po de rje'i zhabs drung du thal gyis byung nas gus 'dud kyis 'dren gsol sogs zhus 'dug pas/ nangs par sku 'khor ba 'ga' zhig la de bzhin gyi gnas tshul bka' stsal te/ bdag nyid chen po dpon slob mang ba zhig gis kun rig gi cho ga rgyas par mdzad nas lam ston mdzad pa'i tshe gshin 'dre rnams kyi ming byang sreg chog mdzad pa na/ shog bu bsregs pa'i dri med par mi ro bsregs pa'i dri 'dra ba zhig thul gyis byung nas/ bsam yas gnyer pa gnyis dang sku rten pa bcas zhabs drung na yod pas dngos su tshor bas khong rnams ha las par gyur cing / de rjes kyi chos skyong sku phebs pa zhig la dge bshes kyi lam ston gyi nus pas gshin 'dre rnams 'phos yod pas/ gdug 'dre'i ba dan 'di khyer la stag rtse'i sku mkhar rnams bshig ste da phan bdag rkyen ma byed cig de bzhin du gshin 'dre rnams kyi rten mkhar rnams bshig cing mchod yal sogs byed mi dgos gsungs byung ba bzhin kun la dril bsgrags te dpon g.yog kun gyis phyag len la theb par mdzad pas/ de phyin chad gshin 'dre rnams kyi gnod pa byung ba'i gtam gzhi med du gyur pa 'di ni rje nyid kyi mthu stobs dang nus mthu'i byin rlabs la brten/ gshin po de rnams dang mi phyug bgrang ba las 'das pa zhig gi srog bskyabs pas mi 'jigs pa'i skyabs kyi sbyin pa bla na med pa stsal pa 'di yang gzhan las phul du byung ba'i rnam thar du snang ngo / /bsam yas su bzhugs ring de dag gi bar la rab byung chos sde'i grwa pa rnams dang / phyogs nas byon pa'i dgon so so'i bla ma grwa rigs du ma 'dus pa la/

kyai rdo rje'i la dbang / rgyu dbang / bdag med ma'i lha mo bco lnga'i dbang / rdo rje phur pa'i dbang / tshe dpag med lha dgu dang / grub rgyal ma/ lcags sdong ma/ grub chen nas brgyud pa'i tshe dbang / rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs/ gur mgon lha brgyad/ zhal bzhi pa/ dur khrod bdag po/ bu tra ming sring / dkar bdud lcam bral/ bran bdud rnams kyi so so'i rjes gnang / rnam rgyal rnam 'joms/ seng ge sgra/ sman bla/ bka' gdams nas brgyud pa'i sgrol ma nyer gcig khyung nag khyung khra/ 'byung 'dul rnams kyi rjes gnang dang / sman bla'i mdo brgyad brgya pa mdo chog dang bcas pa/ rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i bsam yas kyi gnas bshad chen mo/ sngags 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i chab gtor klu gtor gyi yi ge gtor ma brgya rtsa/ 'od dpag med kyi nyal 'pho/ sa paṇa dang 'jam dbyangs sbrags sgrub kyi chos rgyal ma'i 'don thabs/ slob dpon padma'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ thugs rje chen po'i sgom lung sogs/ de ltar dbang rjes gnang lung byin rlabs bsgom lung sogs chos kyi 'khor lo nyin mtshan med pa bskor ba mdzad de/ der 'dus thams cad 'dod chos kyi re ba yongs su rdzogs nas thams cad mgrin gcig par da lo gser gyi pha bong sgo 'grim gyi ngo mtshar dang bsod nams che ba 'di lta bu 'byung ba zhes thams cad gus pa'i rnam 'gyur dang bcas snyan grags phyogs kun tu sgrog par byed cing / de skabs nyin gcig dkar zhal mthil gyi mkhan po bo dhi sa twa'i bzhugs khri'i steng nas bsam yas kyi skya ser gyi steng / phyogs nas 'dus pa'i skye bo khri phrag tu longs pa la/ tshe dbang grub rgyal ma'i dbang mo che rgyas par stsal te so so nas 'bul nod kyang rgya chen po bsgrubs pa yin la/ de nas gza' skar bzang ba'i nyin dpal bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang dbu rtse'i rigs gsum gling bzhi gling phran brgyad dang bcas pa'i lha khang rnams la mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas dpon slob rnams rim par phebs te/

phyag dang yan lag bdun pa sngon du 'gro bas thugs bskyed bzang po dang bcas smon lam rgya chen po 'debs par mdzad cing / yang nyin gcig chos rgyal chen po dang / chos skyong chen po gnyis sku phebs thog bdag nyid chen po spyan drangs te lcog tu phebs pa'i tshe/ chos skyong chen pos bka' bskul te/ lha mi gsum/ skyid shod zhabs drung so so'i zhabs 'bring pa'i tshogs dang bcas/ dbu rtse chen mo'i byang chub chen po'i drung du phebs te/ chos skyong gnyis skyid shod zhabs drung rnams kyis thog drangs der 'dus kyi skya ser mang du tshogs pa rnams la bdag nyid chen pos slob dpon rin po che'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang 'brel bar rang nyid kyi mdzad pa'i slob dpon rin po che'i gsol 'debs bsam pa myur 'grub ma'i ljags lung stsal te/ de nang gi bzhed don rnams tshul bzhin du 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzad dgos pa chos skyong gnyis la bka' stsal pas/ khong gnyis kyis kyang de bzhin du sgrub par zhal gyis bzhes shing / de skabs chos skyong chen pos skyid shod zhabs drung la dpal bsam yas res su bor ba byas mi chog pa'i bka' nan che ba tsam stsal pa la/ bdag nyid chen pos khong sku mched 'di pa tshos bsam yas kyi lha khang sogs la zhig gsos yang dag mdzad 'dug pas chos skyong rnam gnyis kyis kyang skyid shod zhabs drung 'di pa la sku tshe la bar chad med cing thugs bsam bzhin 'grub pa mdzad dgos/ lhag par sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che 'di bsrung zhing skyong ba dang / 'gro ba sems can la bde skyid 'byung ba'i byed por slob dpon rin po che padma 'byung gnas kyis bka' bsgos pa bzhin/ da lta sngags 'chang bdag gis dran gsos btab pa ltar mi g.yel ba'i bka' sgo smra thag chod pa zhig stsal pas/ der 'dus kyi skya ser mang pos thos shing sems thog tu smin pas bdag nyid chen por dad pa lhag par g.yos te la la ni mig chu rang dbang med par gtong zhing lus kyis phyag mang du 'tshal/

la la ni sems hod hod pos rje nyid la mig btsum med du lta/ la la ni bstod dbyangs 'ur dir du 'don pa sogs byung 'dug cing / skabs der mchod yon gnyis kar chos skyong gi bkas bskul ba bzhin gza' skar bzang ba'i nyin bdag nyid chen po dpon slob mang ba zhig gis dbu rtse chen mor kye rdor la brten pa'i rab gnas nyin gang ma rgyas par mdzad de/ phyi dro'i dus la bab pa'i tshe gtsug lag khang sde dang bcas pa rnams la phyag nas kyi phyir zhabs skor la phebs pa'i tshe/ chos skyong chen po yang sku phebs pa'i zhabs 'bring pa'i tshul du chas te rim gyis dkar zhal mthil du phebs pa na/ lha mi gnyis skyid shod zhabs drung bcas pa'i spyan lam du lcog pa rnams kyis gu ru mtshan brgyad kyi 'cham gyi gzigs mo'i mchod 'bul rgyas par bsgrubs/ de nyin gdugs shin tu 'jam zhing lha lam gyi ngos la rnam bkra'i 'dzum rlabs kyis mdzes par spud/ me tog gi char dang / ngo mtshar ba'i ltas gzhan dpag tu med pas rang gzhan snang ba'i dga' ston du gyur cing dad pa'i sgo 'phar yang dbye ba lags/ de nas dbu rtse chen mor lha mi dpon slob kun phebs te/ rje nyid kyi gsung bsngo nam rdzogs par chos skyong nyid kyang zhabs drung du bzhugs te/ de grub 'phral lcog tu chos skyong shin tu myur ba'i rgyug bral gyis phebs te sku gsang ba'i tshul mdzad cing / de skabs skyid shod zhabs drung nas dpon slob rnams la bsnyen bkur zhabs tog shin tu rgya che ba dang / 'bul nod kyang dpag tu med pa bsgrubs shing / de nas chos skyong gi bka' bzhin/ de'i nyin dang po nas bzung ste gling bzhi gleng phran sogs lha khang zhig gsos grub pa rnams la rje nyid dpon slob rags bsdus shig gis phebs te rim pa bzhin phyag nas smin rgyas su mdzad de der yod kyi lha mi kun gyi re ba yongs su gang bar mdzad pa yin la/

de nas nyin gcig chos skyong chen po'i bkas bskul te mdo sde lha mchod chen mo'i skabs bzhin rab byung dpon slob rnams kyis las mkhan ru 'dren dang dmar hrang nag hrang bcas pa'i gar 'cham zab mo'i gzigs mo phul dus/ de dus bdag nyid chen pos pu tra 'chams pa rnams kyi rol stabs dang bstun dbu dang phyag gi 'cham tshul gyis rnam pa cung zad mdzad pas/ de la 'phrin las kyi mgon po dmar po shin tu dgyes nas bdag cag gi 'dren pa bdag nyid chen po 'di kho na la gzigs pa las gzhan du yan pa cung zad kyang med pa'i tshul bstan cing / khrom pa rnams kyang de dang 'dra bar mig mi 'dzum par lta zhing / gus spro'i snying pa spyi bor 'god par gyur la/ de lta bu'i tshul gyi snga dro'i cha phal cher 'das nas/ phyi dro la babs pa na rje 'di ni chos skyong gnyis ka sgo dmar gyi mdun du bzhugs khri la zhabs zung 'khod pa'i drung du chos skyong rang nyid kyi 'khor/ spre'u 'cham pa/ bab rdzu ba/ gar pa rnams kyi gzigs 'bul tshar ba dang / a tsa ra mang po'i 'cham stabs dang bstun 'phrin las kyi mgon po de nyid kyang gar 'cham gyi nyams 'gyur ya ma zung du gnang ba sogs nyin dang po gzigs mo'i mchod 'bul ci yang zhig mdzad de/ de dag la rje nyid kyis dgyes nyams chen pos gzigs pa na chos skyong yang lhag par mnyes te bdag nyid chen po dang 'cham pa rnams la yang yang gzigs pa sogs mdzad pas der yod kun na re/ chos skyong chen po la sngags 'chang bla ma 'di thugs dgyes na snyam pa kho na las gzhan du dgongs pa cung zad kyang med pa de ring gi mdzad tshul de kas shes 'dug chos skyong chen pos rgyun du gdug 'dre la sgom rgyu slob dpon padma dang / bsam rgyu sa skya dge bshes las med gsungs pa de don la gnas par 'dug go /zhes kun kyang ngo mtshar ba'i gnas su gyur la/ yang lan cig chos skyong nyid glo bur du phebs nas/

rje 'di la lcog tu phebs dgos pa'i snyan 'bul byung ba bzhin de 'phral phyag phebs te lha mi gnyis gsung gleng rgyas pa mdzad pa'i mtshams shig na/ chos skyong chen pos smod nas zhig mdzad song bas phyag mthil du nas rdog gcig bab byung ba de ma thag chos skyong thugs dgyes nyams dang bcas nas rdog de rje 'di la yang yang gzigs 'bul zhing / dge bshes kyis 'di go e byung zhes yang yang zhu ba gnang song ba re zhig cang mi gsung bar gda'/ dar tsam nas de cis kyang go byung go byung zhes dbu 'jog dang bcas nyis bstud du gsungs pa na/ chos skyong yang thugs spro ba dang bcas nas rdog de zhal du btab nas khyur mid mdzad song bas cung zad mid dka' ba tsam gyi tshul du 'dug pa la/ mkhan tshang rab 'byams pas rgyus yod kyi chang phud cig zhus song pa des rta byas nas bzhes grub 'phral sku had kyis bzhengs nas/ de res kyang gdug 'dres dge bshes kyi bstan pa'i sha trun zhig la bkod pa byas pa yin pa/ shug sdong rtsa bar sha sna mang po bsregs pa'i gsur dud chen po zhig sbyor gsungs shing / de phyogs la yang yang gzigs pa zhig mdzad kyin 'dug pas/ der yod thams cad rje nyid dang chos skyong chen por shin tu 'jigs shing dad pas a la la de ring gi gnas tshul de 'dra ni bstan dgra rnams la bka' bsgo 'phrin bcol la ma ltos par/ ma bcol bzhin du chos skyong rang gis drag po'i 'phrin las kyi las rnams mdzad pa'i mtshon don yang dag par snang bas kun kyang bag yod byos shig ces zer zhing ngo mtshar ba'i gnas su gyur to/ /yang de dang dus mi ring ba zhig na skyid shod zhabs drung nas chos skyong sku phebs zhus pa'i tshe/ rje nyid kyang gdan drangs nas phebs te/ phan tshun gsung gleng rgyang tsam mdzad pa'i skabs shig chos skyong chen po shug sdong de'i rtse mo'i phyogs la rgyun ring po zhig spyan sdang mig tu gzigs shing /

zhal ras kyang rab tu 'jigs shing khro gtum rngam pa'i stabs kyi ngang nas sku har gyis bzhengs te khyams ra steng 'og gi phyogs kun tu yang yang gzigs shing phyag gi brda du ma mdzad pas de'i nye skor kun na 'khor sde brgyad mang po bun long longs su yod do snyam pa'i 'jigs rngam dang bcas/ yang shug sdong gi rtsa bar sha sna mang po bsreg pa'i gsur dud chen po zhig sbyor ba'i bkod pa mdzad nas/ chos skyong chen po rje 'di nyid kyi drung du byon te/ da res kyang bstan pa yongs la 'tshe ba'i byad ma zhig la gdug 'dres bkod pa byas pa yin no/ /zhes zhu ba na/ bdag nyid chen pos de bzhin ngo mtshar che/ chos skyong khyed sngon tshe shākya'i rgyal pos dpal rta mgrin gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur spu gri dmar po snying gi rgyud gsungs/ de rjes slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyis slar yang dbang bskur cing gsang mtshan kun khyab rdo rje drag po rtsal du btags/ de rjes nged rang sa skya pa'i gdung rgyud dpal ldan bla ma dam pa/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje sogs gdung rgyud rim pa du mas bstan pa spyi bye brag du mar bka' bsgos shing chos skyong du mdzad/ lhag par sngags 'chang bstan pa'i nyi ma kun dga' rin chen gyis bsam yas kyi gtsug lag khang zhig gsos dgos pa thams cad mdzad/ rab byung gi chos sde gsar du btsugs/ khyed rang bzhugs gnas lcog 'di 'dra zhal bkod gnang / de rnams kyi srung mar bka' bsgos dam bzhag mdzad 'dug pa bzhin/ chos skyong rang yang de dag gi dam tshig las cung zad kyang mi 'gal ba 'di bzhin mdzad pa rjes su yi rang / nged kyang sems can gyi bde skyid dang bstan pa spyi bye brag lhag par sngags 'chang chen po'i bstan pa'i rgyun 'di gzhi byes gang du yang ma nyams pa zhig byung na snyam pa 'di kho na lhang lhang las gzhan bsam rgyu med pas/ des na rang re lha mi gnyis thugs 'dod gcig pa'i rten 'brel gyis nged kyi yid la bsam don thams cad ched gtad ma bcol kyang chos skyong rang gis rang mi rang las kyi 'phrin las sgrub pa yin mod/

da dung yang de bzhin mdzad dgos/ khyed gzugs med mthu bo che rnams kyis de bzhin ma mdzad na/ nged gzugs can nyam chung rnams kyis gang yang thub par mi gda'o/ /zhes rje nyid kyis gsung shugs chen po bcas bka' mang du stsal pa na/ chos skyong chen po'i bzhin ras bsdus pa'i 'jigs rngam de bshig nas/ zhal 'dzum mdangs dang bcas rje 'di la gzigs shing sku byin kyang zhum mdzad pas bka' bzhin bsgrub par zhal gyis bzhes pa'i rtags dbu gug gug mang du mdzad pa der yod kun gyis mthong ba na thams cad 'jigs shing ya mtshan pa'i gnas su gyur te/ e ma ngo mtshar che/ sngon sngags 'chang chen po'i dus 'di 'dra ba'i gnang tshul zhig rgyun du yong gi yod 'dug kyang / de'i rjes kyi zhal ngo gdung rgyud bgres gzhon su la yang 'di 'dra ba rang byung bar ma grags/ da lta ni sa skya zhabs drung nas bstan pa dgongs pa'i gdung shugs dang / chos skyong chen pos kyang de'i bka' las mi 'da' ba'i gsan 'jog gzhan las che ba mdzad pa 'di 'dra ni rje 'di nyid sngags 'chang chen po de slar yang bsam bzhin du byon par nges pa'i rnam thar yin yang dag go /zhes yid gnyis dang bral ba'i dad pa lhag par 'phel bar gyur to/ /de lta bu'i lha mi mjal ba'i gnas skabs thams cad du sku rten la chos skyong phebs pa'i tshe rgyun pa'i sku rten gyi lus kyi bongs dang bzhin ras thams cad 'gyur nas/ chos skyong sku bongs che zhing shangs gzengs mtho la bzhin ras rab tu bsdus shing / spyan yang kun la sdang mig tu gzigs pas phal cher gyis blta mi nus pa zhig 'byung ba la/ chos skyong chen po rje nyid la nam gzigs kyang bzhin bsdus pa de zhig nas 'dzum pa'i mdangs dang bcas sku yang zhum mdzad de gus pa'i rnam 'gyur ston pa der yod kun gyis mthong bas rje nyid la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes kyis dad pa'i thal mo rgyun du sbyor bar gyur to/

/de nas zhag 'ga' nas yang chos skyong sku phebs byung ba'i tshe bdag nyid chen po phebs pa na/ sngon slob dpon padmas bam ro'i sgrub pa mdzad dus kyi bar snang du rang byon du 'khrungs pa'i chos skyong rang gi zhal 'bag phir ra smug chung du grags pa dang / rgyal po chags pa'i rten rdzas rnams rje nyid la gzigs 'bul mdzad de slar yang phyag rgyas 'debs par zhus pa bzhin du de bzhin mdzad cing / de dus mthu stobs kyi mnga' bdag nyid kyi gsung las/ da ni bsam yas su/ sdod yun yang 'gyang tsam song zhing dgos byed rnams kyang phal cher grub byung bas nged rnams tshes bcu dgu tsam la thon pa zhig byas na ji ltar 'ong / zhes chos skyong la dri ba mdzad pa na/ de dus chos rgyal chen po yang sku phebs yod pas khong gnyis kyis mgrin gcig tu/ dge bshes kyis de ltar mdzad pas mi yong / nged gzugs med rnams dge bshes rang gi 'phrin las sgrub pa'i phyir nyin re bzhin rlung 'tshub 'dra ba'i skor re sgyir re dge bshes rang gi lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs kyin yod pa de yin yang / khog pa la brten pa'i gzugs can rnams khra sog ste 'dzoms pa 'di shin tu dka' bas nyer lnga'i bar cis kyang bzhugs dgos zhes zhus pa bzhin bdag nyid chen pos kyang zhal gyis bzhes shing / slar nyer bzhi la chos skyong gnyis ka sku phebs thog rje dpon slob rnams kyang phyag phebs pa na/ sngar gyi rgyun mthud de 'phral du phebs chog pa bsed bkrol mdzad pa na chos rgyal chen pos kyang dge bshes zla re zla gnyis bzhugs rgyu yin na dga' ba la a dga' ba la a zhes gsungs shing shin tu thugs 'phreng ba'i rnam pa dang / chos skyong chen pos kyang dge bshes 'phral du phebs rgyu yin na gdug 'dre'i khra chung sgor mo'i bkod pa 'di mthong e byung gsungs shing spyan chab nyil gyis gnang byung bas/ mkhan tshang rab 'byams pas de bzhin mdzad mi dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan mang du phul zhing /

rje nyid kyis kyang a ma lha chen po khyod 'dra ba gnyis kyis nga mi gcig bsdad na snyam pa lhang lhang tsher tsher gyi thugs de bzhin yod phyin/ nged kyis kyang de bzhin dang len ma zhus na don ma go rang du 'gro ba 'dug pas/ de na nyer brgyad kyi bar sdod lugs zhus/ nyer dgu la rta thog khel ba byed dgos 'dug pa la khyed chos skyong rnams kyis 'phrang chag med cing gdugs 'jam pa sogs lam bar bde zhing bar chad med pa'i 'phrin las kyang mdzad dgos so zhes gsungs pas na/ chos skyong gnyis kyang thugs dgyes shing de ltar du zhal gyis bzhes par gyur pa yin la/ de dag gi skabs shig de snga nas chos skyong sku phebs byung res kyis ja phud phul dus ja mchod rim par byed pa la/ tshig ris nges pa med pa'i bskul mkhan rang gi blo la gang yod kyi rgyas bsdus sna tshogs yong ba'i gang dran lag len du 'debs pa zhig las mi snang ba la/ de dus chos skyong nyid kyi bkas bskul zhing / mkhan tshang rab 'byams thar pa rgyal mtshan gyis kyang rtil bskul zhus pa bzhin rje nyid kyis ja mchod 'chi med dpal ster mar mtshan gsol ba'i tshig legs kyi 'khri shing don gyi 'bras bus dud pa 'di yang 'phral de nyid du thugs rtsom gnang nas chos skyong phebs re bzhin chag med du byed dgos rgyu bka' stsal dang bcas gsar du 'dzugs pa gnang ba yin la/ de nas nyer brgyad kyi nyin chos skyong gnyis sku phebs te/ rje 'di nyid spyan 'dren pa byung ba bzhin phebs te/ de dus chos skyong chen pos sdig khrab khrab gdan dang bcas pa rnams kyi nyams gso mdzad pa sogs kyi bka' drin gsob phyir ja gos dar/ rol mo khyad 'phags/ rta sga skor sogs 'bul nod rgya dpang che ba mdzad pa la/ rje nyid kyis khyed rang bstan pa spyi sker bsrung ba'i las yang dag pa mdzad dgos shing / 'di rnams nga mi zhu gsungs nas/ 'bul cha rnams phyir stobs par mdzad pa na/

chos skyong chen po nyid khri chung nas yang skyar bzhengs shing bzhes dgos par gsol ba btab nas/ rol mo phyir slog gzhan rnams bzhes pa'i tshul mdzad cing / de nas lcog gi sbug tu rgyun ring po'i bar du lha mi rnams bka' bgro ba dang 'phrin bcol bka' bsgo mdzad dgos rnams rgyas par grub mtshams chos skyong chen po'i gsung las sngon sngags 'chang chen po dgung lo drug cu re drug bzhes pa'i tshe bsam yas su phebs pa bzhin/ dge bshes kyang dgung lo de tsam lon pa na byon nas slar yang mjal 'dzoms byed pa'i khas len dam tshig byed dgos gsungs pa la/ rje nyid kyis kyang de bzhin gyi zhal bzhes mdzad cing / de kha'i rten 'brel gyi sgo 'phar bye phyir chos skyong gis khrab gdan dkar po zhig bzhes nas rgyang tsam zhabs drung du bzhugs shing gsung gleng mol bar mdzad mtshams shig rje 'di nyid kyi bka' las nged rnams sang 'gro ba la nyi dug med cing 'jam la bsil ba zhig dgos 'dug pa de bzhin gyi nus ldan mdzod cig ces gsungs pa na/ de nyin chu 'dzin lang long du 'du bas nyin byed kyang 'phel 'grib tu snang ba zhig yod pa la/ chos skyong chen po des nam mkhar spyan hur gzigs pa dang lhan cig dge bshes bsil drod 'di tsam gyis es 'thus gsungs pa na/ bdag nyid chen pos nged kyi khams la bsil ba 'phrod kyin yod pas 'di las kyang bsil ba 'jam pa zhig yong ba mdzod gsungs pa na de bzhin byed par zhus/ de nas phebs skyel gyi tshe gsol khrab dbu rmog sogs zab rgyas bzhes nas/ chos skyong chen po rje 'di nyid sku 'khor ba'i tshogs dang bcas/ khyams ra steng gi rdo skas kyi mgor phebs par nye ba na/ de snga nas chos rgyal chen po phebs skyel la 'byon pa zhig med pa la/ de dus myur bar rje nyid kyi drung du byon nas bdag nyid chen po'i phyag g.yon pa chos rgyal chen po'i phyag g.yas pas bcang bcang pa lan gnyis 'jus nas/

dge bshes zab yang mthil du slar yang lan gcig 'byon pa'i dam tshig de khas blangs/ sos theg rang mdzad dgos so zhes nyis bstud du zhu ba la rje nyid kyis kyang de bzhin bgyid do zhes zhal gyis bzhes shing / de nas khyams ra 'og ma'i phyi sgo'i bar chos skyong chen pos phebs skyel mdzad de lha mi myur du 'phrad pa byed do zhes yang yang gsungs shing / rje btsun dpon slob rnams la spyan mi 'dzum par rgyun ring gi bar du gzigs shing / bdag nyid chen pos kyang phyir mig gzigs pa na chos skyong chen pos dbu gug yang yang mdzad pa'i thugs shin tu 'phrang ba'i rnam 'gyur du ma ston pa mdzad cing / de ltar rten 'brel shin tu legs pa'i dge mtshan dang bcas chos skyong chen po lcog dang / rje dpon slob rnams pho brang gong du phebs pa na/ skyid gshong zhabs drung nas bsnyen bkur 'bul dpang che ba bsgrubs shing / phar gnang skyes stobs pa rnams sna gcig kyang ma bzhes pa phyir 'bul zhus/ rang re mchod dpon mjal bas bsam pa rdzogs shing dad gus kha zhe med pa byung bas/ da cha nged kyi 'di phyi'i legs nyes thams cad rje bla ma khyed rang la re ba ni snying thag pa nas yin pas/ slar yang bsam yas su lan gcig phebs thub pa cis kyang mdzad dgos shing zhabs pad kyang skye 'gro'i gtsug rgyan du yun ring brtan pa'i thugs 'dun sogs mdzad dgos pa'i snyan 'bul yang thugs bsam rmad du byung ba'i sgo nas phul/ rje nyid kyis kyang gang ci'i bslab bya lhug stsol gnang ste thugs yid gcig 'dres kyi legs tshogs phun sum tshogs pa byung ba yin la/ de skabs mgon khang gsar bzhengs chen mor zla re bzhin tshes bcu la bskang rgyun rgyas pa gsar du 'dzugs pa dang / rab byung chos sder chos gzhis rgya dpang che ba gsar du 'bul ba'i zhal bzhes phul ba bzhin slar phyag len la theb par mdzad pa 'di yin la/

rje dpon slob rnams bsam yas su bzhugs ring la rab byung chos sder mang ja 'gyed bcas la grangs mang ba dang / yang mang ja sbyor sbrel thog gser 'gyed kyang stsal cing / dge 'dun tshogs par zhabs tog zla med du gnang / tshogs khro chen po zhig kyang sbyor 'jags mdzad/ mi sde rnams la chos dang zang zing gis tshim par stsal pas/ sngar nas kyang bsam yas pa lha mi kun sa skya pa rang la gus zhen che ba la/ slar rdor 'dzin yongs kyi mgon po 'di nyid dang dngos su mjal zhing chos dang zang zing gi bka' drin skya ser thams cad du stsal pas dad pa'i spu long g.yos te/ gus zhen gting tshugs su gyur pa 'di yang sngags 'chang chen po'i 'phrin las kyi rgyun gong 'phel du skyong ba la 'di bas lhag pa su yang ma byung ba sha chags la/ de dus bsam yas gnyer pa la bka' gnang nas/ sngar zhig bzos ma grub pa sangs rgyas dga' ba dpal gyi bzhugs gnas/ nyi zla gnyis kyi lha khang / dbu tshal gser khang / mkhan po'i bzhugs khri sogs la nyams gso zhabs tog 'phral du byed dgos tshul dang / rje nyid kyi gser sku phyag tu byung ba'i rigs grangs mang ba zhig mkhan tshang rab 'byams par gnang ba'i slar zhig gsos grub 'phral dga' ba dpal gyi steng du sgrig dgos pa'i zhal bkod sogs gnang ba yin no/ /don de dag la 'di skad smras ste/ 'dzam gling bstan pa'i bdag po skyes chen khyed/ /'dzam gling sa la dbang bsgyur mchod yon gyis/ /'dzam gling yul phyogs mchog gyur dbus phyogs su/ /'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan khyod spyan drangs tshe/ /de tshe dbyig 'dzin la spyod skye bo'i tshogs/ /nyi zer rdul la 'gran pa'i bgrang yas dang / /ngur smrig gos 'chang shākya'i rjes zhugs pa'i/ /dge 'dun 'bum phrag 'du ba'i chos grwa cher/ /gcig min du mar mgon khyod sku bskyod tshe/ /rang rang khams dang bsam pa ji bzhin du/ /zab rgyas chos kyi char chen 'bebs pa dang /

/zang zing nor gyi sbyin pa bgrang yas pa/ /ri ltar spungs shing mtsho ltar bskyil ba yis/ /dga' ston nam mkha'i khyon la 'gran nus pa'i/ /dpal 'byor rgya mtshos 'gro kun tshim byed sogs/ /ngo mtshar lugs gnyis mdzad pa skyong bzhin pas/ /rim gyis chos 'khor lha sa'i gtsug lag khang / /'gran bral jo shāka bzhugs pa'i bsti gnas der/ /mgon khyod zhabs zung 'khod tshe phyogs de yi/ /mchog dman skye bo thams cad dad gus kyis/ /lhag bsam yar ngo'i zla ltar rab 'phel te/ /rgyal dbang mchog dang thams cad mkhyen pa khyed/ /zhag mang bar du mdo sngags rig gnas kyis/ /bsdus pa'i shes bya'i dkyil 'khor mtha' dag la/ /'bel gtam mdzad pas phan tshun so so nas/ /dang 'dod dad pas thugs yid gcig 'dres shing / /de bzhin bod sog mi dbang mchog rnams kyang / /gus pas thal mo spyi bor rtag sbyor zhing / /dpal 'byor du mas bsnyen cing bkur ba yis/ /rgyun chad med par mchod ces ljongs 'dir grags/ /de nas bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa yis/ /gtsug lag khang gi gnas mchog dam pa der/ /bdag nyid chen po 'khor bcas sku bskyod tshe/ /gnas de'i srung ma sde brgyad yongs kyi gtso/ /'phrin las mgon po gnod sbyin dmar po dang / /chos rgyal chen po la sogs drag shul tshogs/ /thub dbang nyid dang padma 'byung gnas kyis/ /dam bzhag gdug can gzugs med gtso kun kyang / /rje nyid drung du 'dar zhing gus 'dud pa'i/ /rnam 'gyur du mas bka' bran bgyid par gsol/ /de lta'i ngo mtshar ltad mo mthong ba'i mod/ /skye bo kun gyi mgrin lam gcig pa'i tshig /sngon gyi dus kyi padma 'byung gnas dang / /da lta'i sngags 'chang thams cad mkhyen pa gnyis/ /lung rtogs yon tan khyad par med pa'i tshul/ /da lta'i bka' srung rnams kyis gus 'dud pa'i/ /gzugs can bran las bsgo ba nyan gyur pas/ /rtogs par nus zhes kun kyang dad pa 'phel/

/e ma dus gsum rgyal ba rab 'byams kun/ /kun kyang gcig tu 'dus pa'i sprul pa'i sku/ /sku mchog mthong ba tsam gyis yid 'phrog khyed/ /khyed nyid bskal brgyar zhabs pad brtan gyur cig /shes bya kun mkhyen mkhyen bzang 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /'gro la rab brtse brtse chen 'jig rten mgon/ /gang gi mthu stobs stobs ldan gsang ba'i bdag /kun gyi 'dren mchog mchog khyod bsngags par 'os/ /gang yang bskal par las dkar rab bsags pas/ /bstan la yang dag lhag par phan mdzad la/ /zag pa bag chags bcas pa gtan spangs pa/ /dam pa gang la dang bas bdag phyag 'tshal/ /mgon po gtso bo dkon mchog ngo bo khyod/ /dge legs bde chen ye shes nges legs 'phel/ /ji bzhin rim gnyis ting 'dzin nyid kyi rigs/ /kun tu sku gsum lhun grub drung du 'dud/ /gang gang zab cing rtogs par dka' ba'i don/ /de de tshad ldan mkhas pa'i srol bzhin du/ /rang rang gdul bya'i mos blo dang 'tshams par/ /yang yang 'doms mdzad smra dbang khyod kho na/ /ma lus ma ltar mkhyen pa'i byams pa dang / /bu slob bu ltar skyong ba'i thugs rje yis/ /bde mchog bde blag nyid du stsol mdzad pa'i/ /rgyal ba'i rgyal sras mchog khyed skye dgu'i rgyan/ /mgon khyod sku ni mtshan dpe'i rgyan gyis brgyan/ /gnyis med ston pa chos kyi gsung dbyangs gsungs/ /thugs kyi rdo rje snyem ma'i bdag po'i bdag /lhar bcas skye bo kun gyis bstod la bstod/ /de ltar bsam yas phyogs su bstan pa dang sems can gyi don rgya chen po sgrub par mdzad nas/ de nas yar phyogs su zla ba gnyis pa'i nyer dgu'i snga char chibs kha bsgyur ba mdzad de/ ji ltar bka' bsgos bzhin nam mkha' yang ha cang bsil ba ma yin pa dgongs bzhed ltar byung bas kun kyang ha las par gyur cing / sngon du spyan 'dren phebs gsol yang yang byung ba bzhin/ de nub mon mkhar rnam sras gling du bzhugs nas/

sde pa yum sras bcas pa dang / de'i phu na rnying dgon zhig gi bla ma grwa rigs bcas par rje btsun dam pa 'di nyid kyis dbang rjes gnang / lung man ngag sogs so so'i bsam pa dang mthun pa stsal cing / bris thang gsar pa mang po 'dug pa la yang phyag nas mdzad/ sde pa nas kyang zhabs tog 'bul nod shin tu rgyas pa mdzad cing / de nas bye rdzing tshogs pa'i spyan 'dren dang bcas chibs thog khyon pa'i dpon slob rnams lam zhugs mdzad pa na/ de dang dus mnyam mchims phu'i sgrub gnas gur dkar phug gi thad nas 'ja' dkar po yid du 'ong ba gcig shing sdong gi rtsa ba'i tshul gyis rgyang gis thon nas/ de las yal ga dang lo 'dab kyi tshul gyi ri mo ngo mtshar can phyogs mtshams thams cad du gyes te/ rje dpon slob rnams kyi dbu steng du thur ma brgya pa phub pa ltar du gyur pa'i ya mtshan can gyi ltas te lta bu dang bcas rim gyis bye rdzing du phebs par nye ba na khong rnams kyi chibs bsu rgyas pa ser 'phreng gzab ma dang bcas spyan drangs te/ de nub bla brang du bzhugs te zhag gnyis gdan chags pa'i bar la tshogs pa rnams la 'du khang chen mor rjes gnang / rigs gtad/ sgom lung gi rigs mang po dang bcas chos kyi char chen po phab cing / kha che paṇa chen gyi rdza sku phyag nas ma mjal te smon lam thugs tshims par mdzad cing / de dus grwa phyi chos skyong babs nas bdag nyid chen po'i drung du byon te/ lung bstan gyi rigs mang po dang / slar yang bdag nyid chen po dbus phyogs su lan gcig phebs dgos nan gyis zhus pa bzhin zhal gyis bzhes shing / de dus rje gsung sprul gyi dbon po 'dod chos 'dra zhu bar byung ba la khong rang gi bsam pa dang mthun pa'i chos rnams rdzogs par gnang nas/ gsung sprul sku cung zad snyung ba la brtan bzhugs tshig bcad cig dang gnang skyes rgya dpang che ba stsal cing / khong jo gdan tshogs pa spyi sger so so nas zhabs tog bsnyen bkur 'bul nod sogs rgya chen po bsgrubs cing /

de phyogs kyi skya ser khri phrag tu longs pa la ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo nas brgyud pa'i tshe dbang zab mo khrom chos su stsal te kun kyang yid tshims par mdzad cing / tshogs par yang mang ja bsngo rten khal grangs mang po thob pa'i 'gyed bzang po'i bsnyen bkur mdzad de der yod thams cad mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob ste dga' mgu yi rang ba yin la/ de nas dpon slob rnams grwa thang phyogs su phebs te der yod kyi mkhan po las tshan grwa tshang sbyin bdag dang bcas pa rnams kyi chibs bsu rgyas pa dang / 'dus pa'i tshogs pa byings kyis kyang ser phreng rgyas pa dang bcas pas spyan drangs nas sa phyogs der zhag lnga tsam gdan chags pa'i ring la grwa thang gi mkhan po las tshan drag bsdus don gnyer mtha' dag tshogs pa byings dang bcas pa la bdag nyid chen pos zhang blon rdo rje bdud 'dul/ gur zhal pu tra/ dur khrod bdag po sogs chos skyong mang po'i rjes gnang / sa paṇa 'jam dbyangs sbrags sgrub/ dbyug gu ma'i chos skor/ khyung khra khyung nag gi rjes gnang / 'byung 'dul ri khrod ma/ dmar po skor gsum la sogs pa'i gsung chos kyi rim pa mang po nyin mtshan 'khor yug tu stsal cing / der yod rnams dang phyogs nas 'dus pa'i skye bo khri phrag tu longs pa la dbang mo che dang thugs rje chen po'i bsgom lung gi bka' drin yang stsal cing / grwa tshang pa dpon slob rnams kyis kyang gong dkar rdo rje gdan gyi phyag len dang mthun pa'i las mkhan ru 'dren dang bcas pa'i gar 'cham dang / zhang blon gnas pa'i g.yag sang gi cho 'phrul ngo mtshar can gyi gzigs 'bul rnams rim par phul zhing / der yod skya ser drag zhan kun gyis bsnyen bkur zhabs tog dang 'bul ba'i rnam grangs dpag tu med pa bsgrubs shing / de de'i skabs nas rje dpon slob rnams nyin gcig byams pa gling gi rten mjal la phebs pa'i tshe/ der bzhugs kyi bla ma las tshan grwa rigs dang bcas pa'i ser 'phreng zab mos spyan drangs te bsnyen bkur zhabs tog 'bul ba'i rnam grangs chen po bsgrubs shing /

rje dpon slob rnams kyis kyang paṇa chen byams pa gling pa'i sku gdung hril po bzhugs pa'i mchod rten dang / sku 'bum chen mo'i steng 'og gi lha khang thams cad zhib par mjal bar mdzad cing / der yod kyi sgrub sde nam mkha' mdzod pa rnams kyis kyang 'bul nod dang zhabs tog rgyas par phul nas/ sgrub sde'i grwa pa 'das grongs mang po byung ba la brten/ de la phan pa'i spyan dmigs gnang dgos tshul byung ba bzhin rje nyid kyis smin rgyas gnang / khong rnams kyis gsol ba btab ngor dbang zhig kyang stsal/ de nub slar yang grwa thang du phebs/ de'i nangs par rgya gling tshogs pa rnams kyis spyan drangs nas/ khong rnams kyi chibs bsu ser 'phreng sogs rgyas par spyan drangs te bla brang du phebs/ ston mo gzab gshom gyi zhabs tog sngon du 'gro bas so so nas 'dod chos zhu mi mang du byung ba la/ rang rang gi blo dang 'tshams pa'i ci 'dod kyi chos stsal pas kun kyang yid tshims par gyur/ de nas 'du khang du phebs te sangs rgyas kyi tshems la sogs pa nang mjal byin rlabs can ngo mtshar ba mang du 'dug pa rnams mjal ba mdzad de/ slar tshur phebs lam du bsam dar nas dang khang pa chen mo ba gnyis kyis rang rang gi gzhis kar spyan drangs te bsnyen bkur 'bul nod gzab ma bsgrubs/ rje 'di nyid kyis kyang grwa thang / byams pa gling / nam mkha' mdzod/ rgyal gling tshogs pa sogs dgon rigs la/ rgya ja'i bsnyen bkur lan grangs mang ba dang / bsngo rten 'gyed sogs tshan grangs mang zhing dngos gtsang ba'i gnang skyes stsal pas kun kyang lugs gnyis kyi bka' drin la spro ba mchog tu gyur to/ /de'i sang nyin dol gyi chos 'khor gnas su phyag phebs pa'i tshe/ der yod kyi bla ma grwa pa rags bsdus kyi chibs bsu dang / dge 'dun byings kyis ser 'phreng dang bcas bla brang du spyan drangs nas dad ldan so so'i re ba skong bar mdzad/

de'i sang nyin 'du khang du rje nyid phebs te gsol btab bzhin gyi 'dod chos 'ga' zhig stsal/ phyi dro'i dus la babs pa na/ skya ser stong phrag du ma 'dus pa la dbang mo che zhig kyang gnang ste/ thams cad chos kyi bdud rtsis tshims par mdzad cing / 'dus tshogs la yang mang ja bsngo rten spyi 'gyed sogs chos rgyags gnyis ka'i bka' drin la/ dga' mgu yi rang ste snyan grags sgrog pa la brel bar gyur to/ /de'i phyi nyin rje dpon slob rnams skyid shod ra ba smad kyi chos sde chen por/ mkhan po grwa pa rags bsdus kyi chibs bsu/ dge 'dun dmangs kyi ser phreng dang bcas bla brang du spyan drangs te/ zhag gnyis bzhugs pa'i phyi ma la/ skya ser khri grangs su longs pa tsam la dbang mo che stsal cing / chos sde 'du khang du mkhan slob 'dus tshogs dang bcas pa la rong ston chos tshan brgya rtsa'i lung gi gtsos pa'i kho rang tshos 'dod chos du ma zhig nyin gcig la grub pa stsal cing / chos bdag rgyal po bse khrab can la yi ge'i ma mo la spel ba'i bskang gso tshigs bcad ma sogs mkhan po'i 'dod zhus ltar gsung rtsom yang mang po gnang shing / de phyogs kyi chos sde rnams su mang ja lan grangs mang ba'i thog bsngo rten spyi 'gyed rgya dpang shin tu che ba bstsal te/ der bzhugs kun kyang lugs zung gi bka' drin la yid rang zhing dad pa 'phel bar gyur/ de'i nangs par rje dpon slob rnams rdo rje gdan gyi chos grwa chen por phebs pa'i bar lam du/ dwags po grwa tshang gi mkhan slob dge 'dun bcas pa byon nas zhabs tog bsnyen bkur 'bul ba rgya cher bsgrubs te/ khong tsho'i bsam pa dang mthun pa'i gsung chos kyi rim pa kha yar zhig stsal te/ de nas dpon slob rnams chibs thog khel ba'i chos sde chen po dang thag nye bar phebs pa na/ rgya nag hwa shang dang lha'i bu/ chos skyong gi rnam sprul las mkhan gyi bsu mar mtshon pa'i 'bag dang chas gos mi 'dra ba ya mtshan can mang po gyon pa'i phebs bsu du ma yang zhabs drung du 'byor te/

de nas rim par chos sde chen po'i mdun du phebs pa na der bzhugs kyi dge 'dun byings kyi ser 'phreng gzab ma/ mdzes shing brjid chags pa mthong ba tsam gyis yid 'phrog pas mdun nas bsus te bla brang chen mo'i rdo rje gdan pa'i gzim chung du spyan drangs/ de nub nas bzung zhag bcu gsum gyi bar der gdan chags te/ yar lung bkra shis rtse nas dpon rin po che nas gtso mdzad chos sde chen po'i slob dpon rnam gsum dang chos 'chad kyi bla ma sogs dge 'dun 'dus pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la/ kyai rdo rje'i la dbang / rgyu dbang / rdo rje phur pa'i dbang / gur mgon lha brgyad/ zhal bzhi pa/ dur khrod bdag po/ pu tra ming sring / dkar bdud lcam dral/ bran bdud tshogs kyi rjes gnang / 'du khang chen mor sngar gyi chos nyan pa'i khar phyogs nas byon pa'i bla ma grwa rigs yon bdag dpon rigs sogs skya ser bgrang ba las 'das pa zhig la/ 'jam dbyangs dmar ser/ 'jam dbyangs dkar po/ 'jam dbyangs nag po/ u tsa me dbang ma/ 'byung 'dul me dbang ma/ khyung khra/ khyung nag mi g.yo ba dkar po/ mi g.yo ba sngon po chu bsrung bcas pa/ seng gdong ma sngo dmar/ gung chen nas brgyud pa'i gtor dbang / bka' gdams nas brgyud pa'i sgrol ma nyer gcig grub thob brgyad cu'i byin rlabs sogs rjes gnang zur bka' dang byin rlabs mang ba/ lhag par sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang yongs rdzogs bcas pa nyin gcig la stsal pas bdag nyid chen po'i mkhyen rab la der yod kun ha las shing grub pa'i mtshan ma yang dag pa'o/ /zhes chabs cig tu smra bar gyur to/ /gzhan yang sa paṇa dang 'jam dbyangs sbrags sgrub/ 'od dpag med kyi nyal 'pho/ slob dpon padma'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ ku ru kulle/ 'jam dmar lugs gnyis kyi rjes gnang / rnam rgyal/ rnam 'joms/ ri khrod ma/ khro bo rme brtsegs kyi rjes gnang / dbyug gu ma'i man ngag sogs kyis mtshon pa'i dbang rjes gnang lung man ngag rigs gtad la sogs pa chos kyi 'khor lo nyin mtshan med par bskor ba mdzad pas der yod thams cad/

da lo bdag chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs 'dir byon pas rang re rnams kyi chos kyi dbul ba dus gcig la sel bar mdzad pa a re dga' zhes zer zhing / zang zing gi bsnyen bkur yang rje nyid bzhugs ring la chos sde chen por mang ja bcu phrag gnyis la nye ba 'gyed bcas bzang po dang / lhag par rdo rje gdan pa chen po'i dus dran gyi mchod 'bul nyin/ mang ja nyis sbrel gyi thog bla ma slob dpon sogs zur 'bul 'os pa rnams la tshan grangs bzang po dang / der 'tshogs kun la gser 'gyed dang byin rlabs sogs kyi bsnyen bkur yang stsal te dge 'dun re rer yang khal grangs du ma phyag tu babs pa mdzad cing / slar rje sa paṇa dang rdo rje gdan pa chen po'i dus chen gyi theb la gser sga bzhis gtsos pa'i/ ja gos dar/ gos zas snam phrug gri khrab rta sogs dngos gtsang rigs kyi spyad pa gser zho lnga brgya ri nges pa'i dge rgyun gyi theb chen po yang sbyor ba mdzad de/ mdor na lugs gnyis gang gi sgo nas kyang bka' drin chen po stsal pas der bzhugs kun yid rab tu tshims shing dad zhen lhag par 'phel bas rje 'di kho na bsam pa las gzhan byed rgyu dang sgrub rgyu gang yang med pa lta bus thams cad rje 'di la brtan bzhugs dang gsol 'debs snyan grags sgrog pa kho nas dus rtag tu 'da' bar gyur pa yin no/ /de'i skabs gza' skar bzang ba'i nyin rdo rje gdan pa chen po'i sku gdung bzhugs pa'i dngul gdung lam 'bras brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i bla ma lha khang dang / rdo rje gdan pa'i sku tshad kyi kyai rdor gtso bo la lha mo brgyad kyis bskor ba'i sngags thang chen mo/ de nyid kyi thugs dam rgyun par mdzad pa'i kyai rdor rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor/ phyag dpe khang chen mo/ las mkhan ru 'dren dang bcas pa'i 'cham chas bzhugs pa'i rgyan khang chen mo/ rdo rje gdan pa'i thugs dam ma'i rdo rje 'phreng ba'i dkyil thang gi gtsos pa'i bris thang mang po/

yo ga'i dbang bskur gnang dus kyi dbang rdzas khyad 'phags mang po/ gzim chung mgon khang / gser sku lha khang sogs steng gi gtsug lag khang rnams dang / 'du khang chen mo'i sbug gi byang chub chen po nye ba'i sras brgyad/ zas gtsang yab yum sogs kyi sku bzhugs pa'i gtsang khang chen mo/ mgon khang chen mo dang / 'jigs byed lha khang sogs su rje dpon slob rnams rim par phebs te mchod sprin rgya chen po'i bkod pa dang bcas thugs bskyed bzang po sngon du 'gro ba'i smon lam rgya chen po 'debs par mdzad cing / khong chos sde ba dpon slob rnams kyis kyang tshes bcu chen mo'i sa ging gnam ging sogs kyi bkod pa ngo mtshar can dang rdo rje gdan pa'i dus chen dang 'brel ba'i gur gar gzab ma dang / las mkhan ru 'dren dang bcas pa'i gar 'cham gzab ma'i thog chos skyong gi 'cham sku gnyis kyang phebs shing gzigs mo'i rnam grangs du ma dang zhal bzhi pa'i drag po'i gtor chen sgrub pa'i phyag len gzigs 'bul sogs dang / dge 'dun spyi dang bye brag so so nas zhabs tog bsnyen bkur gyi rim pa rgya dpang che zhing 'bul nod kyang blo'i ra ba las 'das pa zhig bsgrubs/ dpon slob kun kyang thugs yid gcig 'dres kyi legs tshogs phun sum tshogs pa byung ba yin la/ der bzhugs skabs/ sde pa lhun grub brtan pa sogs skya ser gsum gyis dbang gzhi bting chog pa'i gsol ba btab nas rdo rje gdan pa'i chos khri chen mo'i steng nas/ rje 'di nyid kyis dbang mo che lan gnyis stsal te de dag gi tshe yang nam mkha' gdugs 'jam zhing 'ja' 'od kyi gur khang 'khrigs pa sogs ngo mtshar du ma byung ba yin la/ de ltar rdo rje gdan du bzhugs ring la lha sa nas phyag mdzod chen mos bka' khyab gnang nas gong dkar rdzong nas zur chas kyi bsnyen bkur rgya dpang che ba sgrub pa'i zhabs tog dang / de bzhin du dpal 'khor chos sde/
