rgyal mkhar rtse/ dpal nam klu sdings/ chu shul/ shun gdong sogs de dang de'i rdzong so so nas zur chas dkar dmar gyi spros zas sogs rnyed pa phul du phyin pas mchod cing / de nas rje dpon slob rnams rdo rje gdan nas yar phyogs su chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur te/ chos rje bka' 'gyur bas gtso mdzad chos sde chen po'i bla ma slob dpon sbyin bdag dpon rigs du ma dang bcas pa'i chibs skyel gzab ma dang bcas rim par phyag phebs te de nub gam pa byang thang du bzhugs shing / nangs par skyid tshal ba rnams kyis spyan drangs pa'i bar lam du stag khu spe chos sde bla ma grwa rigs dang bcas pa rje 'di nyid mjal ba la cher gtad byon te bsnyen bkur 'bul nod rgyas pa dang / der 'dod mthun gyi gsung chos du ma dus gcig la stsal cing rje nyid kyis kyang mang ja bsngo rten spyi 'gyed gya nom pa'i bka' drin yang bstsal te kun gyi yid tshims par mdzad/ de nas skyid tshal ba dpon slob kyi chibs bsu ser phreng rgyas pa dang bcas bla brang du spyan drangs te gnas der zhag gnyis bzhugs pa'i 'du khang chen mor bla ma grwa rigs dang bcas pa la kho rang rnams kyis gsol ba btab pa'i rjes gnang byin rlabs rigs gtad lung gi rigs du ma sogs chos kyi rnam grangs mang po dus gcig la stsol bar mdzad cing / phyi'i chos ra chen mo'i khri steng nas skya ser stong phrag du ma longs pa la dbang mo che zhig kyang stsal pas thams cad dga' zhing mgu bar gyur cing / rje nyid kyis kyang chos sder mang ja lnga phrag tsam gnang ba'i thog bsngo rten spyi 'gyed ngal gsos po'i 'byor pa la co 'dri ba lta bu stsal cing / khong rnams kyang dad spros yid myos par gyur la/ de nas rje dpon rnams 'da' gsing la brgyud de yar 'brog dpal sder phebs pa'i tshe/ sde pa dpon g.yog rnams kyis chibs bsu zhabs tog rgya che ba bsgrubs/

tshe dbang rjes gnang sgom lung gi rigs sogs 'dod zhus ltar ci yang zhig stsal/ sde pa nas bzhengs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi skyes rabs shig 'dug pa la phyag nas smin rgyas kyang mdzad de kun gyi mchod yul du stsal/ de nas dpon slob rnams yar gzigs su phebs pa'i tshe/ sna dkar rtse nas sde bdag chen po dpon blon/ thar gling chos sde sogs de phyogs kyi dgon so so'i bla ma grwa rigs dang bcas pa zhabs drung du 'byor te/ khong rnams la so so'i thugs 'dod dang mthun pa'i kyai rdo rje'i rgyu dbang / lam dbang / rdo rje phur pa'i dbang / gur mgon lha brgyad/ zhal bzhi pa/ dur khrod bdag po/ pu tra ming sring / dkar bdud lcam dral/ bran bdud sogs zab cing dkon pa'i rjes gnang gi rigs du ma dang / tshe dbang grub rgyal ma/ tshe dbang 'chi med dpal ster/ tshe dbang lcags gdong ma sogs tshe dbang gi rigs mang po dang / rnam rgyal/ rnam 'joms/ khyung khra/ khyung nag 'jam dbyangs nag po rnams kyi rjes gnang / slob dpon padma'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ 'od dpag med kyi nyal 'pho/ thugs rje chen po'i sgom lung sogs dang / gzhan yang lung gi rigs bgrang ba las 'das pa sogs gnas der zhag gsum bzhugs pa'i ring la nyin mtshan med par chos kyi char chen po phab pas/ sde bdag dpon slob dgon pa'i bla ma grwa rigs dang bcas pa thams cad so sor thugs 'dod tshims shing / rje 'di nyid la mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob par gyur te/ tha dad nas zhabs tog bsnyen bkur rgya dpang che zhing / 'bul nod kyang grangs tshad kyis gzung du med pa phul/ rje nyid kyis kyang sde bdag chen por gnang skyes shin tu bzang ba dang / dgon grwa rigs so so dang bcas par yang mang ja nyis sbrel gsum sbrel thog bsngo rten spyi 'gyed sogs gzhal du ma mchis pa'i bka' drin stsal/ de ltar lugs gnyis kyi sgo nas der 'dus kun kyang so sor thugs tshims shing rje nyid kyi snyan pa sgrog pa la rtag 'grus su gyur pa yin la/

de dus sna dkar rtse dang dpal sde gnyis kar yar 'brog mtsho mo'i klu rnams la dmigs pa'i dge slong bzhi sde res chab gtor klu gtor nyin re bzhin rgyun ma chad pa gtong ba'i bka' stsal phebs te so so nas phyag bzhes su thebs par mdzad pa yin la/ de nas rje dpon slob rnams rong chen brgyud pa gnang ba'i thog mar rong ram pa/ de nas dga' bde/ de nas rin spungs dkyil khang pa'i sger gzhis skyid gshong rnams su rim par spyan drangs shing / dga' bde nas skyid gshong du phebs pa'i bar lam du ngur smrig gi gtsug lag khang gi rten mjal dang / sa skya pa chen po'i zhabs rjes sogs mjal ba mdzad de smon lam rgya chen po gnang / de nas dkyil khang pa'i bka' 'gyur gsar du bzhengs pa la rab gnas smin rgyas mdzad/ gnas der gong ra dgon pa'i grwa pa mang po 'dod chos zhu bar byung ba la so so'i bsam pa dang mthun pa'i dbang rjes gnang lung man ngag sogs chos kyi bka' drin ci yang zhig stsal cing / der dkyil khang pa sogs skya ser brgya phrag tu longs pa la khrom dbang zhig kyang mdzad/ der yod kun yid tshims par mdzad cing / der skabs rtse gdong nas spyan 'dren gyi mi sna 'byor te gdung rgyud gzhi bsnyen gnang rgyu la/ sngar la dbang ma gsan pa'i thabs khag pa zhig byung 'dug pa/ de nyid gtso bor gyur pa'i gsung chos kyi rim pa mang po zhig gnang dgos tshul gyi snyan 'bul ltar spyi dgos nas phebs spro tshul bcas zhal gyis bzhes te/ rje dpon slob rnams chibs kha bsgyur nas khu lung gi mdo sne bzhir phebs rgyu'i lam bar du/ thog mar gzhi kha byams chen pa rnams kyis chibs bshol zhus nas khong skya ser drag zhan kun gyis bsnyen bkur zhabs tog 'bul ba'i rnam grangs rgya chen po bsgrubs shing / de nas rin spungs klu sdings su phebs pa'i tshe/ skyid tshal gong nas bla ma grwa rigs kun kyang rje nyid mjal bar byon pa la so so'i 'dod pa dang mthun pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor/

rjes gnang / bsgom lung sogs ci la ci 'tshams par stsal cing / rin spungs rdzong sdod rnams kyis kyang bsnyen bkur 'bul ba sogs legs par bsgrubs/ 'bras yul gyi skyid tshal chos sde ba rnams la rje nyid kyis mang ja gsum sbrel thog bsngo rten bzang ba spyi 'gyed dge 'dun re rer yang khal grangs mang po thob pa'i zang zing gi dngos po stobs che bas bsnyen cing bkur bar mdzad cing myong grol ril bu'i 'gyed kyang stsal pa yin la/ 'dis mtshon pa'i dbus phyogs kyi sa skya pa'i dgon che phra thams cad du yang byin rlabs 'chi med ril bu'i 'gyed stsol bar mdzad pa yin no/ /de nas sne bzhir phebs skabs khu lung nas rje dbon bka' 'gyur ba'i sku nye bgres gzhon mjal bar byung ba la/ khong tsho rang gi thugs 'dod dang bstun pa'i chos bka' 'ga' zhig kyang stsal cing / tshur yang zhabs tog 'bul ba rgya chen dang / phar yang gnang skyes dang lugs gnyis kyi bslab bya lhug stsol du mdzad/ de nas rje dpon slob rnams/ bres gshong dang rtse gdong pa'i chos gzhis gyer re rnams su rim par phebs te/ de'i nangs par rtse gdong nas gdung rgyud zhal ngo rtse rgyas drung 'khor rags bsdus dang bcas pas chibs bsu ser 'phreng rgyas pa dang bcas pas rje nyid klu sdings su spyan drangs te/ gnas der zhag gsum tsam bzhugs pa'i ring la gdung rgyud zhal ngo rnams dang / chos sde srid gsum rnam rgyal gyi bla ma grwa rigs dang bcas pa la/ kyai rdo rje'i la dbang / rgyu dbang / bde mchog gi dbang / gur mgon lha brgyad/ zhal bzhi pa'i bsnyen dus/ dur khrod bdag po/ pu tra'i zur bka'/ dkar bdud/ bran bdud sogs kyi rjes gnang / tshe dbang gi rigs mang po/ khyung khra/ khyung nag 'jam dbyangs dmar ser/ sa paṇa 'jam dbyangs sbrags sgrub/ lam 'bras/ thugs rje chen po'i sgom lung / slob dpon padma'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor/

'od dpag med kyi nyal 'pho/ lung gi rigs 'ga' zhig la sogs der bzhugs rnams kyi thugs 'dod dang mthun pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor bar mdzad cing / bkur bsti dang zang zing gi mchod pas mnyes par byas/ rje 'di nyid kyang gdung rgyud zhal ngo rnams la gnang skyes rgya dpang che ba dngos gtsang ba dang / chos sder mang ja gsum sbrel thog bsngo rten spyi 'gyed bzang pos re ba don ldan du mdzad de/ kun kyang dga' mgu yi rangs pa'i snyim pa spyi bor 'god par gyur to/ /de nas rje dpon slob rnams chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur ba na rtse gdong nas gdung rgyud khu dbon rnams chibs skyel la phebs nas/ skabs bab kyi sar chibs gyes gnang ba'i tshe gtsug lag lugs brgya'i bslab bya'i sgo 'phar dbye bar mdzad pa na/ rtse gdong gdung rgyud rnams kyang mi phyed pa'i dad pas thugs rgyud tshims te thugs shin tu 'khreng ba'i sgo nas bskal brgyar zhabs zung brtan ngos sngar mjal thog zab chos nod pa'i rten 'brel gsol ba ltar zhal bzhes kyang mdzad nas de nub gser mdog can du phebs pa'i bar lam du/ rin chen sgrol ma bas khong rang gi sger gzhis lhab tu spyan drangs te bsnyen bkur zhabs tog phun sum tshogs pas mchod cing / rje nyid kyis kyang gnang skyes bzang pos tshims par mdzad/ de nas chos grwa chen po gser mdog can du phebs par nye ba na/ der bzhugs kyi mkhan slob drag bsdus kyi chibs bsu dang / dge 'dun byings kyi ser 'phreng rgyas pas spyan drangs te phebs 'phral paṇa chen rin po che'i bya rgod phung po'i bzhugs khri'i steng nas mkhan slob dge 'dun dang bcas par rje nyid kyis 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa sbrags sgrub/ 'od dpag med kyi nyal 'pho/ 'jam dbyangs dmar ser gyi rjes gnang sogs gsung chos kyi rim pa du ma stsal cing / de nub bla brang du gdan chags pa'i nangs par snga bar paṇa chen rin po che'i sku gdung bzhugs pa'i gdung rten gyi gtsos pa'i lha khang rnams su phebs nas thugs bskyed smon lam rgya che bar mdzad/

'du khang chen mor paṇa chen gyi bzhugs khri'i steng nas mkhan slob dge 'dun 'dus pa'i tshogs la paṇa chen gyi gsol 'debs gsar rtsom gnang ba de nyid kyis mtshon te gsung chos kyi rim pa yang 'ga' zhig stsal cing / 'dus pa'i tshogs la mang ja gsum sbrel gyi bkur bsti dang / bsngo rten bzang po spyi dang 'gyed rgya dpang che ba stsal te/ dad 'dus kun kyang gus pa lhag par 'phel te snyan grags kyi rnga bo che phyogs kun tu sgrog par gyur cing / de nas bya rgod phung po'i bzhugs khri'i steng nas skya ser du ma la khrom dbang zhig kyang stsal te/ de 'phral chibs thog khel ba'i mkhan slob rags bsdus kyi chibs skyel dang bcas rim par phyag phebs pa na/ bsam 'grub rtse nas sa dbang nor bu'i drung gi drung 'khor mang po'i chibs bsu gzab mas spyan drangs te klu sdings bkra shis dge tshal du phebs/ der zhag gsum bzhugs pa'i ring la sde srid nor bu'i drung dpon g.yog rags bsdus/ chos sde brag dmar nas dpon slob grwa rigs bcas pa/ 'phyong rgyas 'du khang pa'i bla ma 'dus tshogs rnams dang / bsam rtse zhol nas dad pa chen pos 'dus pa'i skye bo gdul byar gyur pa bgrang bya las 'das pa de rnams la/ tshe dbang rjes gnang byin rlabs rigs gtad sogs rang rang gang 'dod kyi chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor zhing / dgon so so'i bla ma grwa rigs rnams la yang mang 'gyed bzang po'i bsnyen bkur stsal cing kun kyang spro ba'i dngos po thob par mdzad cing / lhag par sde srid nor bu'i drung rje nyid la mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob ste dge rgyun mang po lo re bzhin 'chag med du 'jug pa'i dam bca' dang / zhabs tog 'bul nod kyang dpag tu med pa bsgrubs te da nas bzung ste 'di phyi kun gyi legs nyes thams cad khyed la re ba yin no zhes shin tu gus pa'i zhu mchid dang / thugs dad gting nas g.yos pa'i lung bstan bslab ston gyi tshogs zhu ba dang /

rje nyid kyis kyang thugs brtse ba chen pos lhug rtsol du gnang ba sogs kyi sgo nas dpon slob thugs yid gcig 'dres kyi legs tshogs phun sum tshogs pa byung ba yin la/ der bzhugs pa'i nyin gcig rje nyid dang / bkra shis lhun po nas paṇa chen rin po che mjal 'phrad gnang ba'i tshe/ paṇa chen rin po che nas kyang thugs dag snang chen pos rje dpon slob rnams la bsnyen bkur zhabs tog rgya dpang shin tu che ba dang / zang zing gi 'bul nod kyang blos dpag par dka' ba zhig sgrub par mdzad cing / bdag nyid chen pos kyang dge 'dun tshogs par mang ja gsum sbrel thog paṇa chen drung du dngos po bzang la gya nom pa'i skyes rgya spang che ba dang / 'dus tshogs su bsnyen bkur zab mo zhig sgrub par mdzad de/ kun kyang dgyes shing tshims pa'i legs lam gong 'phel du gyur pa yin la/ de nas rje dpon slob rnams snar thang du phebs pa'i tshe/ de'i grwa tshang so so'i bla ma grwa rigs mi sde dang bcas pas zhabs tog bsnyen bkur zang zing gi 'bul ba mang du byung zhing / lhag par ngor nas mkhan po/ drung chen/ shar pa/ thar pa rtse pa sogs dngos dang sku tshab mang po dus gcig la 'dzoms pa'i so so nas zhabs tog 'bul nod rgya chen po phul zhing / rje nyid kyis kyang snar thang grwa tshang so so ngor e waṃ chos ldan dang bcas par mang ja bsngo rten spyi 'gyed sogs rnam thos bu'i dpal 'byor la 'gran bzod pa lta bu'i bsnyen bkur bstsal te so so kun kyang dad pa'i spu long cher g.yos te lugs gnyis kyi bslab bya mtha' dag zhu ba dang / rje 'di nyid kyi bka' la mos gus gting tshugs par gyur te/ kun kyang gus pa'i sor bcu spyi bor len pa la ngal ba lhur len par gyur to/ /de nas rje dpon slob rnams kyis rim par tsha shod/ tshal spe/ phyi ba lung rnams su rim par phebs te/ tshal sper bzhugs pa'i tshe shab gzhung gi chos gzhis kyi gnyer pa dgon dmangs rnams dang /

'dra 'dri lhun rtse sogs kyi chos sde'i bla ma grwa rigs du ma/ rgya rgan nas nang so'i drung zhal ngo rnams dang bcas mjal bar byung ba la/ so sor 'dod chos 'ga' zhig stsal cing / zang zing gi gnang skyes gang la ci 'tshams dgon so sor mang ja bsngo rten gyi bya dga' chen po stsal pa yin la/ de nas phyi ba lung du ma phebs tsam gyi bar lam la phu sum chos sde'i bla ma grwa rigs dang bcas pa dang / dgon pa rgyas kyi bla ma sgrub sde rnams mjal bar lhag te zang zing gi 'bul ba ci yang bsgrubs shing / rje nyid kyis kyang so sor 'dod chos dang mang 'gyed bzang po yang stsal pa yin la/ nangs par phyi ba lung nas chibs thog khel ba'i tshe/ gdan sa chen po nas gdung sras 'jam pa'i dbyangs ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug dpon slob rnams kyis gtso mdzad mchod gzhis rta thogs rnams kyi chibs bsu rgyas pas spyan drangs te rim gyis gdan sa chen por phebs pa na/ der bzhugs kyi dge 'dun rnams kyi ser 'phreng gzab ma/ 'cham mgon byin rlabs can rnams kyi bsu ba/ mchod gzhis kyi skyes pa rnams kyi bro dang bud med rnams kyi gzhas rtsed rgyan gos gzab ma sogs ngo mtshar ba'i bkod pa du ma dang bcas pas mdun nas bsus te/ rgyal dbang rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer ma mchis pa'i bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid kyi bsti gnas dam pa dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang du phebs par mdzad de/ de'i nangs par dge 'dun 'dus pa'i tshogs la mang ja bsnyen bkur gya nom pa dang / rtsed sna 'bul mir gnang skyes rgya dpang che ba mdzad de/ kun kyang dga' zhing mgu nas spro ba mchog tu 'phel bar gyur cing / de nas mgon khang rnams su yang gtang rag bskang gso rgyas par mdzad cing / de nas zla ba lnga pa'i rje mus chen gyi sku mchod dang / zla ba drug pa'i sa lo chen po'i dus chen sgrub mchod/ zla ba bdun pa'i sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i sku mchod rnams la/

bde mchog kyai rdor/ rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub mchod gzab ma rnams gnang grub mtshams/ gser mdog can nas mkhan chen dpon slob rags bsdus gsung ngag lam 'bras zhu bar cher gtad byon pa la/ khong dpon slob rnams dang / thub bstan rnam rgyal nas grwa rigs mang po/ sgom sde nang chen nas chos rje gong mas rje nyid kyi lung bstan bzhin ming mngon dga' bde ba can du 'dogs par mdzad pa'i dgon pa gsar rgyag de nyid gegs med du mthar phyin pa'i gnas tshul 'bul bar/ chos rje bla ma dpon slob grwa rigs mang po dang bcas pa khong de dag dang / gtso bo gdung sras bgres pa ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug lcam sring / gdung sras gzhon pa ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis sras yum/ yar rgyab rje btsun ma/ gser mdog dbon po/ chos sde lho byang gi dge 'dun rags bsdus/ rin chen sgang nas sgrub pa mo mang po/ glo bo smon thang pa'i grwa rigs du ma/ gzhan yang mnga' ris/ rnam rgyal lha rtse/ ngor dgon pa/ na lend+ra nyi shar chos sde sogs nas 'dus pa'i dge 'dun grangs mang po sogs gzhi byes kyi chos sde sogs nas chos nyan pa brgya phrag tu longs pa la gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag gi chos kyi 'khor lo zla ba du ma'i bar du bskor bar mdzad de/ de dang 'brel ba'i dbang rjes gnang / lung man ngag cha lag so so ma tshang ba med pa sgrub pa lung sbyin gyi bar du smin rgyas su stsal te/ der 'dus thams cad dad pa dang blo gros kyi dbang po rab tu rgyas par gyur pa yin la/ de dag gi gong rol tsam du byang nas bdag po bla ma'i drung / gong dkar nas sog po bla ma/ gdan sa'i chos sde chen po'i mkhan rin po che/ brgya dpon las chen sogs chos nyan rag bsdus shig la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i khrid/ rje 'di nyid kyi rtogs brjod ngo mtshar rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs kyi sgra dbyangs skal bzang dpyid kyi dga' ston zhes bya ba khro phu mkhan chen dpal rgyas dbang pos mdzad pa/

rnal 'byor ma'i yig skor gsar rnying mang po'i lung la sogs pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi ci yang zhig stsal pa yin la/ lo de'i dgun bzang ldan chos sde'i slob dpon bla ma lags kyis gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ gdung sras dam pa lcam sring sras yum/ rgya dpon las chen/ mdo khams nas 'bul dpon gser mdog bla ma bgres gzhon/ las tshan sogs kyis gtsos pa'i chos nyan pa rags bsdus shig la/ sa skya pa'i kyai rdor bka' bab bzhi'i gzhung 'grel la brten pa gsum gyi rgya gzhung gi rigs phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa ding sang lung rgyun chad la thug pa'i shin tu dkon pa'i gtso che'i chos sna sum bcu rtsa dgu/ 'jigs byed rwa lugs kyi rwa rtse sems 'dzin gyi khrid/ de'i yig skor gyi lung / 'jigs byed rwa lugs/ rwa khrid/ mkha' 'gro snyan brgyud kyi khrid yig cha'i lung dang bcas pa/ 'bri gung dpal 'dzin gyis bsgrigs pa'i 'jigs byed kyi man ngag be bum gyi lung rnams gnang zhing / de rjes sngar gyi chos nyan de rnams phal cher dang / thub bstan yangs pa can gyi slob dpon pa gnyis/ 'tsho byed rgyal thang bla ma/ gan pa rdzong dpon lnga ldan/ bla ma ba ri ba/ shang lha bu ba'i sde pa sogs chos nyan gsar pa du ma dang / gtso bo rigs kyi cod pan 'dzin pa'i gdung sras ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis sras yum gyis gtsos pa'i chos nyan pa bcu phrag gnyis tsam la/ gur gyi mgon po'i gsang khrid rgyas pa cha lag dang bcas pa/ thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid/ 'brug lugs kyi nā ro chos drug ro snyoms sgang sgril sogs kyi khrid/ skyid sdug lam khyer/ sum pa lo tsā nas brgyud pa'i khrid zab mo/ spyan ras gzigs kyi rjes gnang / gong gi khrid so so'i yig cha'i lung la sogs pa'i chos kyi char chen po 'bebs par mdzad cing / de dag gi skabs nas/ rje 'di nyid kyis sngon nas zhal bkod mdzad pa'i gdan sa chen po'i rten gtso 'jam dbyangs gzi 'od 'bar ba bzhugs gnas dbu rtse gsar rnying gi gser tog shing cha sogs gsar du spo ba mdzad pa so sor phyag nas gnang zhing /

de dang nye bar 'khon sku 'bum nyams gso gsar bzhengs lta bu mdzad de lha khang gi logs bris la dus mchod gdung rgyud rim par byon pa'i brgyud rim dang / 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po'i sku gdung ril por bzhugs pa'i mchod rten la grang gser rdzib gtong gi zhabs tog dang / gnam rgyan la bya spu dkar nag kho na las grub pa'i bla bre khyad 'phags/ gzhan yang bkral thags dang / brgyan gzhi sogs khyad gos kho na bsgrigs pa'i ka star gsum gyi bar tal mar bla bre dang / sa rgyan mchod pa'i bye brag kyang gsar pa mang du 'bul bar mdzad cing / rab gnas bkra shis mnga' gsol kyang smin rgyas su sgrub par mdzad de/ deng sang kun gyi yid 'phrog pa'i gnas su gyur pa 'di dang / zur khang du rje btsun rin po che'i sku 'dra la/ hor gos kyi ku ber/ ka star gsum la khyad gos kho na bsgrigs pa'i bla bre/ logs gsum dang ka ba gsum la lam 'bras brgyud pa bla ma gong ma'i phyag nas tshar gnyis kyis gtsos pa'i bris thang byin rlabs can du mas mdzes par byas shing / sa rgyan mchod pa'i bye brag kyang mang po 'bul bar mdzad nas gtsug lag khang 'di la yang zhabs tog gsar bzhengs lta bu'i sgo nas da lta kun gyis mthong ba tsam gyis dang ba'i dad pa dbang med du skyed par byed pa 'di yin la/ gzhan yang bzhi thog bla brang gi rig 'dzin lha khang gi 'og tu yab rje grags pa'i mtshan 'chang de nyid kyi thugs bzhed kyi lhag ma bskang ba'i phyir gur gyi mgon po lha bcu gnyis ma/ ru 'dren sde bzhi/ zhing skyong tsa turmu kha bram ze'i gzugs can/ dur khrod bdag po yab yum/ dmag zor rgyal mo/ dkar bdud lcam dral dang bcas pa'i 'bur sku thog tshad ma/ ka ba rnams dang logs phal cher la sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po yab sras kyi phyag bris gur zhal pu tra sogs kyi bris thang so so'i sku dngos dang khyad par med pa'i byin rlabs can du ma/

yi dam kyai rdor/ bde mchog phur pa/ yang dag dus 'khor sogs kyi bris thang / gzhan yang bla ma gong ma'i thugs dam ma'i gur gyi mgon po 'khor bcas bla brgyud dang bcas pa'i bris thang tshon rdzogs ma dang nag thang grab du ma/ stag bzhon trag shad/ beng / zhang blon/ ma ning / phyag bzhi pa/ phyag drug pa/ mgon po seng ge nag po/ dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa gdong gnyan can/ brtsegs zhal can/ mgon po legs ldan la sogs pa'i bris thang byin rlabs can du mas phyogs kun tu khyab pa dang / ka star lho ma la hor gos ma ṇi ma grab gcig la grub pa'i bla bre dang / ka star gzhan rnams la zhing chen gyi bla bres mdzes par byas shing / gzhan yang chos skyong so so'i phyag mtshan yongs rdzogs gos khyad 'phags kyi rgyal mtshan so gnyis/ dar mdung / mda' dar/ rnga thug khrab rmog gri sogs rngam zhing brjid chags pa rnams dang / ka ba rnams stag gzig sbrul gyi pags pa khyad mtshar sogs kyis 'khyud pa'i steng la sngags 'chang chen po/ yab rje grub mchog bsod nams dbang po rnams kyi phyag 'khar/ sngags 'chang chen po'i phyag ral dzam̐ pa dgra 'dul/ grub mchog mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug gi sku sag grub pa'i sar gnas gtsang smyon pa'i kha ṭwaṃ ka rnams dang / gzhan yang bdag chen blo gros rgyal mtshan gyi mgon po me 'bar ma dngos ma sogs bla ma gong ma so so'i mgon pod phyag dpe'i rigs dmar po skor gsum gyi chos skor/ bdag chen blo gros pa'i phyag bzo 'khrul med mgon po zhal rnams kyi bri snying theg chen rin po che'i rten rdo sogs ye shes pa dngos dang rnam dbyer ma mchis pa rten dang brten pa'i rdzas gzhal du med cing brjod du med pa de dag dad ldan yongs kyi yid dbang 'dren pa'i shing rta chen por bzhugs pa 'di yin la/ mgon khang mthar thon nas mtshan srid gsum zil gnon du gsol bar mdzad cing / su pra tiṣṭha mthun mong ma yin pa tshar gcig dang /

gzhan yang phyag nas smin rgyas yang yang du mdzad pas ye shes sems dpa' dngos su bzhugs pa'i rtags su mgon khang der su zhig gis phyin kyang nang du slebs ma thag 'jigs shing skyi phung byed pa dang / tha mal gyi rnam rtog phra rags rnams 'gags nas/ sku rnams la blta mi nus bzhin du dal bus bltas pa na/ sku rnams shin tu legs shing gzi brjid dang ldan pas yid rang dbang med par 'phrog cing blo phebs te chos skyong ye shes pa dngos rnams la yang 'di rnams las lhag pa med do snyam pa'i dang pa'i dad pa dang byin rlabs rmad du byung ba la yid ches kyi blo rnam par 'phel te yang yang bltas shing byin rlabs kyang ngoms pa med pa'i tshul gyis gnas de nas gzhan du 'gro ba la phangs pa lta bu'i blo'i 'gyur ba gzhan las phul du byung ba 'di ni gcig min skye bo kun gyi blor gsal ba ltar/ ngo mtshar gyi gtam phyogs kun tu sgrog pa 'di yin la/ slar yang nyis thog bla brang du gtsug lag khang gsar bzhengs dang / yang bla ma gong ma'i thugs dam sogs 'cham mgon lcam dral bcu gcig gi gsol phod dang / rdo rje gong pa rnams gos chen khyad mtshar kho nas gsar du spo bar mdzad pa dang / gzhan yang sangs rgyas kyi 'khrungs rabs sngags 'chang nyid kyis mdzad pa'i dpag bsam 'khri shing gi don 'grel nang bzhin rgyal ba'i skyes rabs brgya rtsa brgyad pa thog tshad ma sum bcu rtsa grangs shig gser thang 'ba' zhig tu sgrub par mdzad/ de thams cad la gong gsham 'ja' ris nyis sbrags sngon dus kyi hor gos khyad 'phags 'ba' zhig las grub pa thams cad la zhal kheb lnga brtsegs/ gong shing gi 'dzin a long dang sgril shing gi tog thams cad gser dngul 'jang brdung kho na las grub pa sogs gangs can gyi khrod 'dir sangs rgyas kyi skyes rabs bris thang zhig la 'di bas ri mo ngo mtshar zhing rgyu gong gsham sogs khyad par du 'phags pa kun gyi mig gi bdud rtsir gyur pa 'di 'dra ba sngar ma byung ba yongs la grags pa 'di dag gsar du bskrun par mdzad pa dang /

gdung sras lcam sring sras yum/ chos sde chen po'i mkhan po/ rgya dpon las chen sogs don gnyer gyi slob ma bgrang ba las 'das pa zhig la rje btsun sa skya pa'i gong ma lnga'i bka' 'bum gyi lung la sogs pa'i zab rgyas chos kyi dga' ston rgyun chad med par stsol bzhin pa 'di yin la/ zhes tshig 'phro can du byas nas da lta rje nyid dgung lo re gsum bzhes pa yan gyi rnam par thar pa brjod zin nas/ da dung dgung gi bgrang gzhi brgyad bcu rtsa lnga yan gyi rnam par thar pa slar yang brjod par 'dod pas lhag ma can gyi tshig tu bkod pa 'dis ni 'phral yun du dge legs su gyur cig/ ༈ //'dir smras pa/ ngag dbang lha ltar shes bya kun gzigs mkhyen rab gting mtha' dpag tu med/ /zag med dga' bde'i yan lag brgyad ldan snying brtse'i rlabs 'phreng phyogs bcur g.yo/ /phul byung nus pa'i ra bas yongs bskor blo gsal klu dbang bsti ba'i gnas/ /dge legs yid bzhin rin chen 'byung gnas bsod nams chos kyi mtsho chen rgyal/ /e ma 'di dang phyi ma'i phan bde kun/ /rdo rje slob dpon mchog la rag las phyir/ /grub dbang rnams kyang rigs kyi bdag po yi/ /tshul gyis rang gi bla ma sri zhur mdzad/ /de slad bla ma mchog la mos pa ni/ /sde snod snying po rgyud sde kun gyi bcud/ /dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas bgrod gcig lam/ /mkhas grub dam pa kun gyi gshegs shul yin/ /dang por bla ma sangs rgyas nyid du bsgom/ /bar du bla ma sangs rgyas dngos su mthong / /mtha' mar rang sems bla mar gyur pa 'di/ /rdo rje theg pa'i khyad chos yin zhes grags/ /de phyir sangs rgyas thams cad mchod pa bas/ /bla ma'i ba spu gcig mchod don che zhes/ /rab 'byams zhing gi rgyal ba ma lus pa/ /dbyangs dang dgongs pa gcig gis gsal bar gsungs/ /mos gus med na byin rlabs 'jug min la/ /byin rlabs ma zhugs rtogs pa mi skye ba'i/

/gcig chog rgyal po bla ma'i mos gus zhes/ /grub mchog rnams kyis yang yang bsngags par mdzad/ /de phyir rang nyid mos pa lhur byas shing / /skal bzang gzhan la'ang dang 'dod dad pa'i blo/ /rgya cher spel phyir rtogs brjod rin chen 'phreng / /spel ba 'di 'dra rang nyid skal ba bzang / /gzhir gnas dam pa'i yon tan gang dag ngo mtshar tshig gi srad bu la/ /legs par spel ba'i dge tshogs gang des rnam mang 'gro ba'i kun rmongs tshogs/ /mun pa stug por spyod pa mtha' dag thugs rje'i zer gyis rab bcom nas/ /phan dang bde ba'i 'phrin las mchog gis 'tsho zhing shis pa nyid gyur cig /gcig tu bla mar 'dun pa'i gdung sems kyi/ /las ldan gang de bde ba'i thang la rgyu/ /rin chen ri bo snyen pa'i gnyis skyes tshogs/ /btso ma'i gser mdog 'dzin pa dngos po'i gshis/ /rnam 'dren drin gyis 'khyud pa'i skal bzang tshogs/ /rnam grol mchog gi go 'phang yud kyis 'dzin/ /brgya phrag g.yang du lhung pa'i nyam chung dag /bde ba'i skabs med gcong rong mgron du byed/ /gang yang ma nor lam bzang bye ba brgya/ /rgyun chad med par spel ba'i thams cad mkhyen/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang gzhan ngor mi yi zol/ /gang gi sngon mdzad rnam thar mdo tsam dang / /ma 'ongs 'byung 'gyur rgyas par spel ba yi/ /lhag bsam mchog 'di 'gro ba'i bsod nams dang / /dkon mchog rin chen rnam gsum thugs rje yis/ /yid la re ba ji bzhin 'grub gyur cig /de slad rnam 'dren mchog khyod bskal brgya'i bar/ /lhar bcas 'gro ba'i mgon du zhabs brtan cing / /slar yang bstan 'dzin mkhas dbang ma nu'i bu/ /bgrang yas 'phel te bstan pa rgyas byed shog /gser ldan lto bar rin chen sa 'dzin mchog /nyi zla'i rna cha'i mdzes pa 'dzin byed pa/ /de srid chos kyi gtam 'di 'gro ba yi/ /rna rgyan nyid du mdzes pa 'dzin gyur cig /dbyings rig gcig tu 'dres kyang sgyu ma'i gar/

/skal bzang dpyid du bsgyur ba'i ngo mtshar gtam/ /dpag bsam 'khri shing 'dzings pa'i skyed tshal nas/ /utpal 'phreng ba da dung spel gyur cig /de ltar bdag gi rnam 'dren dam pa thub pa'i rgyal tshab rigs thams cad kyi gtso bo dkyil 'khor mtha' dag gi rdo rje slob dpon mtshan brjod par dka' ba rje btsun bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa yon tan rin po che 'dus pa'i rgya mtsho 'phel bar byed pa phun tshogs bdud rtsi'i char rgyun zhes bya ba 'di thams cad mkhyen pa chen po de nyid la zab rgyas chos tshul rgya mtsho lta bu'i bka' drin nos pa'i skal ba bzang po can gdan sa chen po'i chos las pa shākya'i dge slong byams pa rin chen gyis rang nyid kyang mi phyed dad pa chen pos kun nas bslangs shing / rje btsun dam pa 'di nyid kyi zhabs 'bring pa phyag mdzod bsod nams rab brtan gyi bkas yang yang bskul ba la brten nas/ mkhan chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs mai tri dhya na sa mu dras mdzad pa'i rje nyid kyi rtogs brjod chen mo'i kha skong gi zhabs 'degs su dmigs te rgya gar lugs la bi kā ri ste sgyur byed/ rgya nag lugs la sa pho khyi lo'i me tog can gyi zla ba'i dkar phyogs bzang po gsum pa'i tshes la dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen po'i dge 'phel bla brang du rang nyid kyis sug bris su bgyis pa 'di'i dge bas rje bla ma bskal brgyar zhabs pad brtan nas spyi dang bye brag gi bstan pa nam langs pa la nyin byed shar ba ltar dkar 'jam du gyur te skye dgu thams cad bde skyid kyi dpal la longs spyod pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig/ // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 16 ngag dbang bstan pa'i rdo rje/ a myes zhabs kyi rnam par thar pa byams pa rin chen gyis mdzad pa/
